Title: Data Engineer
Description:
The Opportunity
Just Eat is searching for a senior data engineer to join the Data Systems team. You’ll have the opportunity to work with big data technologies, building scalable and reliable solutions to support real time analytics, advanced data science and critical operational projects powered by data.
What We Do
The Data Systems team’s role is to build a transformational data platform in order to democratise data in Just Eat. Our team is built on following principles:
Open Data: We ingest all data produced across Just Eat using batch and realtime pipelines and make it available to every employee in Just Eat. This data is then used to drive analytics, business intelligence, data science and critical business operations.
Self Service: We build tools, frameworks and processes to support self service modeling and activation of data. Our goal is to empower our users to find, process and consume our data without barriers.
Single Truth: We build services that host all metadata about Just Eat’s data in a single store and promote governance, data culture and Single Source of Truth.
Intelligent Personalisation: We build and maintain a machine learning platform which supports data scientists in developing and deploying ML models at production scale. This allows us to deliver insights, personalisation and predictions to our customers at scale.
How We Do It
Our team is built on the following tenets:
Innovate: We are always learning, growing, inquisitive and keen on new technologies and open source tooling. We love like-minded engineers with a passion to keep our code-base and infrastructure best in class.
Build for Scale: All our tools and components are built for scale and we use Kubernetes and other tools to help us scale automatically.
Cloud based: We use serverless technologies where possible to simplify our estate, technologies like BigQuery, PubSub, Datalow and Cloud functions allow us to move quickly. In addition we run a Kubernetes cluster on GKE with many workloads including instances of Apache Airflow.
DevOps culture: Everyone in the team contributes to infrastructure, we have a CI/CD pipeline and we define our infrastructure as code. Our stack includes terraform, jenkins and Helm. Teams monitor their applications using prometheus, grafana and alert manager.
Collaboration & Ownership: All code is owned by the team and we have multiple avenues for collaboration - rotation, pairing and technical showcases. We also encourage team members to own their own code and promote self governance.
We’re looking for enthusiastic engineers to join two of our teams within Data Systems
Self Service Tools
Our mission is to enable all employees to be self-sufficient with data, so that data-driven decisions can be made quickly and easily. We build and maintain all of Just Eat’s data centric tools.
We use engineering to simplify tasks, reducing the technical barrier of entry to navigate, explore and consume our data. Our tools use Airflow to unlock the tasks of transformation and egress of data, making these simple functions that can be undertaken by anyone.
We support over 200 active users across the business, building Airflow backed tools that run thousands of DAGs in multiple timezones. We manage and run our own Airflow clusters on Kubernetes. We work together as a team in three countries to produce innovative products and keep data flowing.
Core Systems
Our team’s mission is to build base functionalities that power a leading data platform. Our portfolio includes a variety of highly critical tools including (but not limited to) Real-time Ingestion, GDPR, Metadata Catalogues, and Access Controls. Here are snippets of some of our portfolio
Real-time Ingestion - A generic data ingestion pipeline currently running up to 10k events per second from 2.5k topics.
Metadata Catalogues - Infer and store context around data (about 1 PB in 500 datasets) and keep it secure and searchable.
Our stack is primarily Scala using libraries like ZIO, Cats, Akka streams and Apache beam. Python is also used in lot’s of areas.
Required skills and experience
You should apply if
You love writing well tested, readable and performant code, capable of processing large volumes of data. You have mastery in Scala and/or Python.
You love working with Cloud technologies, and have experience in working with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. We use Google Cloud with a mix of services - Kubernetes, Dataflow, PubSub etc.
You can contribute to architecture discussions and influence peers and stakeholders to make better decisions.
You have the inclination to collaborate and ability to communicate technical ideas clearly.
You understand the entire product development lifecycle, from coding to deployments, to monitoring, alerting etc... Our teams maintain all aspects of our product lifecycle, but we don’t expect everyone to be an expert in all of it.
You understand the fundamentals of computing and distributed systems.
We dont expect people to already know our tech stack top to bottom, but knowledge of some of it or similar technologies is beneficial
Why work at Just Eat?
Just Eat Takeaway.com is a leading global online food delivery marketplace headquartered in Amsterdam and listed on the London Stock Exchange.
We've built our business on having the widest choice available on our platform – connecting millions of customers with over 155,000 restaurants across 23 countries - with over 100 different cuisines from local independents to globally famous restaurants, available to order via our app and website.
We provide the platform and tools to help independent restaurants move online and reach a significantly broader customer base – to generate increased orders and grow their businesses. We also provide the insights, advice, and support our growing community needs to satisfy customers and help raise standards across a vibrant takeaway sector.
We’re built to deliver behind the scenes too. To make Just Eat the great company it is, it takes a great team of people. Which is why all of our colleagues are welcomed into a diverse and inclusive workplace where they feel they can belong. We're passionate about nurturing our people and offer a full programme of training and support to our employees – helping them to develop their careers in a way that suits them.
No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, where you are from, religious beliefs or takeaway preferences you could find your place at Just Eat. We’re a diverse and inclusive workplace that promotes a sense of belonging, allowing all of our people to bring their most colourful and complex selves to work every day.

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Higher Scientific Officer in High-Throughput Immunohistochem...
Description:
The Cancer Research UK Convergence Science Centre was established as a strategic partnership between the Institute of Cancer Research (ICR) and Imperial College London. The mission of the CRUK Convergence Science Centre is to bring together engineering, physical sciences, life sciences and medicine to develop innovative ways to address challenges in cancer research to benefit cancer patients. This is achieved through multidisciplinary collaborations that integrate otherwise distinct approaches to co-create new tools, technologies and methodologies. It is underpinned by a Major Centre award from CRUK, which provides the funding to create step changes in cancer research to address unmet medical needs in all cancers, particularly those that are hard to treat.
One of the objectives of the Centre is to expand the collaborative activities between the two institutions in the context of computational histopathology and artificial intelligence/ machine learning analysis of histopathological images from cancer patient cohorts. Specifically, we aim to operate a service generating large, clinically annotated datasets of digitalised histology images processed using multiplex immunohistochemistry assays. These data will then be made available to mathematical and computational scientists at Imperial and ICR for analysis using artificial intelligence/ machine learning approaches. Following an initial proof of concept study to optimise workflows, the service will open to researchers at the ICR and Imperial who will submit project proposals based on novel cancer questions for competitive selection.
For this position, we are seeking a highly motivated Higher Scientific Officer with expertise in immunohistochemistry and histopathology in cancer. You will be responsible for supervising and running multiplex immunohistochemistry platforms and performing high-throughput multiplex immunohistochemistry assays on cancer samples from retrospective patient cohorts and clinical trials, with the objective of generating spatial tissue maps at single-cell resolution. You will interact with other members of the Centre, including computational scientists that develop machine learning algorithms for the automatic analysis of histopathological images. You must have a solid cancer biology background, experience with cancer histopathological assays and be highly organized and meticulous. You will work closely with a diverse team to formulate and validate hypotheses.

You should have a good first degree in biological sciences or equivalent, and solid expertise in histopathology, immunohistochemistry and cryosectioning. Experience with, micro- and macro-dissection of tumour specimens and flow cytometry are highly desirable. Experience with library preparation for next-generation sequencing, as well as general molecular biology techniques including PCR, nucleic acid extraction and cell culture would be advantageous. Excellent organizational and communication skills are essential.
Appointment will be on a Fixed Term Contract until March 31st 2022 in the first instance, subject to review in March 2021. The position is potentially extendible for a further 5y dependent upon successful renewal of the Centre grant and the overall research strategy. The salary for the post will be dependent on candidate skills and experience, for Higher Scientific Officer being £32,000 to £44,400.
Informal enquiries can be made to Dr Andrea Sottoriva (andrea.sottoriva@icr.ac.uk). Please DO NOT send your application via email, formal applications must be submitted online.
To apply please upload your CV, complete an application form including the supporting statement to address where you meet the person specification provide the names and addresses of two referees and submit online at http://www.icr.ac.uk/jobsearch
We consider all applications on merit and have a strong commitment to enhancing the diversity of our staff.

Title: Research Manager

LGC’s Grant Management Group (GMG) are experts in managing research funding to maximise its impact. We are looking for Senior Research Managers and Research Managers (full-time or part-time) to join our CCF Research Programmes Directorate team to help drive, among other things, a new funding scheme designed to generate a pipeline of data science and artificial intelligence translational research projects to understand and map clusters of multiple long term conditions (multimorbidity) (MLTC-M).
This initiative will support research collaborations and partnerships between leading academic institutions, health and care researchers, AI experts, and practitioners and grow capacity and capability for multi-disciplinary working in MLTC-M for the benefit of patients, practitioners and the public.
At the heart of this investment is a commitment to reducing health inequalities, reconfiguring the health and social care system in areas and for populations living with the greatest burden. In order to genuinely deliver on these commitments, meaningful and sustainable engagement at multiple levels is required. Key stakeholders will include communities, local authorities, industry, regulators, policy makers and academics.
These roles will cover the full end-to-end process of research management, from launching new calls for applications through to the active monitoring of funded projects and will require an ability to work collaboratively with other team members and across organisations. Senior Research Managers will be expected to take on additional line management or technical expert associated tasks.
Key Accountabilities:
Supporting all aspects of research funding, including researching and articulating potential research investment opportunities, advising potential applicants, revising application forms and guidance documents, reviewing and short-listing of applications for funding, coordinating and managing the peer review process, overseeing the funding committees, coordinating and attending funding committee meetings, providing feedback to successful and unsuccessful applicants
Undertaking due diligence of proposals based on critical assessment of healthcare-related projects, including reviewing the scientific, technical and clinical rationale, and, supported by senior members of the team, analysis of value for money, evaluation of proposed IP protection and freedom to operate positions and assessment of the proposed dissemination, adoption and/or commercialisation strategy
Negotiating funding agreements for projects recommended for funding, including the negotiation of milestones and deliverables, financial arrangements and reporting requirements to enable successful project progression
Managing a portfolio of funded projects, including monitoring of scientific, clinical and financial performance, reviewing IP and dissemination plans and managing contractual changes to ensure appropriate strategies are in place leading to patient benefit and/or commercial realisation
Liaising regularly with internal and external stakeholders, including attending, organising and leading meetings, representing the funder’s perspective at project meetings to facilitate successful project development, and promoting and representing funding programmes at external meetings
Contributing to strategic development initiatives, for example those to enable broad data access to successful applicants
Drafting SOPs, work instructions and template documents and issuing guidelines
Assisting with the quality control of minutes, outcome letters and other external documentation
Assisting in the preparation of regular and ad hoc programme reports, papers and minutes
Ad hoc “special project” work
Identifying enhancements to working practices and defining, implementing and supporting the processes to deliver operational excellence
Organising and attending site visits, advisory panel meetings and relevant external meetings etc.
Responding to Parliamentary Questions or briefing requests from DH, often at very short notice
Developing and maintaining excellent professional relationships with other GMG teams, applicants and award holders and with colleagues within NIHR and at the Department of Health and social care, and act as a role model to colleagues at all levels

Qualifications
Candidate Specification:
Knowledge of the National Institute for Health Research architecture and objectives
Background in biomedical, health, engineering or social sciences (we would welcome applications from candidates with a background in artificial intelligence, machine learning or data science)
Experience of working in a research environment, either in academia or industry
Experience or clear awareness of commercially focused research or the commercialisation of research, including understanding of intellectual property.

Excellent interpersonal skills from liaising with internal and external stakeholders and communities

Well developed analytical and complex problem solving skills, with a solution based approach
Excellent communication skills and customer focus, including experience of external liaison

Initiative

Title: Data Mentor
Description:
Decoded is currently hiring for new joiners to begin in this role from August 2020.

ABOUT DECODED
We are Decoded, the pioneers of transformative technology education. We democratise cutting edge skills. We help transform traditional businesses into tech companies. We give our learners the skills and confidence to embrace the future of work.
Our products and methodologies have been shaped through our collaboration with some of the largest and most technologically progressive organisations in the world. We use the intelligent, ethical and creative application of technology to lay the foundations for a more productive and promising world – one with unlimited possibilities.

OVERVIEW
Decoded is looking for a Data Mentor to join our Mentorship Team. You will be responsible for supporting a group of learners through the Data Academy by providing first-class coaching, mentoring and teaching that meets their aspirations and objectives.
Our Data Academy delivers a government-funded Level 4 Data Analyst apprenticeship qualification to our learners. Our accelerated technical skills development focuses on data science and machine learning as it applies to the commercial context of our learners' day to day work. Course content includes various supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques including forecasting algorithms, database management techniques and big data.
You will facilitate 1-on-1 sessions with learners during which you will help them apply machine learning techniques to their day-to-day job, simplify complex data concepts, assist with potential programming issues, give feedback on projects, review their progress, and help them to plan the coming weeks. You will also support monthly in-person workshops to your learner groups throughout the course.
ACCOUNTABILITIES
As a Data Mentor at Decoded, you’re accountable for:
Successfully mentoring learners through the 18-month Data Academy Apprenticeship programme
Enabling and empowering learners so they can produce high-quality work, and develop as lifelong learners as well as employees
Evidencing the knowledge, skills and behaviour they acquire as part of our obligations as a government regulated entity through Ofsted and ESFA
Maintaining regular learner metrics to comply with Decoded’s administrative requirements to manage your caseload of learners

SPECIFIC ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES
Mentoring
Support learners with effective time and stress management methodologies
Model and share best practice to adapting to learning a new discipline
Offer emotional support when responding to the challenges learners face during the programme
Learner engagement
Hold one-to-one learning and development sessions with each learner of your cohort on a monthly basis
Respond to emails and messages within a timely manner
Troubleshooting with Programme Managers to improve learner engagement
Hold quarterly reviews with each learner and their line manager to track progress and development on the course
Teaching
Take our theoretical course content and tailor it for each individual learner that you are supporting through individual learning and development sessions
Support your learner to complete all of Decoded’s training material and assessment tasks in a timely manner
Help learners with programming issues through calls, workshops and via email
Help learners to apply and develop their learning at work
Supporting the facilitation of Data Academy workshops once or twice a month as required, to offer technical support to learners as they learn new content
Learner Administration
Upholding the highest standards of compliance administration, specifically by requesting and marking evidence from learners on the knowledge, skills and behaviours they are acquiring throughout the programme
Keeping our LMS up to date through records of learner calls, submitted work and business-relevant work to provide visibility of engagement across the Decoded team
Project support
Providing timely, detailed and specific feedback on learner’s business-relevant projects at the end of each module as part of their ongoing assessment
Offering guidance and support to learners about their project work using Decoded’s mark scheme
End Point Assessment
Support learners to prepare a portfolio demonstrating the technical competencies
Offer guidance on revision for their exams and final interview

SKILLS & BEHAVIOURS
Your performance will be measured by and driven by:
Data analysis using Python or R
Striving for excellence in everything you do: you don’t accept mediocrity in yourself or the team around you
Building brilliant, collaborative and productive relationships with colleagues and partners alike
Solving problems elegantly and creatively: “find a way or make a way”
Taking accountability for your own success, and the success of others
Guiding first, directing later
Being non-judgemental
Excellent listening skills
Meeting learners where they are at, not where we expect them to be

WHO ARE YOU?
Our Data Mentors are a community of data science education enthusiasts. Our learners love their blend of science and humanity, combining technical expertise and a passion for education.
Our mentors have backgrounds ranging from Theoretical Physics to Clinical Psychology to Zoology with experience ranging from secondary school teaching to PhD-level research to data engineering. They have developed models across machine learning techniques within academic and business settings, and whatever their background, they are all:
Obsessed with learning and teaching
High quality communicators, verbally and in writing
Excited by the frontiers of data science and machine learning
Problem solvers who work with Python or R
Empathetic
Highly organised and motivated
Passionate about transforming the skills of their learners

TEAM & REPORTING STRUCTURE
This role will be reporting into one of Decoded's Lead Mentors.
DAY-TO-DAY
You will be based in our London office. You will work from 9am to 6pm either full time five days a week, or part time for a minimum of four days a week. You will travel to your learners' workplaces to deliver in person workshops monthly.
You will be in control and responsible for your time. You plan your working day around the best outcomes for success, identifying and prioritising projects against business need.
LEARNING & PROGRESSION
All team members gain full exposure to Decoded learning programmes. So when it comes to future-proofing your CV, you couldn’t be better placed. In just a few months at Decoded you’ll become fluent in digital technologies and innovation, and you’ll continue to refresh and refine this knowledge for the duration of your career here.
Beyond that, we run a dedicated learning calendar to hone craft skills in teaching, leadership, strategy and other relevant disciplines.
Quarterly performance reviews embedded within our culture of feedback will ensure you are recognised and rewarded for the value that you bring to Decoded.

Apart from the above, working at Decoded means you’ll get:
28 days’ holiday per year, inclusive of the 8 bank holidays. We also close for two full weeks at Christmas, at Decoded's discretion
Modern, flexible and fully serviced offices at Fora
Company pension contributions
Private health care including dental, GP and hospital cover and a gym-discount to help you prioritise your wellbeing
Travel insurance
A huge array of social events including themed Christmas get-togethers and a summer away day as well as monthly drinks and activities
Continuous learning and development through monthly training sessions focusing on data science and teaching, plus bespoke training, coaching and development to allow you to reach your potential. You will be challenged with lots of responsibility and exciting projects in an environment that encourages learning, creativity, personal growth and collaboration
Free monthly lunches, fresh fruit every day, drinks and snacks
Casual dress every day
Flexible working and working from home when you need to
Cutting edge software and kit, always
Interview process
Phone call: you will speak to our people team and be asked a series of questions in relation to your background and experience, and will be given an insight into Decoded and the Data Mentor role.
First interview: you will be invited to a Google Hangouts call to meet two people at a similar level to you. This is a competency-based interview, involving a teaching task and a mentor-call task along with questions about your skills.
Second interview: the final will be held in person at our office in Spitalfields by our Head of Mentorship. By the end of this process you will come away with informative insights on the role and life at Decoded.

The Biomedical Research Centre (BRC) Clinical and Research Informatics Unit (CRIU) is a partnership between University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (UCLH) and University College London (UCL). Candidates should have a degree or equivalent in Informatics or Software Engineering, Computer Science or Systems Engineering. They should also have experience of database and data warehouse design, experience of preparing detailed technical documentation, and knowledge of data modelling.

Job Description
Location: London / Edinburgh / Singapore / Houston
We are looking for a Head of Economics & Demand to lead the newly created Demand Centre of Excellence (CoE), reporting into our Commodities Research group. This new role provides an exceptional opportunity to work across Wood Mackenzie, ensuring our demand analysis is a must-have reference source for our clients. Understanding demand is increasingly important, as the energy transition and shifting patterns of global consumption evolve. The role will ensure leading edge analytics, technologies and modelling techniques are used to acquire, interpret and forecast demand data. You will be responsible for our demand-side analysis across all energy and natural resources sectors (Oil, Gas and NGLs, LNG, Coal, Power, Refined Products, Petrochemicals and Metals), ensuring forecast accuracy, credibility and consistency.
About you and how you can excel in this role
You understand the value of data and expert insight for business decision making and want to work in a leading research, analytics and consultancy business. You are passionate about leadership and excellence.
You are an experienced leader in the commodities or natural resources industry. In doing so, you have shown that you possess sound commercial acumen and have led strategic development within your area, particularly leading through change and business transformation. It would be an advantage if you have worked with a data and analytics, commercial research or consulting business, and industry knowledge and leadership skills are essential.
The people around you recognise your ability to develop others, building an environment in which people thrive and deliver high quality results. The way in which you work enables you to build effective, collaborative internal relationships and can influence within a matrix at all levels in the company. You understand that diversity of experience and thought makes a difference and that working across different geographies requires cultural appreciation.
You are passionate about what you do and the quality of your work makes you credible with clients and able to engage at the senior level. Your extensive knowledge of modelling methodologies has supported you defining the data strategy for demand and setting the requirements to establish best-in-class demand modelling. Strengthened by your sector-specific experience you have proposed approaches to forecast energy and natural resources demand, focusing particularly on integrated methodologies for Power, Transport, Industrial Production, Commercial and Residential segments.
If you are looking for a role where you can make positive impact on business results, your own team and those around you, please apply now.
About the role
You will be custodian for demand forecasting methodology for each commodity, segments and key markets. Leading demand base case forecasting for each update cycle across all commodities, you will define the approach and appropriate level of granularity used by Wood Mackenzie to analyze and forecast demand in each commodity area. You will bring specific understanding of a range of modelling methodologies applicable to short-term and long-term demand modelling.
Your focus will be to transform the business. This will include contributing to fostering an open, innovative and dynamic environment where unconventional thinking is encouraged. You will ensure thought leadership is authored highlighting Wood Mackenzie analysis and perspectives on demand and its role in energy transition.
As Head of Demand, you will represent our demand views externally. You will be able to prioritize what matters to clients and the industry. Given your engagement with your network of senior-level clients and contacts, you will understand their needs and business priorities. Internally you will establish efficient demand modelling consistent with the defined forecasting methodologies. You will also focus on setting up price response functions for demand as part of integrated energy balance modelling, reflecting the interplay between different commodity sectors and energy transition factors.
You will work collaboratively developing demand subject matter expertise and the community of demand analysts in each commodity area. You will also work closely with the other CoE Leads (in particular Short Term Analytics, Modelling and Economics), commodity Subject Matter Experts, modelling experts, data analysts and data scientists across Research and Technology to ensure that appropriate demand models are developed, used and maintained. You will ensure Wood Mackenzie’s integrated energy balance modelling incorporates appropriate price elasticity and demand response functions.

Title: time Security (ENSURESEC project)
Description:
We have a position for the senior research fellow to work in the EU HORIZON 2020 project “ENSURESEC: End-to-end Security of the Digital Single Market’s E-commerce and Delivery Service Ecosystem”. ENSURESEC is a sociotechnical solution for safeguarding the Digital Single Market’s e-commerce operations against cyber and physical threats. It combines an automatic, rigorous, distributed and open-source toolkit for protecting the e-commerce infrastructure, with monitoring of the impact of threats in physical space. ENSURESEC addresses the whole gamut of modern e-commerce, from standard physical products purchased online and delivered via post, to entirely virtual products or services delivered online. Similarly, it addresses threats ranging from maliciously modifying web e-commerce applications or rendering them unavailable to legitimate customers, to delivery issues or fraud committed by insiders or customers. It achieves this by focusing on the common software and physical sensor interfaces that sit along the e-commerce, payment and delivery ecosystem. At a technical level, it integrates proven state-of-the-art inductive (machine learning) with deductive (formal methods) reasoning tools and techniques so that e-commerce operations are protected by design, as well as through continuous monitoring, response, recovery and mitigation measures at run-time.
This is an exciting opportunity to participate in a new area of research and in the process collaborate with our prestigious project partners, including key players in software engineering, software verification, blockchain, pen testing, telecommunication, electronic financial services, social media, cyber and physical security of critical infrastructure, to name a few.
Within the project, you will be responsible for design and development of a run-time security monitor that requires to translate and adapt existing monitors for the security of e-commerce system. The tool is required to be open source and free. This research will be expected to be published at a premier related journal.
You will need to be a highly competent software developer with experience in developing cyber security tools, ideally in the context of run-time security or software security or vulnerability/fault analysis as well as have high-impact research publications in related areas. A PhD in computer science, mathematics or engineering is essential.
Since this post is project based, this is fixed term for two years.
Before applying, you may wish to contact Dr. M. Taimoor Khan (m.khan@gre.ac.uk) for informal enquiries.
We are looking for people who can help us deliver our mission of transforming lives through inspired teaching and research, through our values.

Title: Centre Project Manager
Description:
Are you able to give direction and support for the development of cross-faculty and cross-disciplinary research collaborations of our newly established £20Mio UKRI Centre for Doctoral Training in AI for Healthcare?
We are inviting applications for a Centre Project Manager at the UKRI Centre For Doctoral Training in AI for Healthcare (AI4Health). This is a high-calibre professional role which stirs the direction and development of the Centre’s partnerships and collaborations.

Duties and responsibilities


Project management for activities related to the Centre.

Executive support for the director in fulling their function.

Manage and support the Centre’s public engagement to identify and develop opportunities for impact development and income generation (for studentships) from external sources.

Provide project and collaboration management support to cross-disciplinary research project development.

Build relationships with alumni and effectively leverage the local alumni community for marketing and collaboration purposes.

Support the project teams in developing external relationships with organisations who will invest in research and education. Work closely with principal investigators (PIs) on existing major funded projects to further develop the relationship with the funder, facilitate discussions for funding follow-on developments, and facilitate impact-related activities.

Essential requirements
In order to be successful for this role you should have:
Experience in managing, coordinating and implementing projects, including digital marketing and global outreach, ideally in Higher Education
Experience of successfully supporting academic staff in addressing priorities
Experience of managing the support of grant development, or similar strategic documents
Excellent IT skills and demonstrable experience of analysing complex data and using the results to inform future planning and strategy.
Educated to degree level or equivalent and/or relevant professional, industry and/or research experience in a similar capacity

Further information
Background:
The vision of the newly established £20Mio UKRI Centre for Doctoral Training in AI for Healthcare (AI4Health Centre) is to become a world-leading centre driving the research in AI applied to healthcare and to train a new generation of researchers and leaders in AI applied to healthcare who will be able to move effortlessly across the disciplinary AI-healthcare boundaries and can develop and implement deployable solutions.
The term “AI” means for us the development of intelligent systems that embody a practical solution. Amongst contemporary AI approaches, Machine Learning methods have shown to yield powerful solutions which work in purely data-driven manners and link via data science to emerging biomedical research methodologies. However, practical solutions involving AI will require a broader approach and we will drive technical innovation by providing broad training for the exploitation of multiple technological strategies within the broader realm of AI, including, Machine Learning, Logic-based, Computer Vision or Natural Language Processing methods.
The AI4Health Centre is based at Imperial College London which is consistently ranked in the top 10 of University world rankings, it has the highest proportion of 4* (world-leading) and 3* (internationally excellent) academics in the UK, ranks 3rd in Engineering, Medicine and Technology in Europe (e.g. QS, THE league tables). All participating departments span Imperial’s Faculties of Engineering, Natural Sciences and Medicine, and have a long tradition of successful collaboration between themselves and with industry, through joint research projects, joint student projects and industrial placements. The Department of Computing, which hosts the AI4Health Centre has been awarded the highest research rating in each of the national Research Excellence Framework (REF) exercises. Imperial College also has over 50 years of history in AI research and a thriving Artificial Intelligence Network which is also a Network of Excellence.
A particular strength of our environment is the pathway to impact. This is facilitated by the Centre being close to business via the industry board and end-users in the NHS and patients through the patient board.
Applications should be submitted online. To apply, visit www.imperial.ac.uk/jobs and search by the job reference ENG01293.
For any questions or queries regarding the application process and aspects of the posts, please contact Britta Ross at b.ross@imperial.ac.uk in the first instance or visit our website: https://ai4health.io/
For technical issues when applying online please email recruitment@imperial.ac.uk

Title: Higher Scientific Officer / Scientific Officer in Tumour Het...
Description:
The new Centre for Evolution and Cancer within the Institute of Cancer Research is supported by a Strategic Award from the Wellcome Trust. We focus on interrogating clonal evolution in tumours by studying the dynamics of heterogeneous cancer cell populations and their microenvironment. We make use of multi-region genomic profiling, single-cell genetics, computational histopathological analysis and mathematical modelling to reconstruct the past evolutionary history of tumours and predict their future.
Prof Andrea Sottoriva is the Director of the Centre for Evolution and Cancer and his lab focuses on deciphering the dynamics of cancer growth, progression and treatment resistance in each patient using a combination of cancer genomic approaches, experimental model systems and mathematical analyses, with the objective of predicting the future course of the disease.
For this position, we are seeking a highly motivated Scientific Officer / Higher Scientific Officer with expertise in immunohistochemistry and histopathology in cancer. The successful candidate will be responsible for performing high-throughput multiplex immunohistochemistry assays on cancer samples from retrospective patient cohorts and clinical trials, with the objective of characterising spatial intra-tumour heterogeneity. The candidate will interact with other members of the lab, including computational scientists that develop machine learning algorithms for the automatic analysis of histopathological images. Other responsibilities include helping postdocs and students with sample processing, nucleic acid extraction and NGS library preparation when needed. The candidate must have a solid cancer biology background, experience with cancer histopathological assays and be highly organized and meticulous. The successful candidate will work closely with a diverse team to formulate and validate hypotheses.
Applicants should have a good first degree in biological sciences or equivalent, and solid expertise in histopathology, immunohistochemistry and cryosectioning. Experience with, micro- and macro-dissection of tumour specimens and flow cytometry are highly desirable. Experience with library preparation for next-generation sequencing, as well as general molecular biology techniques including PCR, nucleic acid extraction and cell culture would be highly advantageous. Excellent organizational and communication skills are essential.
The position is offered on a 3 year fixed term contract. The salary for the post will be dependent on candidate skills and experience, for Scientific Officer being £26,000 to £33,600 and for Higher Scientific Officer being £32,000 to £44,400.
Informal enquiries can be made to Dr Andrea Sottoriva (andrea.sottoriva@icr.ac.uk). Please DO NOT send your application via email, formal applications must be submitted online.
To apply please upload your CV and complete an online application form addressing in the Supporting Statement section how you meet the person specification and including the names and contact details of two referees.
We consider all applications on merit and have a strong commitment to enhancing the diversity of our staff.

Title: Head of Platform Security
Description:
The Head of Platform Security is responsible for overseeing security aspects of the end-to-end YouView Platform and the associated eco-system. In doing so the Head of Platform Security is required to act as YouView’s primary information security advocate in both internal and external contexts.
Working with the Platform Security team and a range of internal and external stakeholders, the Head of Platform Security is responsible for the definition and communication of security policies and processes as well as ensuring that these are implemented across new and existing elements of the YouView Platform by all relevant participants. The range of technologies and domains that this encompasses is broad: consumer device implementation, in particular Set-top Boxes and Connected TVs and their in-field management; Public Key Infrastructure management; cloud services, third party applications and content delivery solutions. Broadly speaking, Platform Security covers Cyber Security, Content Protection and Data handling (GDPR and more).
The role requires engagement with a wide range of third-party content providers, rights holders, device manufacturers, Internet Service Providers and specialist technology suppliers. This includes household names, such as the BBC, BT, TalkTalk, Netflix, Amazon and Sony as well as Content Rights Holders (including Hollywood Studios).
The Head of Platform Security is not responsible for Corporate IT systems and processes but is required to work closely with the Operations Security Manager to ensure that a co-ordinated approach to information security is taken across the Corporate IT estate and the wider YouView Platform.

Primary Responsibilities:
Ensure that information security policies and processes are defined, adopted and maintained across and within the YouView Platform, balancing the business’s desire to introduce new features, capabilities and partners with the longer-term viability of the YouView Platform as an ongoing concern.
o Contribute to the definition of the YouView Platform roadmap ensuring that security-related considerations are reflected.
Act as the key point of engagement with YouView Device Manufacturers’ security representatives, ensuring that they operate in line with the overall security design for the YouView Platform.
o Execute the security certification activity for new YouView Device models, including design review and implementation validation (e.g. factory process audits, security evaluation etc.)
Act as the key point of engagement with YouView Content Providers’ security representatives, ensuring that they operate in line with the overall security design for the YouView Platform.
Review compliance with security obligations as part of on-boarding a new YouView Content Provider.
Maintain active engagement with key participants in the content protection landscape that directly impact or potentially influence the YouView Eco-system, using this intelligence to steer the current and future direction of the YouView Platform.
o Content Protection technology vendors (e.g. Microsoft, Intertrust etc.)
o Content Rights Holders (e.g. Hollywood Studios incl. Sony Pictures, Disney, Sky, BT etc.)
o Native Players (Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, etc.)
Lead and manage the YouView Platform Security team, deploying staff effectively within the business as necessary to support the execution of this role.
o Participate in the design, development and deployment of new features and capabilities within the YouView Platform, as operated by YouView and/or third party eco-system participants.
o Execute data and intelligence gathering activities to pro-actively identify potential security issues (e.g. threat analysis, system monitoring, vulnerability scanning, horizon scanning etc.)
o Manage the operation of YouView’s Public Key Infrastructure.
Work with the Operational Security Manager to ensure a co-ordinated approach to governance and communication of security related issues.
o Provide second line support to the YouView Operations team as part of a co-ordinated response.
Essential Skills & Experience
Experience working as a technical lead in information security related roles.
A broad knowledge of information security methods, best practice, architectures, technologies, standards,
management frameworks and training methods.
Definition and communication of information security policy and processes to a range of stakeholders.
Stakeholder engagement, requirements capture and management of a programme of project work alongside ongoing operational activities.
Analysis, specification, audit and ongoing review of the security considerations for information systems.
Leadership and management of a team of technical specialists.
Engagement in technical and commercial discussions with internal and external partners and suppliers.
Ability to take stakeholders along on the security journey and to balance conflicting and changing demands through prioritisation and a pragmatic approach
Engagement in the management, mitigation, analysis and resolution of security issues and operational
incidents.
Ability to work to deadlines and contribute to timely management and resolution of operational issues.
Consensus building across collaborative teams, working with technical and commercial subject matter experts that are often more knowledgeable in their respective domain.
Awareness of Agile, DevOps and SecOps methodologies.
Good written and verbal communication.
Desired Skills & Experience
Working knowledge/experience of the security considerations in any or all of the following areas:
Online video and/or digital television delivery, ideally in the area of content protection and digital rights management; and/or
Consumer devices based on embedded systems, ideally in the area of IP Set Top Boxes; and/or High-availability, cloud-based backend systems, ideally as used to support delivery of services to consumer devices.
Working knowledge of security considerations relating to identity management and consumer privacy.
Experience with high-availability, cloud-based backend systems, ideally as used to support delivery of services to consumer devices.
Familiarity with the design and management of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).
Practical experience of implementing and operationalising security solutions, and a willingness to get hands-on where necessary.
Knowledge of software security mechanisms and Common Criteria security evaluation
Applied knowledge of state-of-the-art technology such as Fuzzing and Machine Learning techniques in the context of static and dynamic code analysis, and their integration with the SSDL

Primary responsibilities
Bring expertise in the application of artificial intelligence to real-world problems in drug discovery and development
Promote machine learning best practices, such as: scalable training and deployment, model introspection and evaluation, new state-of-the-art implementations, etc.
Work as a member of a cross-functional team comprising specialists in informatics, engineering, AI, drug discovery and product. In these teams, you will apply the latest advances in machine learning to develop tools for drug discovery and development.
Define the analytical and technical problems in applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to develop new solutions and deliver applied research within your team, and to influence an empirical approach across the company


We’re looking for someone with...
An advanced degree (a PhD) in computer science or a related field with a clear focus on empirical research, or equivalent experience
Knowledge of modern tools for ML such as Tensorflow, Pytorch, etc.
Experience implementing machine learning workflows.
Awareness of and passion for the state of the art in machine learning.
PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS
Experience building research prototypes and developing product-worthy tools from them.
Experience with relevant research applying modern machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques to biological data (e.g., genomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics, proteomics, etc.) or clinical data (e.g., electronic health records).
Experience with the development and evaluation of methods for biomedical knowledge base construction and machine reading.
Experience with automated reasoning from a knowledge base, including graph inference algorithms and knowledge base completion.
Knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry, ideally with a focus on drug discovery.
Who are we?
We are an eclectic bunch at Benevolent, united by our belief that innovative thinking and purposeful technology can truly change outcomes for the better. Our mission is to re-engineer drug discovery and deliver life-changing medicines for patients in need and we do this by applying AI, machine learning and other advanced technologies to reinvent the ways drugs are discovered and developed. We strive to bring together unique skills and perspectives across biology, chemistry, engineering, AI research, informatics, precision medicine and drug discovery. Together, we envision a world in which no disease goes untreated. If you are benevolent, curious, want to tackle real world problems and are willing to embrace new ideas, hit that ‘apply’ button and join us.

Show phone number
Regarding the room
Sufficient space and room size
Clean and comfortable surroundings
Comfortable bed
Sufficient lighting (preferably natural lighting)
Wardrobe with sufficient storage space
Mirror
Heating
A desk and chair for studying
Waste bin
Regarding the household
Give students free access to the bathroom in the same way as the rest of your household. Baths or showers should be available daily
Encourage students to speak English as much as possible in the home
Encourage students to feel at home and to treat them as full members of the household rather than paying guests
Ensure that you do not host two students of the same native language at the same time, unless by special arrangement agreed with the students and the school
Provide a home environment in which it is possible for students to carry out their English studies properly

Provide clean towels

Respect students’ cultural backgrounds and to be sensitive to the particular needs of students
Know, exemplify, encourage and respect the core British values of:
democracy,
the rule of law,
individual liberty,
respectful tolerance of different faiths or beliefs.

Title: Insights and Analytics Associate
Description:
We are looking for someone to join our small, close knit team to help us understand the data we generate every day, to make better decisions faster. You will bring experience pulling insights out of multiple datasets, ideally in other healthcare businesses, and a self-motivated, proactive style. You will be responsible for analysing data for different teams in the company to enable them to make smart decisions with deep insights; proactively getting the right pieces of data for your colleagues. This will include timely reviews of different aspects of the business as well as ad-hoc analysis.
*
About Ampersand Health
We are a social purpose company, focused on improving the health and happiness of people living with long term conditions. Working alongside world-renowned researchers, clinicians and patient groups, we are developing groundbreaking digital medicines for patients with inflammatory conditions, using deep clinical insights and cutting edge behavioural science techniques.
Our apps are designed to improve patients’ mental and physical health and quality of life using courses to help address their stress management, medicine adherence, sleep quality, relationships and more; with courses for food choices and flare management in development.
We were selected by NHSX and DHSC to be part of Techforce 19, the NHS’s digital-first response to Covid 19. The company was also selected for the Digital Health 100, the NHS’s DigitalHealth.London accelerator and PWC’s Scale Health; and has won awards from Innovate UK, the Health Service Journal and Design 100.
The role
Your role will be to own the data processes, analytics and insights within the company, enabling the team to make better, data-driven decisions faster. Ampersand Health creates digital health mobile applications, so you will provide insights around the impact on patients’ health through aggregated, anonymous clinical data, as well as analysing business KPIs around conversion and engagement.
You will work in the domains of product analytics, performance analytics, business and user analytics, as well as general research analytics for specific topics relevant to the business. You will be required to understand both the business and the clinical data our patients input to provide deeper insights to the team about how patients are managing and improving their health and conditions using our technologies.
Your responsibilities will include:
Being accountable for the company’s analytics and insights; being the voice for data in the company, championing making data-driven decisions
Analysing data for different teams in the company to enable them to make smart decisions with deep insights; proactively getting the right pieces of data for your colleagues. This will include timely reviews of different aspects of the business as well as ad-hoc analysis
Combining analytical insights with data gathered from interviews and workshops to support decisions taken, supporting the team with best practices around these two data types
Using statistical methods and forecasting to find significant patterns in data to guide future decisions
Managing data processes: planning, executing and maintaining data processes for the secure storage of data and information assets. Flagging where new systems would be required, with appropriate appraisal of impact vs effort
Aggregating data across the business: compiling information from multiple data sources to prepare combined datasets for data processing
Being responsible for data quality and accuracy in our systems, checking and cleansing data
The skills we are looking for include:
You will be comfortable working in Google Sheets, Docs and Slides
Experience writing SQL queries, and tech literate - comfortable asking questions where you don’t have the skills to understand a problem
Working in large data sets, running statistical analyses and pulling insights from data
Creating documents and presentations to share information with the wider team and other stakeholders
[bonus] we use tools such as Adjust, Google Analytics, Firebase, RevenueCat and have our own data held in AWS; the ability to join these systems up (and others as we add them) through coded or integration services would be very valuable
[bonus] you have experience in predictive analytics and can bring your understanding of that field to further boost our insights
You will be:
A team player: no job is too small for you, you understand that your role goes beyond the job description in a small growing startup with big ambitions
Fast learner: able to pick up new concepts quickly, eager to learn
Self-motivated: strong work ethic, comfortable being accountable for complex tasks and delivering quality work to tight deadlines
Organised: able to plan, structure and communicate to deliver discrete projects and keep on top of your workload independently
Able to work independently, comfortable in large datasets, but switch easily to consulting with the teams to understand their requirements and educate them about the data they have available
You will have:
Spent the last 1-4 years working in a data heavy role within a startup, corporate or professional services firm. Ideally, you will have worked in a small-team environment and understand the nature of fast growing companies, where everyone pitches in
Worked in a healthcare setting as a data informatician, providing insights on healthcare data to clinicians
[bonus] worked in a startup that has raised venture financing
Studied a numerate degree at a top university
If you don’t fit these criteria, please make sure you cover why you think you are the right candidate for the role in your covering letter
Note: we are open to this being a full or part time role.
Why Ampersand Health?
We are a young, dynamic startup in the digital health space, with a team who are all-in on our purpose. You’ll be joining a team of motivated people working on a mission to improve patients’ health. We’re a sociable, easy-going bunch, who support each other through the challenges of our work. As a small company, you’ll get to know all your colleagues well. In addition, we offer:

Title: Associate Data Engineer
Description:
Just Eat is searching for an Associate Data Engineer to join the Data Systems team. You’ll have the opportunity to work with big data technologies, building scalable and reliable solutions to support real-time analytics, advanced data science and critical operational projects powered by data.
What We Do
The Data Systems team’s role is to build a transformational data platform in order to democratise data in Just Eat. Our team is built on the following ideals:
Open Data: We ingest all data produced across Just Eat using batch and realtime pipelines and make it available to every employee in Just Eat. This data is then used to drive analytics, business intelligence, data science and critical business operations.
Self Service: We build tools, frameworks and processes to support self-service modelling and activation of data. Our goal is to empower our users to find, process and consume our data without barriers.
Single Truth: We build services that host all metadata about Just Eat’s data in a single store and promote governance, data culture and Single Source of Truth.
Intelligent Personalisation: We build and maintain a machine learning platform which supports data scientists in developing and deploying ML models at production scale. This allows us to deliver insights, personalisation and predictions to our customers at scale.
How We Do It
Our team is built on the following tenets:
Innovate: We are always learning, growing, inquisitive and keen on new technologies and open source tooling. We love like-minded engineers with a passion to keep our code-base and infrastructure best in class.
Build for Scale: All our tools and components are built for scale and we use Kubernetes and other tools to help us scale automatically.
Cloud based: We use serverless technologies where possible to simplify our estate, technologies like BigQuery, PubSub, Dataflow and Cloud functions allow us to move quickly. In addition, we run a Kubernetes cluster on GKE with many workloads including instances of Apache Airflow.
DevOps culture: Everyone in the team contributes to infrastructure, we have a CI/CD pipeline and we define our infrastructure as code. Our stack includes terraform, jenkins and Helm. Teams monitor their applications using prometheus, grafana and alert manager.
Collaboration & Ownership: All code is owned by the team and we have multiple avenues for collaboration - rotation, pairing and technical showcases. We highly encourage teams to own their own work and promote self-governance.
We’re looking for enthusiastic engineers to join our Core Systems team within Data Systems
Core Systems
Our team’s mission is to build base functionalities that power a leading data platform. Our portfolio includes a variety of highly critical tools including (but not limited to) Real-time Ingestion, GDPR, Metadata Catalogues, and Access Controls. Here are snippets of some of our portfolio
Real-time Ingestion - A generic data ingestion pipeline currently running up to 10k events per second from 2.5k topics.
Metadata Catalogues - Infer and store context around data (about 1 PB in 500 datasets) and keep it secure and searchable.
Our stack is primarily Scala using libraries like ZIO, Cats, Akka streams and Apache beam. Python is also used in lot’s of areas.
Senior engineers at Core Data Systems are enthusiastic about mentoring early talents; you would get to learn, grow and contribute to the team’s success.
Required skills and experience
You should apply if
You love writing well tested, readable and performant code, capable of processing large volumes of data. You have interest in functional programming (Scala) and Python. You are proficient in either language.
You love working with Cloud technologies. We use Google Cloud with a mix of services - Kubernetes, Dataflow, PubSub etc. Experience is a plus.
You have the inclination to collaborate and ability to communicate technical ideas clearly.
You have a basic understanding of product development lifecycle, from coding to deployments, to monitoring, alerting etc... Our teams maintain all aspects of our product lifecycle, but we don’t expect everyone to be an expert in all of it.
You understand the fundamentals of computing and distributed systems.
Why work at Just Eat?
Just Eat Takeaway.com is a leading global online food delivery marketplace headquartered in Amsterdam and listed on the London Stock Exchange.
We've built our business on having the widest choice available on our platform – connecting millions of customers with over 155,000 restaurants across 23 countries - with over 100 different cuisines from local independents to globally famous restaurants, available to order via our app and website.
We provide the platform and tools to help independent restaurants move online and reach a significantly broader customer base – to generate increased orders and grow their businesses. We also provide the insights, advice, and support our growing community needs to satisfy customers and help raise standards across a vibrant takeaway sector.
We’re built to deliver behind the scenes too. To make Just Eat the great company it is, it takes a great team of people. Which is why all of our colleagues are welcomed into a diverse and inclusive workplace where they feel they can belong. We're passionate about nurturing our people and offer a full programme of training and support to our employees – helping them to develop their careers in a way that suits them.
No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, where you are from, religious beliefs or takeaway preferences you could find your place at Just Eat. We’re a diverse and inclusive workplace that promotes a sense of belonging, allowing all of our people to bring their most colourful and complex selves to work every day.

Decades of data underpins our business. As a shared service function, the analytics department plays a crucial role ensuring our stakeholders needs are being met – be that for commercial divisions, finance, product, marketing or operations. The current main outputs are; enabling self-service reporting and analysis, creating new or ad hoc reports and dashboards, retrospective analysis and automation of it, as well as forecasting.
The team has successfully set up our data warehouse but there are many improvement-based projects to complete such as; refining existing reports, bringing in new data sources to the warehouse and extracting new insights.
Reporting to the Head of Engineering, we are looking for a savvy Data Engineer to join our Business Intelligence and Data team. The hire will be responsible for expanding and optimizing our data warehouse and data pipeline architecture, as well as optimizing data flow and collection. The ideal candidate is an experienced data pipeline builder and data wrangler who enjoys optimizing data systems and building them from the ground up. The Data Engineer will support our data initiatives and will ensure optimal data delivery architecture is consistent throughout ongoing projects. They must be self-directed and comfortable supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems and products. The right candidate will be excited by the prospect of optimizing and expanding our company’s data architecture to the pave way for advanced analytics, such as the introduction of Data Lakes.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture,
Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional / non-functional business requirements.
Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, etc.
Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and AWS ‘big data’
Build analytics tools that utilize the data pipeline to provide actionable insights into customer acquisition, operational efficiency and other key business performance metrics.
Work with stakeholders including the Executive, Product, Data and Design teams to assist with data-related technical issues and support their data infrastructure needs.
Work with data and analytics experts to strive for greater functionality in our data systems.
Support the engineering leadership team in defining the technology roadmap to underpin advanced analytics and data science.
KEY SKILLS/EXPERIENCES
Advanced working SQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases, query authoring (SQL) as well as working familiarity with a variety of databases.
Experience building and optimizing data pipelines, architectures and data sets.
Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
Strong analytic skills related to working with unstructured datasets.
Build processes supporting data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency and workload management.
A successful history of manipulating, processing and extracting value from large disconnected datasets.
Working knowledge of message queuing, stream processing, and highly scalable data stores.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
We are looking for a candidate with 5+ years of experience in a Data Engineer role, who has attained a Graduate degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems or another quantitative field.
You should also have experience using the following software/tools:
Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Analysis Services, PowerBi, and DAX.
Experience with relational SQL and NoSQL databases.
Experience with MS SQL Server and Transact-SQL.
Experience with Google Analytics.
Experience with AWS/Azure cloud services.
Experience with Python, R and C# would be advantageous.
Knowledge and experience of architectures to support advanced analytics and data science would be advantageous.

Title: Commercial Co-ordinator
Description:
Tech Nation is the growth platform for tech companies and leaders. We fuel the growth of game-changing founders, leaders and scaling companies so they can positively transform societies and economies, by providing them with the coaching, content and community they need for their journey in designing the future.
We bring together a network of purposeful founders, leaders and philanthropists, progressive enterprises and policymakers, influential funds and institutions so we can collaborate in building the technological innovation that will improve the future for the UK and beyond.
We provide learning and content, insights and analysis, coaching and research. We’re laser focused on delivering powerful outcomes and impact, because collectively we want to create a world in which anyone with vision and drive can access the skills and support needed to scale and succeed as a game-changing leader. #WeAreTechNation. We fuel growth.
Our company values:
Deliver impact that lasts
Collaborate to innovate
Inform to inspire
Be all in
About the role
We are looking for an efficient, effective, proactive and collaborative Commercial Coordinator, who demonstrates great attention to detail and loves getting stuck into data and answering questions with that data.
As Tech Nation scales and realises its commercial ambitions as an organisation, you will keep the Commercial team organised and hold us to account. As the point person for efficiency in the Commercial team, your role will be to keep us on deadline and honest about our progress against agreed targets/outcomes.
Some of your regular tasks will be ensuring we are sticking to our team processes - ie producing the work we said we would on time, attending the right meetings with our proposals/decks, having signed contracts stored correctly.
You will also be responsible for the management of our Commercial Director’s diary, running team meetings, off-site agendas, tracking against actions, and you will manage project delivery closely.
Confident with data, you will be responsible for tracking and reporting as well as working with Finance to ensure invoices have been sent, and that they have been paid. Being close to the data on all metrics we track will enable you to raise risks and issues to the wider team.
You will manage and analyse our Hubspot CRM data, ensuring there are no data errors plus spotting and interrogating anomalies. You will track progress and compile and pull regular reports, ensuring we are using them for decision making.
You will also be responsible for managing the data for our Exec Commercial Reporting Pack. You will ensure our fortnightly document - the most important document our team produces - is updated to show accurate and relevant information and is submitted in a timely way.
This will involve pulling sales and account management reports and documenting commercial activity and outcomes, eg how we are tracking against revenue target and how likely our pipeline is to convert to sale, as well as other metrics we track.
In terms of efficiency-driving, you will identify cross-organisational processes that can be automated, and create team processes that enable effective and collaborative ways of working and that deliver the best result for our private sector customers.
You will need to be responsive to the team’s needs as well as owning complete projects yourself.
You will have stand out skills when it comes to making connections with the wider team and external contacts, and you will have a passion for everything tech.
You will also have the opportunity to learn about client relationships. Our AM team will mentor you to grow your client-facing skills set in terms of account management and also sales targeting and outreach. You may also support the senior members of the Commercial team with bid writing.

A Day in the Life of a Commercial Co-ordinator might look something like this:
Tracking and analysing our team performance against key metrics
Ensure best practice Ways of Working are adopted and that we are following agreed team processes
Setting agenda for the fortnightly team meeting, running it, noting actions and tracking against them
As well as sharing our ambitions and values you will have:
Knowledge of all the hidden tips and tricks of the Google product suite, plus Excel and be a super-user of CRM systems
A proactive self-starter, you are determined to succeed and use your initiative to solve problems
Meticulous in all work produced you also have an eye on the big picture
Personable and collaborative - good connector and true networker - you will know exactly who to go to for what you need, and you will always look to support others too
Data analytics, you will be able to make practical financial judgements and show the rationale behind recommendations by analysing the right set of data
Where to from here?
We welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences. Our team includes women, men, mothers, fathers, the self-taught, the university-educated, and people of a wide variety of nationalities, ages, and socio-economic backgrounds.
Obviously, we’re looking to ensure it’s a solid fit from both sides: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day.
We know that diverse teams are strong teams, and welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply to life at Tech Nation. We are committed to a fair and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. We would be happy to meet any accommodation requests during the application or interview process, please just let us know.
