Strategy, Analytics and M&A
How do you make intelligent, future-proof decisions in a world where change is the one constant? That’s exactly what you’ll help our clients to do. You’ll build trusted relationships with business stakeholders – and use the most exciting new technologies available – to create data-driven programmes that transform their organisations. Your advice will help clients position their organisations to succeed in an ever-evolving marketplace.

Your role
As a practitioner in Data & Analytics Modernisation, you are responsible for delivering Data On AWS Cloud projects. You are encouraged to devise innovative solutions to help our clients address their biggest data challenges including developing modern analytics platforms. Typical projects could include, developing an AWS streaming data ingestion pipeline, developing Scala application, engineering and optimising machine learning models, designing physical data models on object, NoSQL and RDBMS stores, or re-engineering / re-platforming an existing solution.

In your role, you will have responsibility for deliverables and client stakeholder relationships and will be delivering solutions for our clients using agile methodologies. You will often be working in multi-disciplinary teams across a range of industries, subject matters and locations.

Our projects vary greatly and your responsibility as a Consultant will differ based on the focus of the client engagement and your skillset, but could include and may require you to:
Work directly with client stakeholders, as a part of a team, to assess the as-is Information Delivery solution and suggest an efficient to-be solution based in AWS IaaS, PaaS and Serverless components
Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
Investigate and understand trends in open source data technology development, such as Apache projects and the work of leading tech companies such as Facebook and Netflix
Assist in the development of our market leading analytics and information management offerings, help produce proposal documents to showcase our capabilities, and contribute to the development of our thriving Information Delivery and Information Management community
Contribute to client project delivery and ensure commercially successful conclusion of the client engagements.
You may be involved in:
Designing, architecting and implementing components of end–to-end next generation data solutions for our clients for their data and analytics needs.
Contributing to the solution architecture of an operational information delivery or analytics solution
Contributing to the designing of an enterprise data lake to cater to a client’s data storage needs for structured and unstructured data, to enable analytics across global clients
Developing components of a real-time data solution using streaming ingestion and deliver real time analytics, to help our clients respond to customer behaviour as it happens
Developing components of a cloud based Information Delivery platform which allows our clients’ apps to talk to each other, enabling real-time insight from the movement of data between their technology components
Assisting our clients to modernize their data warehouse to achieve scalable analytics
Cleansing and transformation of data using AWS EMR analytics platform.
Your work, your choice
At Deloitte we believe the best impact is the value we add, not the hours we sit at our desk. We carefully consider agile ways of working, both formal and informal, that allow for the best impact for our people and our clients. Please speak to your recruiter about the working pattern that works best for you.

Location:
Your home office will be London, but this client-facing role provides lots of opportunity for travel in the UK and overseas.

Work pattern:
This is a permanent contract opportunity. Our team members work a variety of agile working patterns. Tell us what arrangement works for you and we’ll try to accommodate.

Your professional experience
Must have Scala, C++ or Java development experience deploying workload to production
Must have either one of the following:
AWS Associate Solution Architect, or
AWS Big Data Specialty, or
Similar certification
Ability to demonstrate stakeholder management skills and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
Candidates must have experience in AWS Data Platforms involving some or all of the following areas:
Architecting, designing and implementing a data warehouse on AWS using AWS Redshift, AWS DMS, AWS Kinesis, AWS EMR, AWS SecretManager and other AWS Services.
Designing, orchestrating and implementing highly performant, scalable and re-usable data ingestion and transformation pipelines across AWS components and services.
Designing and implementing Event based and streaming data ingestion and processing using AWS PaaS services.
Data ingestion, data engineering and/or data curation using native AWS services or tools available in AWS Marketplace.
Designing and implementing data governance, data cataloguing and data lineage solutions using tools such as AWS Glue Data Catalog, Informatica Data Catalog, Talend Data Catalog, IBM Information Governance Catalog.
Developing physical data models in MongoDB, Cassandra, SQL DWH, CosmosDB, …etc.
Developing GraphQL end-points/APIs
Have worked in agile delivery teams with DevOps ways of working to continuously deliver iterative deployments with experience in using Jira, Git Repositories, Confluence, or similar
Have had experience in data migration activities in the past including migration strategy and approach, source and target system discovery, analysis, mapping, development and reconciliation
Your service line: Consulting
Our people and the way we work are the two things that set us apart in the consulting universe. For us, collaboration is fundamental to success, along with an unrivalled depth and breadth of expertise. We work closely with our clients and each other, at every stage of every project, solving our clients’ trickiest problems with a mix of knowledge, creativity and intellectual rigour. A hugely diverse range of clients rely on us to deliver the kind of change that adds genuine, lasting value to their business.
Personal independence
Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints. This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm. The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process.
About Deloitte

Our Purpose & Strategy
To make an impact that matters for our clients, our people and society - defines who we are and what we stand for. Our purpose provides the foundation for our strategy and our aspiration to be the undisputed leader in professional services: this is not about size, it's about being the first choice. The first choice for the largest and most influential clients, and the first choice for the best talent.
What do we do?
Deloitte offers global integrated professional services that include Audit & Assurance, Consulting, Financial Advisory, Legal, Risk Advisory and Tax Consulting. Our approach combines intellectual leadership, industrial expertise, insight, consulting & problem solving capabilities whatever the role, technology revolutions and innovation from multiple disciplines to help our clients excel anywhere in the world.
Beyond the UK: Deloitte North and South Europe
The UK is part of Deloitte North and South Europe (NSE), the second largest member firm in the Deloitte network. Deloitte NSE combines operations in Belgium, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Malta, the Netherlands, the Nordics (Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden), Switzerland and the UK. Deloitte NSE brings together 2,500 partners and over 40,000 people, combining our unmatched breadth and depth of capabilities in audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, and tax and legal across the region. Being part of Deloitte NSE supports our aspiration to be the undisputed leader in professional services and will create more opportunity and growth for our people.
What do we value?
What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for maximum impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.
Being a Leader at Deloitte
Cultural fit and purpose-led leadership is crucial for Deloitte. Our leaders always set the example and inspire their colleagues. They make quality time for people and take an interest in them. They know what matters to people - both inside and outside work – and value them as individuals; always finding opportunities to develop them while showing respect and appreciation.
We expect colleagues at all levels to embrace and live our purpose and our leadership culture by challenging themselves to identify issues that are most important for our clients, our people, and for society and make an impact that matters. We know leadership comes in all shapes and sizes, but our Leadership Charter helps all of our people understand what we’re looking for:
We live our purpose: we act as a role model, embracing and living our purpose and values, and recognising others for the impact they makeWe develop talent: we develop high-performing people and teams through challenging and meaningful opportunitiesWe drive performance: we deliver exceptional client service; maximise results and drive high performance from people while fostering collaboration across businesses and bordersWe believe positive influence can make an impact that matters: we influence clients, teams, and individuals positively, leading by example and establishing confident relationships with increasingly senior peopleWe move, together, towards a strategic direction: we understand key objectives for clients and Deloitte, aligning people to objectives and setting priorities and direction.

Acquisition strategies, to improve our funnel and costs to acquire
The key levers to drive up customer love, retention and referral
Create dashboards and tooling that drives testing and iteration across our organisation
Build our growth and attribution infrastructure, from 3rd party attribution tooling to bringing in new channels and partnerships over time

React & React Native
Redux Sagas
Styled Components
Typescript
Jest
Python
Ruby on Rails with AWS Aurora Postgres & Redis
Minitest
Sidekiq
Heroku
Github
CircleCI for automated testing & native builds/deploys (Using Fastlane)

Java 8+

Docker
Kubernetes
MySQL

Message oriented middleware,
Multithreaded programming,

Big Data,

Title: Product Engineer
Description:
Number of vacancies: 1
Preference for Location: London, UK

About Pangaea Data Limited
Pangaea Data Limited provides a machine learning based software product to its customers from the biopharmaceutical and healthcare industry for faster identification of patient cohorts based on phenotypes (clinical characteristics and symptoms) from electronic health records (EHRs) and unstructured doctors’ notes. This is critical for detecting patients at risk of diseases, finding genes linked to a phenotype in the context of drug or biomarker discovery, recruiting patients for clinical trials, conducting real world evidence (RWE) studies and matching the right patients with the right drugs. The company's product has demonstrated that its able to find the right patient cohorts at 50x speed and 30% higher accuracy when compared to alternative methodologies such as rule based natural language processing (NLP), keyword extraction and manual means.

The company is headquartered in London and was founded by serial entrepreneurs who have raised more than £130 million through their work and is advised by leading experts from industry, Imperial College London and Stanford University. Pangaea's investors include a UK based Deep Tech fund and renowned angels who founded several UK and US headquartered unicorns. Pangaea has access to 90 million patient electronic health records through its partnerships with hospitals and other such providers from the US, UK, Europe, South America and Asia Pacific.
Role Description and Responsibilities
Pangaea is looking for a technical expert to join its founding team to lead and define the company’s product engineering department.

This is a broad role, which will shape as the business grows, but in the short term it will involve leading the technical development of the software product.

Key technical responsibilities will include:
Take the lead in product and feature design, representing the needs of the user and other stakeholders.
Identify suitable candidates to build the engineering team.
To adopt an approach which maximises the value to the user, while minimising technical complexity.
Prioritise tickets in bi-weekly sprint planning sessions to make sure we are regularly delivering small improvements, rather than only focusing on big feature releases.
Monitor the impact of new features and releases, to determine if they achieved the goals set out for them at the start.
Develop User Experience (UX) strategies for regular monitoring and collecting user feedback.
Formulate hypotheses regarding the UX of the product which we can answer with user feedback and testing.

This role will also involve working closely with internal teams (sales and marketing, support, business) to:
Understand the users they engage with and the problems, pain points and requests they are seeing.
Clearly communicate our roadmap and product changes in advance of their launch.
Run early rounds of internal feedback gathering, before we launch to users.
Understand how our internal tooling can be improved for internal users.
Understand the high level company vision and goals, and make sure these are reflected in ongoing product development.

As a product engineer, you would have been involved in leadership, product decisions and coordination between teams that went into the above process.

Mandatory Requirements
Personal traits:
A strong intuition for what makes products a joy to use.
Empathy for how different users will need different things out of a product at different stages, and how to effectively serve these different needs in one product.
Strong communication and mediation skills.
A strong software engineering background with machine learning expertise to understand how the user facing product will tie into backend and architectural decisions.

Technical skills:
Have a minimum of 2–3 years of relevant experience.
Ambitious new graduates are welcome to apply.
Technical degree is desirable.
Applied technical knowledge is preferable.

Perks and Benefits
Remote and flexible working.
Salary depending on experience.
You would join a small, dedicated and growing team.
You will have the opportunity to learn about building a startup business from experienced professionals and serial entrepreneurs.
We are currently supported by serial entrepreneurs and angel investors. You will have the opportunity to experience an investment life cycle for a startup and meet leading venture capitalists.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Application Contact Information
Please send your latest resume along with a cover letter to careers@pangaeadata.ai.

General Information
Pangaea Data’s headquarters is in London (UK) with teams in San Francisco (US) and Hong Kong. For more information please visit www.pangaeadata.ai.

Pangaea Data is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

Title: Staff Software Engineer, Reliability
Description:
Coinbase has built the world's leading compliant cryptocurrency platform serving over 30 million accounts in more than 100 countries. With multiple successful products, and our vocal advocacy for blockchain technology, we have played a major part in mainstream awareness and adoption of cryptocurrency. We are proud to offer an entire suite of products that are helping build the cryptoeconomy, and increase economic freedom around the world.
There are a few things we look for across all hires we make at Coinbase, regardless of role or team. First, we assess whether a candidate demonstrates our values: Clear Communication, Positive Energy, Efficient Execution, and Continuous Learning. Second, we look for signals that a candidate will thrive in a culture like ours, where we default to trust, embrace feedback, disrupt ourselves, and expect sustained high performance because we play as a championship team. Finally, we seek people with the desire and capacity to build and share expertise in the frontier technologies of crypto and blockchain, in whatever way is most relevant to their role.
Read more about our values and culture here.
The Reliability Engineering team helps realize that vision by supporting Coinbase engineering teams to build software that is world-class in terms of its reliability. As a core service team, the Coinbase Reliability Engineers work closely with the rest of engineering. We actively seek out and gather the state-of-the-art, best practices from the industry at large. Through education and advocacy, we seek to ensure that reliability is a core value of our engineering culture. We level up other engineers by sharing deep knowledge, performing proactive analysis and improving processes, tools, and automation. Ultimately, Reliability Engineering succeeds when all engineering teams are able to build reliable software on their own.
We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to balance the role of an individual contributor while also anchoring new projects, leading technical direction and mentoring other engineers on the team. We highly value individuals with intellectual curiosity and openness. We collaborate across the organization, helping our engineers think big and take risks while building a culture of diversity, positive energy and blameless truth-seeking. Blog Posts: Reliability Engineering at Coinbase, gRPC to AWS Lambda: Is it Possible?
Scale & Integrations: 5 Million Users, 33 Countries, NYSE Integrations
Transparency: Public Post-Mortems, Open Sourcing Our Infrastructure
What you’ll be doing:
Design and implement foundational infrastructure components used by every engineering team in production (e.g. dynamic configuration, secrets storage, container orchestration, etc).
Pro-actively find and analyze reliability problems across our business units and stack, then design and implement software to create step-function improvements.
Build automation and improve systems to eliminate toil and operations work.
Educate, mentor and hold accountable the engineering team to improve the reliability of our systems and make reliability a core value of the Coinbase engineering culture.
Work closely with product engineering teams in improving observability to identify and measure SLIs and corresponding SLOs.
Projects you could work on:
Developing extremely high performance and reliable dynamic configuration systems supporting a service oriented architecture.
Improving observability of shared services frameworks used across the entire company.
Automate the incident response process to eliminate troil and improve communication.
Embed with customers to solve totally new problems in operating crypto, fiat and trading systems at scale.
What we look for in you:
At least 7+ years software engineering experience in industry.
Experience working with containers and container orchestration systems (Docker, ECS, EKS, etc).
Understanding of data structures & algorithms especially as they pertain to performance and reliability.
Ability to debug complex systems and evolve a running environment while maximizing availability.
Fluent in at least one programming language such as Golang, Ruby, or Python.
Knowledge of UNIX/Linux system internals such as system calls, TCP/IP and debugging tools.
Nice to haves:
Exposure to both NoSQL and SQL database technologies such as DynamoDB, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, AWS Aurora.
Fluent in Golang.
Experience with observability and monitoring systems such as Kibana, Datadog, etc.

Title: Python Developer
Description:
Our Mission
Bud's mission is to make the money part of people's lives simpler. The products we’re building are designed to place the power of personal data back into the hands of normal people, making finances easier to manage for everyone
What's the opportunity at Bud?
You'll be joining a team of Python developers who are primarily Data Focused (Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and Data Analysts)
We split our time currently between working on data projects and building out our Python services and processes for massive scale. You’ll own the latter, building the APIs that serve our ML models, working on queue consumers for our training data pipelines and building out web apps like our labelling tool. If you’re a developer with an interest in data or ML engineering then this is probably a great role for you.
We need someone who is a straight up Python Developer with experience building APIs ( Starlette, Flask, etc) and would be great if you have experience in OLTP style application building (Django, Dash etc).
Our tech is deployed through Kubernetes as Docker Containers so some knowledge of containerisation is highly desirable. You'll have the ability to tweak how our services are deployed so being able to reason about these decisions is important
We need someone who can help in scaling, monitoring performance of our services and making them easy to dev and deploy
Our wider engineering org primarily writes in Go. If you know it, or are keen to learn, there is plenty of opportunity to work on Go services as well.
What skills do we need?
We have people internally who are great at Python so you'll be in good company. But we need someone who can design and build APIs and services from the ground up.
The ability to work well in a cross-team collaborative environment.
Experience with ASGI frameworks like Starlette, with async python stack such as (uvloop, aiohttp, etc) and a good knowledge of concurrency in python in general.
A commitment to code quality and correctness.
Ability to write code to suit the problem. Sometimes high-level abstractions and extensibility are needed, other times we need code to solve a specific problem right now. The ability to work in both contexts is highly valued
A deep understanding of Python concepts including OOP and Functional programming paradigms
A good understanding of common Data Structures and their pros and cons
A good understanding of distributed systems / horizontal scalability
What knocks our socks off?
(These are different flavours of magicalness, we don’t expect them all!)
You have a bit of experience working with the Python data stack ( like numpy and pandas) is a plus.
You (actually) know C++ or are seasoned in cython and pybind11.
You’re fluent in both Python and Go.
You’re super experienced in working with distributed systems of scale, making use of tools like gRPC, RabbitMQ, etc.
What's in it for me?
If you love using technology to solve problems; we are working on some of the best new tech including Kubernetes, Docker, Pytorch, Tensorflow, Apache Beam as well as some interesting problems such as scaling to millions of transactions per-day, anonymisation of data, microservice architecture to list a few.
If you want to help improve the way financial services work for people; we strive to improve the lives of everyone through the way they interact with financial institutions and services.
If you want to grow with a company and help build it as it scales to millions of users globally; we're a tight-knit team that has ambition to grow and prove our tech in some massive scale markets. We have a lot of unsolved challenges and need people to help get us to the next phase
Engineering at Bud
The software engineering team are tasked with solving highly technical problems to enable solutions that tangibly benefit the lives of millions of people. From how to scale our solutions to tens of millions of users in the most effective manner of integrating hundreds of third-party businesses. Data is key to our business and we need passionate developers to help capture it, store it, transform it, research and most importantly secure it.
What is it like to work for Bud?
We could play buzzword bingo but one of our core values is 'Authentic' and the best way to demonstrate this is by sharing our employee engagement dashboard. This provides a weekly engagement and NPS score giving you a true reflection of life at Bud. All data collected is realtime & anonymised so we have no control over what you see.
The dashboard is interactive so check it out here and have a look at what the numbers mean, https://bit.ly/2MhjAZT
What are the perks?
25 days holiday! You can carry up to 5 over the following year if you wish
️Health and Wellbeing Allowance! We have a monthly allowance of £50 for all employees to use towards wellbeing activities such as classes or a gym membership.
‍‍Flexible working! We encourage autonomy here at Bud. We trust you to work in a way that will enable you to deliver your best work. Bud supports flexible working; we want you to perform at your best and recognise that other issues will arise from time to time.
We match up to 5% of your salary in our pension plan.
You’ll be provided with a brand new MacBook or PC, and any computer accessories you need so you’ll have the best tools for the job!
Season Ticket loan
The biggest motivation for people is learning and developing, our people have up to £500 per annum of learning and development opportunities funded by Bud.
️‍ ️We’re big on keeping Bud a social team, so Christmas and Summer parties can be a big deal. We also put on events and have a social committee organising things from 5-a-side football, gaming comps and after-work meet-ups!
A bit more about us
We’re a diverse group of people. With backgrounds ranging from data science to music production, more than 80% of our team come from outside the world of finance – providing us with a unique perspective as we help consumers feel more in control of their lives. For us, an interest in people comes first; finance follows.
More about what we're doing
The apps and infrastructure we’re building are designed to place the power of personal data back into the hands of normal people. Picture this: a world where your bank knew you were paying too much for your gas bill and could switch you to a more suitable provider, or understood your savings targets and could automatically find you a better deal. That’s what we’re working towards.
We believe that diversity will make us better.
Bud’s mission is to make the money part of people’s lives simple. To get there, we need a workforce that is diverse as the people we create our products for. Which means we need people who have different backgrounds and experiences, who are diverse in age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and ways of thinking. We truly believe that these differences will make us grow as a company and a team. We strive to create a workplace and culture where our people are empowered, supported, given equal opportunities and can bring their authentic selves to work.

Title: Investment Administrator - Octopus Ventures
Description:
Company Description
About Octopus Ventures
We invest in pioneers creating the next billion-pound companies in the areas of health, money and deep tech. Our core team has been together since 2008 and has grown to around forty people. Together, we run one of Europe’s largest venture funds with £1.3 billion under management.
Our typical investment starts from £1 million for Seed to around £10 million for Series B and we can follow our investment right up to £25 million. Over the years, we have supported over 100 outstanding entrepreneurs that are leading the way in disrupting their industries. Companies backed in recent years include allplants, Elvie, Depop, Big Health, graze.com, Eve, Magic Pony, Secret Escapes, Sofar Sounds, SwiftKey, Swoon Editions, tails.com and Zoopla Property Group.

We’re based in London and New York with partners placed in San Francisco, Singapore and China to help the companies we back scale in those markets. We are part of Octopus Group, managing £8.6 billion (31 Mar 2020) on behalf of more than 50,000 investors, spanning investments, healthcare, energy and property.

Job Description
The opportunity to join Octopus Ventures in London as an Investment Administrator is now available. This offers a challenging and exciting opportunity to help pioneers change the world as Octopus Ventures looks to scale its business.
An excellent, collegiate, and effective operations team is crucial to enabling Octopus Ventures to meet its objectives in the European and global VC community as one team. The successful candidate will join our existing operations team to help ensure the investment processes, governance and related obligations are executed seamlessly as we continue to grow our business, and increase the capacity and efficiency of our investment capability.
The role’s primary focus is to provide administrative support for our investment processes. Key responsibilities include:

Understanding the steps of the investment processes well and helping ensure the Ops and investment team adhere to them.
Updating our process management system and drafting, reviewing and distributing key communications for the team, Investment Committee, investors and other key external stakeholders.
Undertaking and overseeing the recording of our investments or divestments in our various systems (including in accordance with relevant FCA regulation), such as investment, asset & valuation data and investor information, and ensuring the movement of related funds runs smoothly.
Liaising with the investment leads and legal counsel throughout, using your knowledge of our processes and risk tolerances to manage workload and prioritise requests as part of a team.
Administration of relevant client or regulatory reporting following completion of an investment or divestment, including VCT or EIS fund-related matters.
Liaising with core teams across Octopus and suppliers externally to keep things running smoothly and information flowing between us seamlessly at all times.

Qualifications
What you’ll need to be successful:
An understanding of venture capital/private equity or equity investments generally, although you don’t need to have worked exactly in our part of the industry before - we welcome transferable skill sets and recognise that diverse working backgrounds make us stronger overall.
Superb administration and organisation skills, and an excellent sense of how to prioritise and manage your own workload.
The ability to get your head around complex processes and stick to them.
Be as comfortable working with databases and numbers as with communicating well both verbally and in writing.
Proactivity. Being able to spot issues before they happen or volunteering to solve them when they do is vital.
Great attention to detail, and an ability to keep this up whether it’s the first or twentieth time you’re doing something.
A passion for putting the customer at the heart of what you do, whether that customer is internal or external.
A desire to be part of a tight and ambitious team with shared values, where you will both work with others of all seniorities and be expected to own delivery of your own workload.
The courage to challenge the status quo.

And to really stand out from crowd:
Be freethinking and proactive in suggesting changes to ensure processes remain efficient, scalable and have minimal time wastage.
Be comfortable in working in a fast-paced, flexible, dynamic and entrepreneurial environment where priorities are regularly changing.
Have an interest in learning more about the companies we invest in, the industry and applying this knowledge to the role as you learn more

Additional Information
Our Values and DNA
At Octopus we don’t just focus on what we do but also how we do it. Everyone shares our values of being straightforward, helpful and bold. And while these are the principles that guide us as an organisation, our DNA goes even further, by revealing our inner strength:
We are loyal: we fully buy-in to the company’s vision and believe in everything that Octopus stands for.
We are respectful: we live and breathe the Octopus values of being helpful, straightforward and bold.
We are resilient: we have an inner strength that means we never give in.
We are intellectually curious: we seek to understand how the world works and we’re always learning, adapting and improving.
We understand who our customers are: and because we know them really well, we always give them our very best.

What we offer
Octopus has built an exciting and inclusive high-performance culture where employees feel empowered. This means we welcome discussions around flexible working hours. We also understand the value of diversity, and we have a team dedicated to promoting gender, ethnic, socio-economic, LGBT and disability equality, to make sure we back up our words with actions.

Title: Website CMS Specialist
Description:
Website CMS Specialist

We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.

This is the career you’ve been waiting for your whole life. Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 58,000 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black & Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.

Who You Are
You’re a curious problem solver who has the ability to bring big ideas to life. You’re creative and scrappy but can navigate a large organization with ease. You’re agile and adaptable but work with precision to ensure we deliver top-notch customer experiences, always.

You also have:
Bachelor’s Degree in a related field is required
5+ years’ experience managing content for large scale websites, with a working knowledge of Sitecore, Drupal, or other enterprise content management systems preferred.
A thorough understanding of product data and asset management, B2B and B2C audiences, ecommerce platforms and best practices preferred.
Has a demonstrated ability to:
Work with limited supervision in the areas of website content management and organization.
Manage multiple tasks simultaneously, organize workflow, set priorities, and communicate progress.
Proactively and clearly communicate verbally and written with multiple audiences.
Consistently meet deadlines, while adhering to brand and editorial standards.
Self-motivated, positive attitude eager to learn and evolve as business needs change in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

The ideal candidate is an experienced project manager or web content administrator with proven ability in a variety of digital marketing activities and technologies. This candidate is self-motivated with strong attention to detail, an eagerness to learn new platforms, an aptitude for creating documentation and training programs, and optimize processes. S/he should have experience communicating and collaborating with a variety of audiences across departments, hierarchies, and geographies within the Global Tools & Storage organization.

Specifically, you’ll:
Leverage CMS platforms on an ongoing basis to manage and perform content updates from a variety of global stakeholders.
Own the review and approval process for all site updates and perform content publishing tasks.
Proactively identify gaps or areas of opportunity, communicate recommendations, and perform necessary actions to deliver a fresh experience for new and repeat users.
Define and prioritize website bugs and enhancements, coordinate with IT on project management efforts, and communicate development status to manage stakeholder expectations.
Produce and present quarterly website reports including performance metrics and key observations, then implement actionable recommendations on site.
Collaborate with the cross-functional teams – email, social, PR, and paid media – to ensure campaign alignment and innovation through landing page concepting and creation, content strategy and management, and ad hoc reporting with actionable observations.
Collaborate with the cross-functional team – Brand, Insights, Search, and Studio – to define overall content strategy and implement opportunities for A/B testing, personalization, and other areas of dynamic content presentation through the marketing technology stack.

Additional benefits:
Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t liner here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.
Learning & Development: Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).
Diverse & Inclusive Culture: We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.
Purpose-Driven Company: You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.

Stanley Black & Decker is one of the world's largest, fastest growing and most dynamic companies. SBD, a Fortune 200 company is a world-leading provider of tools and storage, commercial electronic security and engineered fastening systems, with unique growth platforms and a track record of sustained profitable growth.

Title: Global Investment Research, Global Macro Research, European...
Description:
MORE ABOUT THIS JOB:
GLOBAL INVESTMENT RESEARCH
From macroeconomic forecasts to individual stock analysis, our team develops tools and insights to help shape investment strategies for clients and the firm. Our analysts work on client-focused research in the equity, fixed-income, currency, and commodities markets, mining big data that enters markets around the world each day to identify game-changing insights. You’ll be part of a team that is intellectually curious, creative, analytical, and passionate about performing market research.

At Goldman Sachs, our culture is one of teamwork, innovation and meritocracy. We often say our people are our greatest asset and we take pride in supporting each colleague both professionally and personally. From collaborative work spaces and mindfulness classes to working from home and flexible work options, we offer our people the support they need to reach their goals in and outside the office.
RESPONSIBILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS:
Global Investment Research (GIR) provides investment recommendations by generating fundamental research and analysis of economies, markets, industries and companies. GIR analysts help our clients achieve superior returns by seeking to develop creative, differentiated investment insights and ideas. Title: G6 - Geospatial Commission, Head of Geospatial Data Contract...
Description:
Organisation Details

Cabinet Office supports the Prime Minister and ensures the smooth running of government - from developing policy, to modernising public services. We welcome talented people from all backgrounds with the skills and the commitment to build a career in the Civil Service.
The Cabinet Office Purpose is:

to maintain the integrity of the Union, coordinate the security of the realm and sustain a flourishing democracy;
to support the design and implementation of HM Government’s policies and the Prime Minister’s priorities; and
to ensure the delivery of the finest public services by attracting and developing the best public servants and improving the efficiency of government.

The work Cabinet Office delivers is vast and therefore presents opportunities to develop your skills and experience in a variety of critical government agendas.
An organisation of approximately 7,000 employees, the Cabinet Office is a vibrant, modern and exciting place to work, attracting a diverse workforce which represents the people we serve. Our main offices are in London, but we have staff based around the UK.
At the heart of this are our Cabinet Office values. To deliver our Purpose and help make Cabinet Office a great place to work, we all commit to:-

treating everyone with Respect
actively Collaborate, and
build Trust

We have an aspiration to become the most inclusive employer across the Civil Service. We have a number of staff benefits, including flexible working, and access to a number of staff support networks to ensure we meet this.

Business unit information

About the job

Better use of location data has the power to transform the lives of UK citizens and grow our economy. The increasing relevance of location data and technologies and the array of applications present a clear economic opportunity by transforming services across the private and public sectors and helping to deliver economic growth and increased productivity. The UK’s status as a world leader in location data presents an exciting opportunity to realise value in the applications and services it underpins.

Geospatial Commission

The Geospatial Commission is a multi-disciplinary new unit within the Cabinet Office, tasked with maximising the benefit from the location data that the UK holds. The work of the Commission stretches across a broad range of sectors and cutting-edge technologies. The potential economic value of geospatial data is huge and, with a dedicated programme budget to deliver change, the Commission is developing an ambitious national strategy for geospatial data use in the wider economy, and has a mandate to:




Provide strategic oversight of the geospatial ecosystem in the UK, setting geospatial strategy, policy and standards

Hold the budget for the public sector’s largest investment in strategically important geospatial data

Make targeted investments in data projects that accelerate innovation and the adoption of geospatial data applications

About the Contracts, Finance, and Operations Team

The Commercial, Finance and Operations team provides a solid foundation for both the public sector’s access to core geospatial data and the Commission’s sector-wide policy and implementation.




The Team provides financial support, guidance, and clearance of often novel financial cases, setting current and future budgets in line with wider team strategy, monitoring and forecasting against our c.£130m annual budget to support the development and delivery of the UK geospatial strategy.

The Team is also responsible for management of contracts of a value of circa £100m p.a. on behalf of the whole of the public sector in England and Wales, providing access to Ordnance Survey data and the setting of their public task, aerial photography and height data, and addressing data. All of which work in conjunction with one another to underpin critical public services including the emergency services and the full spectrum of local government services.

The Geospatial Commission is commissioning work in a range of areas to support the development of a wide range of public and private sector organisations which will build on sound commercial and contractual footings.


Job Description

About the role

We are looking for a strategic leader with a strong track record of programme management and delivery expertise, to develop and oversee the team that leads on implementing and managing the Geospatial Commission’s current geospatial data contracts. These currently include the new £1bn Public Sector Geospatial Agreement supplied by the Ordnance Survey, the contract with the Royal Mail for Postcode Address File data and our aerial photography data contract.

This is a pivotal and high-profile role at a critical time for the Commission as we deliver the UK’s first Geospatial Strategy and seek to embed the contracts to both realise the significant benefits and opportunities that they offer across both the public and private sector.

It will require working closely with public sector customers, relevant Partner Bodies and the wider geospatial data economy players. This is a unique opportunity to be involved in a high-profile aspect of government policy, aligning with its wider data and industrial strategies, and other key priorities where location-based data is a key component in realising both economic and social value.

Key responsibilities will include:

Setting up and managing a multi-disciplinary eight person team of contract and programme management specialists, and working across the Geospatial Commission’s wider functions to bring in its finance, policy, data, portfolio management office and analysis expertise to develop and run contract management best practice.

Leadership and oversight of the Geospatial Commission’s core public sector data contracts, including the Public Sector Geospatial Agreement, the PAF Public Sector Licence, and Aerial Photography Great Britain that will support efficient access to data for over 5000 public sector customers.

Strategic oversight of Geospatial Commission contract management best practice to ensure adherence to legal and commercial frameworks and deliver value for money for the Cabinet Office. This includes leading the team of commercial experts on establishing the process for review, monitoring and assurance of the key contractual requirements, and working across analysis and policy teams to feed back evidence supporting positive outcomes into the strategy development

Provide contractual/commercial input into policy development across the wider Geospatial Commission.

Person specification

We are looking for a talented individual with policy, programme delivery, and commercial experience, and with following skills and capabilities:



Essential

Leadership - Strong leadership qualities, with an approach to team working that prizes inclusion, values diversity, and encourages a culture of creativity and passion for the work both within and outside of the organisation.
Programme management - Experience of applying project management techniques to run high-value, large scale contracts with public and private sector delivery organisations

Influencing & communicating - ability to gain the credibility and trust of senior stakeholders, to build and maintain a wide network of public sector data users and to lead negotiations with commercial suppliers

Management: an experienced team manager who supports staff individually and collectively to continuously learn and develop, including through matrix management

Desirable

Commercial expertise - An awareness of effective delivery and management of large and complex contracts with a broad range of stakeholders and suppliers is essential. Knowledge of the government’s procurement processes, in particular relevant frameworks for data access would be beneficial in supporting the expert team.

Please note that this role requires SC clearance, which would normally require 5 years’ UK residency in the past 5 years. This is not an absolute requirement but supplementary checks may be required where individuals have not lived in the UK for the required period. This may mean that your security clearance (and therefore your appointment) will take longer or, in some cases, not be possible.
Responsibilities
Please refer to job description
Behaviours
We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:
Communicating and Influencing
Working Together
Making Effective Decisions
Seeing the Big Picture
Benefits
Learning and development tailored to your role
An environment with flexible working options
A culture encouraging inclusion and diversity
A Civil Service pension

Title: Technical Support Engineer
Description:
Network Assurance | Up to £23k p.a. | Old Street, London (but working from home for now)
At Pod Point we’re changing the way people drive. We fundamentally believe that travel shouldn’t damage the Earth so we’ve made it our mission to install a Pod Point (an Electric Vehicle charging point) everywhere you park. To make that vision a reality, we need the brightest, most tenacious and most inspiring talent in the world - we are growing faster than the market and we need to maintain that velocity - that’s where you come in!
The Role
We’re looking for an exceptional 2nd Line Support professional to join our growing team. This is a fantastic opportunity to work within a passionate team and have a big impact on the entire organisation. You will collaborate with the rest of the team to ensure that Pod Point’s network achieves the highest levels of network reliability and uptime. You will work closely with the other team members to provide solutions to our customers and clients which ensure top notch product reliability; you will report into the Technical Support Manager and will initially be based from home (at least until the risks of catching Coronavirus are reduced), but our office is based near Old Street Station in London and you’ll probably need to be able to commute there in future as and when required.

What you’ll do
Provide technical support for the Pod Point charging network, handling incoming calls that are raised as a level 2 support issue
Escalate problems and provide detailed handovers to 3rd line support when necessary
Log all information accurately and in a timely manner whilst building rapport with internal members of staff
Work closely with the Customer Support team as well as the Technical (Product) teams
Organise remote Electricians to resolve issues and assist in fault finding
Ensure tickets are properly managed, and that notes are kept up to date
Continuously participate in creating tools and processes which increase the number of issues which can be resolved by the Level 1 support team
Continuously improve and develop the efficiency of your own processes
Requirements
What you’ll need
Previous experience in a technical support role
Familiar with Google Drive, Docs and Sheets and experience working with a range of systems including a CRM system (ideally Salesforce)
A strong interest in technology, and the ability to pick up new technology quickly
Strong attention to detail
Bonus Points
Previous experience in electrical field servicing
Familiar with Salesforce
Good understanding of electronics and electrical components
A dog that you can bring into the office (once Coronavirus abates)
Passionate and knowledgeable about climate change, sustainability and/or the EV industry
And if you’re not sure whether you’re what we’re looking for - send us your CV anyway! We love to hear from people who are passionate about what we do, and we always take the view that a good cultural fit (and mission alignment) is much more important than ticking all the “qualifications, skills and experience” boxes.
Benefits
Our culture is electric
At Pod Point we like to think we are anything but conventional. We have worked hard to create a rapidly-growing, constantly innovating, flat-structured world, where each employee can see the vital contribution they are making to the company. We knew from the very beginning that a rigid, corporate environment was never going to work for us, and we have stayed true to our word - we’re anything but.
We work hard; we’re not clock-watchers but equally you may find yourself working into the evening very occasionally. In return we’ll pay you well, give you complete ownership to shape the role, give you ground-breaking projects to work on and surround you with fantastic, talented people. We also provide the following benefits:
Flexible working hours and a casual dress code
25 days holiday (plus bank holidays)
Very generous maternity and paternity leave scheme
Pension scheme
Eyecare scheme
Bike to work scheme and discounted gym membership
An extensive non-fiction library to provide a bit of inspiration
The odd Pod Point puppy to cuddle.


The socially distant elephant in the room
So, you may have noticed that the world is a little different right now. As such, there might be a few parts of this spec that appear a bit wishy-washy. We’re sorry about that and we’ll try to give as much clarity as possible as and when we have answers.
Our first priority (at all times, but especially during the COVID-19 pandemic) is to make sure we’re not unnecessarily exposing Pod Pointers to potential health risks, so for now the majority of our team is working from home and we’re not sure when it will be safe for everyone to return to the office. We are, however, continuing to look for candidates who are able to commute to the Old Street area of London when the world becomes a bit more safe. In the meantime, we’re conducting all interviews on Google Meet and are able to onboard new starters remotely.
We also realise it may seem daunting starting a new role remotely (and some people struggle with their mental health when working from home at the best of times) so we’ve put in place some extra initiatives whilst we’re in lockdown (for both “work” and “play”) to keep our culture humming.

Final things to note
Pod Point is an equal opportunities employer, although you must be legally able to work in UK, and any data you provide us will be stored and disseminated in accordance with Pod Point’s Privacy Policy.
We like to deal directly with our candidates so no agencies please!

Title: Product Designer (UX/UI) - Enterprise Tools
Description:
About the role
We are looking for a Product Designer who can see the possibility in every opportunity - from large transformational projects on big budgets to the small incremental quick wins that will provide millions of our customers, colleagues and suppliers with immediate improvements. Together with our design team you will help to create products and experiences that are compelling and easy to use. Our design challenge is vast, and we have bold plans for both innovation and expansion so it’s the perfect time to join us and help shape the future of design in Tesco.

Our multidisciplinary team is made up of design, research, content and prototyping specialists who design global enterprise products, tools and services, which thousands of our colleagues and external supplier partners use every day to communicate and do business with Tesco. You’ll collaborate with other teams within our Technology function – Product, Data Science and Engineering as well as the wider business in a fast-paced agile environment. We align around our objectives to provide customer and business value, always asking “it’s good, now how can we make it better?!”

You’ll be a smart, empathetic creative with a real passion for design and storytelling. You’ll always champion a human-centered approach to problem-solving throughout all stages of the discovery and design process and most of all have a clear vision of the future for user experience.

With genuine appetite for solving complex problems, you will have experience in research, workshop facilitation, ideation and technical implementation as well as a passion and energy for design and visual communication of your ideas. Insights and data is what drives our team and you will use it to empower your decisions to support and enhance the lives of people when coupled with a clear understanding of their evolving needs. You’re no stranger to emerging, data informed and driven technologies. You love creating easy to use, engaging, viable and feasible solutions to big problems.

You will be responsible for

Championing the user experience and working closely with Product and Engineering team to develop the right product delivering value to our customers and our business.
Define, influence, and drive the user experience vision for projects through design and development
Coordinate and conduct usability tests, stakeholder interviews and user polling to help inform and evaluate design.
Work with multidisciplinary teams across the business to Identify core customer missions, create user journeys and experiences that let our customers use our products seamlessly.
In addition, work across the company’s multi-platform sites: and support experiences developed based on responsive design principles while contributing in development of our design system.
This role will best suit an individual who embraces unique skillsets of each product team member and seeks team effort over individual achievements, is well organised, pragmatic and a lateral thinker with an inquisitive mind who is motivated to make change for the better and, most importantly, puts our customers first.

You will need

You’ll need to have demonstrated experience of:
Expertise in research, workshop facilitation, conceptual design, prototyping, detailed UI design, user testing, and implementation.
Solid understanding of web technologies and software development life cycle would be a great advantage (no coding required).
Expertise in creating quick sketches, paper prototypes and translating them to fully functional prototypes that are used throughout our design process to validate your solutions against customer needs while ensuring your solutions are technically feasible.
Agile scrum workflow
Experience with meaningful data visualizations, intuitive dashboards, business intelligence tools and the tools that allow users to make better decisions would be desirable, but not essential.
Demonstrate strong written, verbal communication and presentation skills to all levels of seniority and disciplines within the organization.
Work in partnership with Product Managers, Researchers and Engineering to align design vision and activities with our business goals.
Bachelor’s degree in Interaction Design, Computer Interaction, Behavioral Psychology or equivalent related industry experience
4+ years of design experience.

We pride ourselves on enabling an inclusive, calm, creative and fun environment and we can’t wait for you to join our team!

About us
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone is welcome and truly feels able to be themselves. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings to enable us to serve our shoppers a little better every day. We strive to create a workforce that reflects our customers not only here in the UK, but worldwide. Our aim is to attract and welcome a diverse range applicants from all walks of life, offering many varying working patterns across our business, and we would love to hear from you!

What’s in it for you
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren’t limited to:

Annual bonus scheme where you can earn up to 3.5% of base salary
Holiday starting at 20 days plus a personal day rising to 22 days after 12 months (plus 8 Bank holidays)
On-site state of the art gym at our Welwyn Campus with discounted “Gympass” membership & free health checks via Nuffield Health
Retirement savings plan - save between 4% and 7.5% and Tesco will match your contribution
Life Assurance - 5 x contractual pay
Share Schemes – Join our ‘Buy As You Earn’ & ‘Save As You Earn’ share schemes after 3 months service
Colleague Clubcard (including a 2nd card for a family member) after 3 months service

Colleague Discounts:
10% increasing to 15% after every pay day for a four day period, off most purchases at Tesco (from April 2020)
10% off One Stop
10% off pay monthly & SIM only deals with Tesco Mobile
20% off all F&F purchases
20% off car, pet and home insurance at Tesco bank. T&C’s apply
25% off Tesco Café
50% off complete glasses purchases & free eye tests (other offers available) at Vision Express
50% off health checks at Tesco Pharmacy

An exclusive deals and discounts website saving you money on everyday purchases, treats for the family, eating out and utility bills for the home
Cycle to work scheme
Shuttle Bus Service to/from Hatfield & Welwyn Garden City Station to Welwyn Campus & Hatfield Offices
Opportunities to get on - take advantage of our ongoing learning opportunities and award-winning training, to help you achieve the job and career you want
Our Employee Assistance Programme helps you deal with life’s challenges
Financial wellness - Tesco has partnered with experts to help you make the most of your money
Get involved in a range of fundraising activities with our long-term charity partners

Title: Product Manager, Search

Refinitiv Workspace is more than just a way to access an extraordinary range of data and market-leading Reuters news. Powerful apps help you understand the markets and make crucial decisions, and you can connect to the world’s largest verified directory of financial professionals - over 300,000 trusted contacts collaborating, sharing, and gaining vital insights. The scope and usage of the system extends into many Refinitiv products beyond the desktop. At the heart are search engines tuned and specialised to cater for the demands of our customers and the complexities of the financial markets.
We need a hardworking product manager to join our team and take ownership for the powerful and exciting search capability that we are constantly developing and diversifying.
Key Responsibilities:
Requirements definition and analysis for all content and feature additions and enhancements to the core search service, the search apps and the APIs
Monitor and improve search precision and recall. Investigate where relevancy is poor and identify solutions, including areas where content improvements are needed
Own the relevancy and ranking rules and algorithms, query boosts, linguistics tools and synonym definitions used in the system
Analyse usage statistics and helpdesk logs to identify common customer issues and opportunities to improve the search service
Act as the key product team contact for search content issues and queries and be the main liaison with content organisation

Educated to degree level either in a technical or business-focused discipline
A good understanding of information retrieval, search engines and relevancy
Knowledge of SQL, database and search query tools, big data, web services/API design, JSON, XML
Thorough experience with agile methodologies
A good understanding of the financial markets and market data
The ability to communicate confidently with technologists, content specialists and business people.
An understanding of the role that search plays in online product interactions.
Desired Skills:
Strong analytical skills
While we do not expect you to be a coder, you will need to be familiar with json, xml, database and search query tools, ETL tools, API definitions and other technologies
Some experience or exposure to data modelling would be an advantage

Title: Geo Strategy Manager

Geo Strategy Manager

Job Description
Expedia Group, worldwide leader in online travel, is looking for a Strategy Manager for its Local Markets team, reporting into the Director of Geo Strategy. You will be based in London.
We at Expedia have unusual core values: we believe in the Scientific Method, we are open and low ego, we celebrate diversity, and organize for speed. The Local Markets team is part of the Expedia Group Retail team. We are the voice of the Expedia customers wherever they are from into the Expedia Group. We champion our customers locally, on a global scale, and help shape the company’s investment and product priorities to ensure we serve their needs.
This is an exciting opportunity for a creative leader in driving growth and scale at Expedia.
Are you a driven strategist with a passion for bringing the world within reach?
What you’ll do:
You are a leader within the Local Markets team, providing structure and coordinating efforts across different regional teams.
Communicate Geo strategy and performance updates to the rest of the organization.
Engage with senior leaders across the organization to ensure the right organizational focus across the relevant markets.
You are a key driver of the Geo prioritization process for Retail, and ensure alignment with brand leaders and the Retail Strategy team to embed in business execution, by:
Enhancing and maintaining the Geo prioritization framework, including a fact-based model that supports decisions.
Providing guidance on targets to align with the Geo prioritization framework.
Drive strategic projects with teams across the globe and act as the strategy lead or program manager on strategic work-streams key to unlock growth in regional markets.
Manage the annual country planning process with the regional leaders and inform the development of a reporting scorecard to track progress at a market level.
Who you are:
Confirmed experience in a strategy or management consultant role, with increased responsibility and complexity.
Strong influential leadership and can develop meaningful relationships with partners at different seniority levels and in various geographies
A friendly, mature, transparent, meticulous and self-starter attitude.
Sound presentation and communication skills. You can articulate compelling recommendations for complex problems, driven by logic and data
Advanced analytical skills, learn quickly and simplify complexity.
An action bias and have a demonstrated track record of navigating and getting results in a large and global organization.
A strong understanding of business, market dynamics, and consumer research. You never lose sight of what is meaningful.
Have multicultural work experience.
Why join us:
Expedia Group recognizes our success is dependent on the success of our people. We are the world's travel platform, made up of the most knowledgeable, passionate, and creative people in our business. Title: Director - Forensic Technology (Lab)
Description:
Do you want to work for a fast-paced, rapidly growing firm that values culture, work-life balance and reputation above all? If so, StoneTurn could be the right fit for you.

StoneTurn, a global advisory firm, assists companies, their counsel and government agencies on regulatory, risk and compliance issues, investigations and business disputes. We serve our clients from offices across the U.S., U.K., Germany, Brazil, and South Africa, assisted by a network of senior advisers around the world.

StoneTurn's leaders'partners and alumni of international public accounting and consulting firms, industry and government agencies'opted for a different professional services model. Our vision is to create a highly collaborative team of professionals who prefer "hands-on" client service and focus on forming long-term, trusted relationships.

StoneTurn is seeking a qualified Director to lead our Forensic Technology practice in London.

Job Summary

StoneTurn's Forensic Technology Practice assists lawyers and corporate clients with all information technology needs in forensic and litigation environments by utilizing state-of-the-art technology laboratories to stay ahead of the technology curve. Our national practice consists of certified computer forensic experts (EnCE, CCME, & CCE), including former "Big 4" specialists and strategic relationships with former law enforcement professionals. Our employees are skilled in obtaining and analyzing forensic images, restoring data obtained through forensic technology, performing in-house, third-party and incident response investigations, and assisting clients in the electronic discovery ("eDiscovery") process from the initial planning stage through data retrieval and production.

In this role you will be responsible for launching and managing the local computer forensics lab in the London market, delivering client engagements and working with the firm's existing forensic technology team to provide coordinated solutions on client matters in the investigation and litigation environment. You will lead business development efforts for the Forensic Technology practice in London and will add value by having previous experience in computer forensics, data analytics and electronic discovery. This position requires you to be a person with strong interpersonal, communication and technical skills.

Responsibilities
Application of forensic collection/preservation & analysis principles in the litigation environment
Understanding client needs in electronic and traditional discovery management
Collaboration with Partners in StoneTurn's Forensic Accounting, Litigation, and Compliance practices to deliver coordinated services
Lead Request for Proposal (RFP) process for Forensic Technology engagements, including generate budget estimates
Lead the firm's local Forensic Technology business development initiatives
Oversee and lead Forensic Technology engagements beginning to end, including engagement acceptance, data preservation, data recovery, forensic analysis, reporting on results through to billing and collections
Maintain regular contact with, and manage the expectations of, clients to help ensure client satisfaction, and report progress, both internally and externally, where applicable
Serve as a firmwide technical resource to ensure Quality Control processes are followed and maintained on engagements
Facilitate client and internal team meetings to document client objectives and requirements, make recommendations and determine best solutions
Invest in development of co-workers and staff, providing performance feedback and training
Foster a positive, efficient, and team-oriented environment
Ensure consistent high quality work product
Execute multiple priorities and projects on a daily basis

Required Qualifications
Good class degree in any in computer science or related field
8+ years of hands-on technical, computer forensic investigations and/or electronic discovery experience
4+ years of management experience
In-depth Financial Services experience (e.g. surveillance and/or compliance)
In depth experience of ACPO guidelines and gathering material to both civil and criminal evidential standards
Network of relationships within law firms and corporate legal departments
Extensive familiarity with EnCase and Cellebrite
Strong working knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems
Experience with eDiscovery matters
Experience with various forms of electronic media and cloud based systems
Flexibility with the potential travel requirements of client engagements
Professional demeanor and strong written and oral communication skills
Demonstrated ability to structure and perform technical projects, manage client expectations and relationships
Excellent prioritization skills
Commitment to exemplary client service delivery

Desirable qualifications
Experience in a professional services firm
EnCE, CCE, CFCE, or CCME certifications
Fluency with mobile forensics (cell phones, tablets, media players)
Experience with eDiscovery tools (Intella, NUIX, dtSearch)
Familiarity with Mac OS X and *NIX operating systems
Understanding of mail servers, backup software and database systems
Professional forensics training
Experience giving evidence

Title: Principal Solutions Architect, Enterprise Retail customers
Description:
Basic Qualifications
Background in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps
Experience driving technical and/or organizational change of significant complexity
Technical Degree (Computer Science, Maths, Engineering or equivalent) and/or relevant tech experience.
Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English
Passion for technology and for learning

Location: London, willing to consider candidates based in Manchester / Edinburgh

The retail industry is transforming at a pace and all sub-sectors from specialist high-street retailers to supermarkets and mass merchandisers are investing to transform customer experience, leverage data to drive engagement as well as efficiencies and look at increase the pace at which they transform. Cloud technologies are playing a pivotal role in this transformation and at AWS we are striving to become a trusted innovation partner for Retailers.
Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud and unlock innovation at pace. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. They will work on market innovative topics like Smart stores, Smart warehouses, Computer vision or Digital assistants.

Principal Solutions Architects work on the most complex customer challenges and opportunities. They have a leading role in developing both an offering tailored to the Retail industry and the Solutions Architecture team itself. They combine an informed view of the market with their understanding of emerging technology trends to speed-up innovation across their customer segment. Externally, they are recognized thought leaders and influence the strategy of our customers. Internally, they earn a reputation of role models and deliver bar-raising guidance to the broader Solutions Architecture team.

In this role you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating AWS customers about the art of the possible. You will have the opportunity to define or invent cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases (e.g. Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Serverless and Container based architectures, Analytics and Big Data, DevOps or Security).
The Solutions Architecture team is a diverse group of technologists from a variety of backgrounds. Practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have a sound technical foundation and a desire to learn.

At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.

Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.

Roles and Responsibilities
Work directly with Retail customers to assist them in achieving their long-term business outcomes by accelerating their cloud journey with architectural guidance based on best-practices to migrate their mission-critical workloads.
Build technical relationships with Retail customers up to the C-suite and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide.
Proactively work within the organization to influence the evolution of the platform
Take a leading role in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts).
Evangelize and educate about AWS technology and industry trends (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
Help develop the technical elements of the AWS go-to-market strategy, and the plan to engage with customers and partners, within your area of responsibility.
Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organization by interviewing candidates and having a voice in hiring decisions. You will also be helping others develop new skills by mentoring team members and identifying talent needs in the organization
Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to your interests and your customer's outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications
The following qualifications are desired but not required:
Experience within the Retail industry
Working knowledge of cloud native architectures
Development / DevOps background with knowledge of a modern programming language (Python, JavaScript, Go, .Net, Java, etc.)
Experience working in a customer-facing role and/or with public speaking
AWS certification (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Professional) or other industry certification
