Title: Chair
Description:
Join us in tackling one of the most pressing issues of our time
We are World Animal Protection. We’ve moved the world to protect animals for more than 50 years. We work for a world where animals live free from cruelty and suffering; we influence decision makers to put animals on the global agenda; we help the world see how important animals are to all of us; and we inspire people to change animals’ lives for the better. We believe change for animals changes our world - for the better.
For many years we have been a catalyst - our passionate teams inspiring and mobilising people, governments, communities and non-governmental organisations to protect animals across the world. We have made real advances in our work, but there is much more to do.
Awareness of the importance of animal welfare is growing and the interconnection with other global issues better understood but animal protection still needs to be universally acknowledged as a global priority that can change the world, and animals continue to face unprecedented threats. Whether it’s the billions of animals that suffer unspeakable cruelty in industrialised food production systems, or wild animals reduced to commodities for human exploitation. Animal suffering is not inevitable. If we help people understand how their actions affect animals and change their behaviour accordingly, the lives of billions of animals will be improved, and a better world created for everyone.
We are recruiting a non-executive chair of our international board, to lead the organisation during an exciting period of change, having developed our new Beyond 2020 Strategy. We continue to deliver against our current 2020 strategy and our focus is on delivering real and lasting change, not only for animals but also for the people who depend on them. This means we need to engage at the top tables in both governments and big businesses around the world.
We are seeking an experienced and accomplished Chair; someone with excellent business acumen, an understanding of complex, international operational structures; together with the energy, passion and inspiration to lead the charity’s vision as the organisation takes forward an ambitious strategy to increase our impact on sustainable animal welfare practices globally.
This is a significant opportunity for a person who has the strategic focus, governance understanding, leadership experience, emotional intelligence and time to support and develop a high-performing board and to ensure that it provides the right blend of support and challenge to the Chief Executive and Executive Team. Perhaps most importantly, you will bring a deep and demonstrable commitment to animal welfare, as well as an appreciation for how our work links to other causes such as the environment, sustainability and climate change.
Please quote reference 4751 to apply and download further information on the required qualifications, skills and experience for this exciting opportunity. The closing date for applications is 9am GMT on Monday 17th August.
The position of Chair is voluntary but reasonable expenses will be reimbursed. The time commitment for this role is approximately two to three days per month. World Animal Protection is headquartered in London.
Protecting your personal data is of the utmost importance to Perrett Laver and we take this responsibility very seriously. Any information obtained by our trading divisions is held and processed in accordance with the relevant data protection legislation. The data you provide us with is securely stored on our computerised database and transferred to our clients for the purposes of presenting you as a candidate and/or considering your suitability for a role you have registered interest in.
As defined under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Perrett Laver is a Data Controller and a Data Processor, and our legal basis for processing your personal data is ‘Legitimate Interests’. You have the right to object to us processing your data in this way. For more information about this, your rights, and our approach to Data Protection and Privacy, please visit our website: http://www.perrettlaver.com/information/privacy/

Staines
Permanent

Title: L2 Technical Operations Analyst
Description:
DESCRIPTION
Permutive is looking for a Technical Operations Analyst (L2) for our Support team. Someone with strong troubleshooting skills who is an empathetic problem solver. You'll be joining Permutive's Support team, engaging with our user base and improving their customer experience by providing quick and sound responses to queries and issues. As a Tech Ops Analyst you'll also be contributing to and supporting products that transform the way publishers make money and help to transform the way engineering build software on the edge.
The Technical Operations team work directly with our customers across the globe. We aim to delight our most important users with friendly and personalised support, while gathering feedback to drive improvements to our products. You'll work closely with every part of the organisation including Product, Engineering and Customer Success to help scale Permutive globally.
Your day to day will include:
Set the standard for individual Technical Support for our customers
Responding to tickets in our CRM.
Triaging and investigating system bugs, performance and integration issues
Running data queries to verify customer data collection
Troubleshooting customer configurations
Working closely with the Engineering and broader Support teams.
Contribute to the ongoing learning and success of the team and company, by sharing knowledge through mentorship and collaboration
Drive and help shape our support processes within the company, working with Support Engineering (L3) and other members of the Customer Operations team (L1)
Work with the product development team to test new features and bug fixes and surface meaningful customer feedback
We don't expect you to have deep experience in these domains: we're interested in someone who has a passion for innovation and professional growth.
Our ideal candidate will be excited by the opportunity to join a fast-growing start-up, in a role where you'll be able to have a positive impact and take ownership of the challenges you work on. This role is positioned for career progression into our L3 Support Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architects and Customer Success teams. As an early hire, you'll have the opportunity to be exposed and contribute to every aspect of the business, from product decisions and development processes to strategy.
REQUIREMENTS
WE EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:
A basic understanding of JavaScript, HTML and SQL (either through work-related experience or e.g. a bootcamp)
A deep curiosity for solving technical problems and a passion for helping others.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, comfort engaging with people who have varied levels of comfort with programming
WE'D BE PARTICULARLY EXCITED IF YOU ALSO HAVE ONE OR MORE OF THE BELOW:
Experience investigating and responding to technical questions
Curiosity for technology and pushing the envelope of what's possible
Some experience working with multi-platform SDKs (e.g. web, Android, iOS)
Familiarity with databases (SQL, BigTable/HBase, Cassandra, InfluxDB)
An involvement in the open-source or broader technology community
If not, we'd still love to hear from you - we're very happy to support you as you learn.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who:
Has a lucid, well-formed communication style (on the phone and in writing), with an impulse to listen and be empathetic first, and an ability to be firm and assertive when necessary.
Can articulate complex thoughts. One moment you may be having a technical discussion with an engineer about the product implications of a new feature, before quickly moving on to working directly with a non-technical customer to fix a problem. The ideal candidate will be able to clearly articulate themselves in each scenario.
Understands the web and how it works. You're not necessarily writing and deploying your own JavaScript-based, CSS-heavy responsive sites, but you're also not afraid of the technology.
Manages time and prioritises efficiently. Things move quickly in this environment and it's crucial that you are able to react to new information and re-prioritise accordingly.
Is self aware and adaptable in changing environments.
Has great operational awareness. A sense of the big picture in any organisation they inhabit, how team members' individual goals contribute to that, and how they can help team members navigate best within the big picture
We'd particularly love to hear from you if you also have:
Experience in customer support for a B2B SaaS company or in a dynamic startup environment
Experience in the AdTech or MarTech space
Salary
We take a structured, objective approach to salary-setting, which is based on market information, our compensation strategy, and your experience and capability as assessed through our interview process.
For a typical candidate with strong technical support experience plus most of our requirements, we would likely pay £37,000 + options.
For a candidate with a breadth of experience, and who meets several of our bonus criteria, we'd pay up to £48,000 + options.
Benefits
Stock options (you'll own a piece of the pie)
Parental Leave Policy entitling new parents up to 26 weeks of leave on full pay
Time to rest and relax with unlimited paid leave (minimum expectation of 20 days annually)
Extensive training and development opportunities
Automatic enrolment into our pension scheme from day one
Free access to Spill, our mental health partners

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
At Permutive, we're taking a thoughtful, intersectional, long-term approach to diversity, equity & inclusion. We care deeply about creating an inclusive work environment that allows everyone to flourish, and we are taking continual action to progress in that direction. If you would like to read an outline of efforts we have already made towards becoming a more inclusive company as well as insight into what we are actively working on, you can find that information here.
How we are responding to COVID-19
We have a physical office presence in London and New York. At the beginning of March 2020 we made the decision to move to work from home for all Permutive employees until January 2021. We have invested significant time and budget into ensuring that everyone is suitably equipped to manage this time period. Our guiding principle behind any decision we make will always be the health and well-being of our employees.

Title: Insights Manager, M4D Connected Women
Description:
Department: Mobile for Development
Department detail: Connected Women
Location: London
Position type: FTC 2 years
Reporting to: Senior Insights Manager, Connected Women

About the Team

GSMA Connected Women aims to reduce the gender gap in mobile internet and mobile money services and unlock significant commercial and socio-economic opportunities. A significant gender gap in mobile phone ownership and usage in low- and middle-income countries is hindering growth for the mobile industry and means women are being left behind in an increasingly connected world.

GSMA Connected Women works with mobile operators and their partners to address the barriers to women accessing and using mobile internet and mobile money services. It aims to equip mobile network operators and their partners with the knowledge needed to take action to reduce this gender gap and overcome barriers to women’s use of mobile phones. For more information, please visit the GSMA Connected Women website at: www.gsma.com/connectedwomen.

What the hiring manager says

“Access to digital and financial services can be incredibly empowering for many women, providing access to crucial information, opportunities and services. As an Insights Manager in the Connected Women team, you will work on research projects that truly drive impact on the ground, ensuring that millions more women can access these through mobile. The role offers an exciting and varied mix of primary research projects and industry engagement, providing unparalleled access to key industry players across Africa and Asia, and the opportunity to shape the agenda of an industry that has a profound impact on millions of women’s lives.”

Senior Insights Manager, Connected Women

About the Role

Connected Women is seeking a French-speaking Insights Manager to help create and implement our research agenda on the mobile gender gap in low- and middle-income countries, driving greater digital and financial inclusion of women.

Key responsibilities include the following:
Contributing to Connected Women’s research on the digital and financial gender divide; understanding the barriers to women’s access to and use of mobile, and how these can be addressed; evaluating the social and commercial impact of initiatives to reach women with mobile services
The Insights Manager will develop and manage high quality primary research studies from brief to debrief across a range of methodologies and markets. He/she will also keep track of external studies, digital innovations, and stakeholder initiatives advancing inclusion of women through mobile.
This includes managing quantitative and qualitative research projects; collecting and analysing data; generating and synthesising insights and learning on industry trends; and engaging with operators and relevant stakeholders on insights projects and to disseminate learning
In coordination with the team, help provide advisory services to the mobile industry and their partners interested in closing the gender gap in mobile connectivity and mobile money using research, analysis and insights generated.
Act as the primary relationship manager for French-speaking mobile operator partners of the Connected Women programme, driving action at operator level and liaising between them and the wider Connected Women team
Respond to ad-hoc requests from industry partners, members of the Connected Women team and other GSMA departments in a timely and engaging manner (sourced either from internal or external intelligence and often to support advocacy work and content production)
Disseminate research and learnings through written reports, case studies, blogs, conferences and meetings and workshops with relevant stakeholders.
Work effectively with other members of the Connected Women team as well as across the GSMA. This includes working closely with the Connected Society and Mobile Money teams on market engagement and insights projects.

About You

The right candidate will be able to draw on a solid foundation of research and commercial expertise and be excited to join a diverse team that shares a passion for the ways mobile can empower women across emerging markets.

We welcome applications from professionals with the following demonstrated qualifications:
A passion for primary research, and an understanding of the specific considerations of researching women in low- and middle-income countries
Some prior experience of managing externally commissioned research projects– either client or agency side, either qualitative or quantitative – is essential
Familiarity with a range of research methodologies, qualitative and quantitative
Ability to isolate and translate problems/requirements into research and analysis projects
Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks at the same time
Proven qualitative and quantitative analytical skills, including the ability to generate frameworks and structured analysis.
The ability to articulately and concisely summarise large volumes of intelligence into both PowerPoint documents and reports
Demonstrated stakeholder management experience, and fluent and compelling written and oral communications skills, in English and French
Ideally some commercial experience gained within telecoms or other industries (e.g. as a management consultant, as part of a research agency or from working for an operator or telco industry body)
Demonstrated interest in or familiarity with the mobile for development sector, particularly in mobile money and financial inclusion
Experience and interest in working in emerging markets is desirable
You must have the right to work in the UK.

What We Offer

Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.

In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.

We offer a working environment that reflects our organisational values. We also hire in line with our values and recruit candidates who demonstrate a strong affinity with these 7 principles:
DREAM BIG - Demonstrate vision and insight to lead the industry forward
BE BOLD - Have the courage to take risks and make tough decisions
OWN IT - Take full accountability for your decisions and actions
WORK AS A TEAM - Collaborate to deliver impactful results
DO THE RIGHT THING - Conduct yourself with honesty and integrity at all times
SHOW RESPECT - Treat others as you would expect to be treated
LOVE WHAT YOU DO - Bring passion and pride to your work

Title: Growth Marketer
Description:
About SoPost

At SoPost, our ambition is to build the world’s most powerful product sampling platform.

Our proprietary technology already enables many of the world’s most recognisable brands to run highly effective product sampling campaigns online, with a focus on three core areas:

(1) Relevance - Reaching consumers where they interact online, because of who they are or an action they’ve taken.
(2) Data - Collecting valuable contact and demographic information from recipients, enabling future engagement.
(3) Analytics - Qualitative and quantitative feedback around purchase intent and product or brand recommendations.

Our clients (‘Brand Partners’ as we refer to them) come from a broad range of different categories from cosmetics and fragrance to pharmacy to food and beverages. We believe our technology can work with any brand product and can address a wide range of communications objectives for the brands we work with and we are continually building our category and market representation.

Founded in 2012, SoPost employs over 30 people across three hubs: Our technology team of software engineers and UX/UI designers are based in Newcastle, while our commercial and partnership teams are located in both London and New York. We are active in seven major markets: The UK; North America (USA and Canada); and in mainland Europe (France, Germany, Italy and Spain).

Our growth trajectory has been significant and last year we were named as the thirteenth fastest growing UK company within the Deloitte Fast 50 technology companies and the fastest growing marketing technology business. We placed 8th in the Northern Tech Awards Top 100 growth companies and have also been selected for the prestigious Mayor of London’s International Business Growth Programme which supports UK businesses with an ambition to grow overseas.

While we know we have come a long way, our ambition extends well beyond where we are now. That means constantly striving to innovate around our product; to help more and more Brand Partners run highly effective product sampling campaigns using SoPost’s technology and to establish new markets to enter. We will never stand still.

What we’re looking for...

We’ve experienced some incredible organic growth over the last few years and are on track to double sales by the end of this year. We’re now looking for a B2B marketer to help us continue on this amazing trajectory. You’ll be excited about our mission to become the world’s most powerful sampling platform and be ready to take the lead on developing our marketing strategy from the ground up.

This role will have a global reach, based in our London office you’ll be responsible for driving awareness of SoPost in the UK, Europe, North America and beyond. You’ll be working with some of the best brands in the world like L’Oreal, GSK, and Unilever to understand the value we bring to our customers through our network of delivery partners including Facebook, Pinterest and Hearst. Translating your insights into creative marketing strategies that help us acquire new Brand Partners.

What will you be responsible for?

As the first dedicated Marketer at SoPost, you’ll have ownership over all growth marketing initiatives - working closely with the commercial, product and design teams to:

Build and define SoPost’s marketing strategy to increase awareness of SoPost amongst our target audience:

You’ll have responsibility for all elements of the marketing mix across our key markets in North America and Europe, with a primary focus on generating demand and acquiring new qualified leads.
You’ll be establishing SoPost’s voice in the market, using customer and competitor research to confirm product positioning, messaging and value proposition.
Increasing our visibility across digital channels (Social media, SEO etc.) as well as at events and identifying speaker opportunities.
You’ll develop innovative and creative marketing programs to drive outcomes that scale.
Build a global lead generation engine:
Define the concept of a qualified lead in agreement with the commercial teams, identifying and developing new tactics and channels to acquire these leads.
Work with the commercial teams to define demand generation KPI’s that help us achieve monthly, quarterly and annual revenue goals.
Work on strategic initiatives with both internal teams and external partners where needed that deliver on the KPI’s.
Coordinate a content strategy that positions us a thought leader in the sampling and marketing technology space to support the demand generation efforts.
Build a strategy to educate brands that don’t yet sample on the value of sampling with SoPost to broaden the total addressable market.
Measure and optimise results:
Define objectives, track progress, measure impact, and use your research to influence how we grow our product and customer base.
Design, test and learn from approaches to refine acquisition channels, analyse campaign performance, understand drivers of ROI and identify opportunities to optimise conversion funnels.
Own the marketing budget and report on activities we allocate spend to, demonstrating the expected outcomes for strategies in line with our budgets and company goals.
A little bit about you….

You’re excited about growth and how you can make a big impact in a fast growing business. You love experimenting with new ideas are not afraid to try things. If they don’t work out, you take the learnings and you move forward with a fresh take on things.

You have some or all of the following qualities:
Experience helping to build a global B2B marketing strategy.
Creative and data driven, making educated moves on channels and strategies to find new customers.
Both a team player and self starter, you’re self motivated but can get others onboard to help build out your ideas.
You’re a generalist and passionate about all elements of the marketing mix and keen to explore which routes will work best to meet your KPI’s.
Excited by the challenge of building the marketing function at SoPost from scratch.
Proactive in suggesting ideas and implementing them.
Clear communication when it comes to reporting and optimisation and how your decision making process works. Experience tracking and reporting on marketing activities.
Results driven.
Proven ability to build innovative programs, run marketing experiments and demonstrate results.
Comfortable working in a fast paced environment.
What you can expect from us

Commitment to growing your professional development and a training budget to support that commitment
Competitive Salary plus 23 days of annual leave, increasing to 25 by the end of three years of service.
Eligibility for our flexible working arrangement, giving you the power to manage your time and place of work.
Participation in Annual Bonus Plan and SoPost pension scheme.
Social events (monthly team lunches and quarterly drinks / team building activities)
Opportunity to work with the team in our New York office in Manhattan
How do I apply?

We believe that the successful recruitment for any role at SoPost is as much about giving you the opportunity to find out as much as possible about us and our Company as it is about us finding out about you and your capabilities. We want you to be as excited about joining SoPost as we are about being here!

With that philosophy in mind, we will be running the following selection process to ensure that each candidate is given a comprehensive view of what we are all about:

Stage one : Initial interview with our UK Head of Account Management, Sinead. You can read more about Sinead
here [https://www.linkedin.com/in/sineadmcsweeney/].

Stage two : Interview with our US country Manager, Bianca and our CFO, Russell. You can read more about Bianca and Russell
here [https://www.linkedin.com/in/bianca-chambers-23233475/] and here
[https://www.linkedin.com/in/russell-brown-37509321/].

Stage three : Final Round interview with our Founder/CEO, Jonny Grubin. You can read more about Jonny
here [https://www.linkedin.com/in/jgrubin/].

Stage four: Meet the team - probably the most important stage for us. An opportunity to meet with our brilliant Commercial team in London.

Stage five : Appointment decision and offer subject to references.

You can apply for the role at our dedicated portal here
[https://jobs.sopost.com/jobs/?team=COMMERCIAL]

Title: Delegated Authority Analyst
Description:
Main Purpose of Role

Developing Delegated Authority reporting capabilities is among Argo Global highest priorities in 2020. The Head of Operations is overseeing a significance project to embed bordereaux processes and platforms and to enhance and develop MI throughout the company. The main purpose of this role is to assist with the roll-out of agreed binder/ delegated authority bordereaux platforms utilising offshore teams where possible as well as developing business rules and MI to allow ArgoGlobal to better interrogate bordereaux information.

The broader Delegated Underwriting and Bordereaux Management Teams are, in line with the roll-out of the new platform, undergoing a Target Operating Model (TOM) review. As such this role has responsibilities and required skillsets which span across both teams currently. As a result, accountabilities will include both assisting management in the design, roll-out and operation of end-to-end Delegated Authority management and the processing and oversight of bordereaux collection, reporting and in particular the completion of key regulatory projects (e.g. Part VII).

Key Accountabilities

To co-ordinate workflows for Coverholder and Binder / Lineslip Contract management including on and offshore workflow processes and compliance reviews

To work with offshore technicians to ensure processes are successfully completed, review weekly offshore workflow and carry out required Quality Assurance checks

To assist Management on new Lloyds and Non-Lloyds coverholder applications (including Class of Business, Regional extension and Branch Office Applications for Coverholders and Argo Service Companies)

To assist Management on Argo Service Company requirements including preparation of renewal slips and endorsements throughout the contract period

Assist on system testing and liaise with the IT and Projects Department as and where required

Comply with Lloyd’s and MFSA rules on delegated underwriting and Argo internal protocols and procedures

Attend Lloyds Town Halls and workshops as and when required to stay abreast of ongoing regulatory and market changes

To own the processing of bordereaux and support the delivery of analytical advantage through effective sourcing and processing of bordereaux data

Complete the life-cycle of bordereaux capture and processing including:

Produce the initial mapping of new bordereaux to the ArgoGlobal binder tool

Liaising with Coverholders, Brokers and Underwriters to ensure the timely receipt of bordereaux

Ensure data quality and MI business rules are in place and adhered to in conjunction with underwriters

In conjunction with the Management liaise with ArgoGlobals offshore team to ensure that data entry SLAs are met or escalated

Work with Credit Control to assist in binder credit control helping the offshore team with any required chasing and/ or queries

Work with the Outwards Reinsurance to ensure the annual R/I Renewal process is completed with accurate information.

Attend regular broker meetings with the Bordereaux Manager and Credit Control Manager to maintain good working relationship discussing binder premium settlements and bordereaux queries

Maintain a good relationship with Lloyd’s Delegated Authority team ensuring changes to regulatory requirements are understood and embedded in ArgoGlobal processes.

Monitor Conduct Risk MI data being received to ensure completeness.

Assist in large-scale regulatory and / or other key Argo or Market projects, e.g. Lloyd’s Part VII Transfer

Role Requirements

Demonstrated experience in performing end-to-end bordereaux entry and oversight processes.

Demonstrated experience in coordinating end-to-end Delegated Authority Due Diligence and oversight.

Strong knowledge of DA SATS and Watertrace such bordereaux management systems

Excellent attention to detail and a meticulous eye for identifying inconsistencies or inaccuracies in data entry or data outputs.

Strong stakeholder management experience, building and strengthening relationships within the business at all levels as well as with brokers and Coverholders as required.

Bordereau management tools, document repository and workflow systems, Lloyd’s tools (Atlas, Crystal, BARS, AIMS)

Skills/Competencies

Communication (oral) – ability to communicate well one-to-one and in small groups. Keeps others informed and updated

Communication (written) – ability to write clear, precise and well organised documents

Relationship building – establish and maintain good working relationships with internal and external parties

Organisational Skills – ability to deliver on tasks and meet deadlines

Prioritisation and attention to detail – must have excellent skills in both of these competencies

Team Player – ability to work well in a team as well as on own initiative

Strategic thinking – understands the big picture. Ability to acquire, understand and absorb information quickly

Ideally good knowledge of Lloyd’s, FCA/PRA and other regulatory standards

Ability to act with due professional care, demonstrating sound integrity and confidentiality.

Qualifications

Educated to at least A level standard

LMMIT – Pass preferable although not essential

Technical Skills & Experience

Proven experience in delegated authority business, preferably working in an insurance company or Lloyd’s Syndicate in a role with responsibility for Delegated Authority oversight.

Excellent administrative experience

Experience of working in a Lloyd’s environment advantageous

Experience of London market systems and processing desirable but not essential

Knowledge of the insurance industry

Good knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint

Experience of identifying and implementing process improvements

Experience of working to deadlines and managing other’s priorities.

Experience of Bordereau Management systems essential

Title: Associate, Digital Forensics

Alvarez & Marsal
London

Electronic Disclosure Management;
Data Mining and Database Analytics;
Information Governance; and
Cyber Security.

Sound technical understanding of the ACPO guidelines;

Strong written and oral communication skills in addition to well-developed organisation skills; and

Fast learner, eager to learn new technologies.
Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
Objective, fact based approach to problem solving.
Hands-on and non-hierarchical operator - relates well at all levels and cultures.

Demonstrable ability to balance a high level view with detail.
A natural ability to prioritise – especially in highly pressurised situations.
Autonomous – Alvarez & Marsal has a flat structure with a self-sufficient culture.
Entrepreneurial spirit.
Academics and qualifications
A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university is required.

Attracted by our meritocratic culture and the opportunity to build a business with like-minded individuals, our people have joined Alvarez & Marsal from the Big 4, top tier strategy houses, private equity firms, hedge funds, leading financial services institutions and industry and commerce. Title: Clinical Trials Data Manager
Description:
One business, one mission: improving brain health through the application of digital technologies.
Established in 2004 and listed as a public company in October 2013, IXICO has established itself as a trusted partner to the global biopharma industry, providing technology-enabled speciality services. Our neuroscience expertise in image data management and analysis provides specialist data analytics services, which are applied on some of the most important clinical trials in neuroscience, providing valuable insights to disease progression and patient safety, enabling our clients to make better informed decisions earlier in the clinical development pathway.

Reporting into
Data Management Lead
Purpose of the Role
The Data Manager role will be responsible for executing standard, advanced and complex or novel data management tasks in clinical research studies, including performing data checks and reconciliations, preparation of departmental and project documentation, and execution of interim and final data transfers. This will include the oversight and training of junior colleagues, and contributing to the department’s procedural documents and reports.
The Company measures itself against the four key values of Aspiration, Ability, Agility and Accountability. This role holder will set Aspirational goals for the way they deliver and improve data management processes and efficiencies, with a mind to the continued growth and scaling of the Company in the future. The role will require an individual of significant Ability in the area of Data Management, someone able to work with Agility across multiple projects employing good communication skills, to work with different teams from across and outside the Company as they delivery to strict deadlines. Responsibilities:
Perform routine and ad hoc hygiene checks on project data.
Perform Data Reconciliation of externa data.
Configure database extracts to support data transfers.
Validate the transfer/data prior to submission to sponsor.
Writing standard/complex Data Transfer Agreement and Image Transfer Agreements.
Perform standard/non-standard Data and Image Transfers.
Handling and processing of Clinical Device Data (e.g. wearables)
Devise and implement efficient and secure procedures for data handling, also assisting in standardizing and documenting data management procedures.
Define and implement Data Metrics and KPI’s.
Perform QC on all aspects of work performed in Data Management to ensure that data quality and integrity is maintained.
Interact with other project team members to support the set-up, maintenance, and closure of the Data Management aspects of the project.
Oversight and training of junior members of the DM team
working knowledge of each of the tasks performed within the department, and to be able to provide coverage for a broad range of tasks as and when required.
Additional:
Timely and accurate management of the receipt, tracking and recording of incoming data (including those received via methods other than e-transfer [e.g. CDs]), into the appropriate database including trackers.
Managing the upload of data into the IXICO data platform/ project-specific database on applicable projects.
Administrative tasks within trials such as adding sites/users to a trial.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent data management experience.
5+ years ‘experience of working in data management within a clinical trials environment essential
Strong IT skills essential (working within cloud-based database systems desirable) and demonstrate experience of working with a variety of data formats
Strong attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Team oriented and flexible; ability to function in high volume environment with competing priorities.
Ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously under direction and prioritise workload.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office (in particular Excel).
Ability to learn other computer systems, including databases.
Experience in using SAS platform desirable but not essential.
Benefits
Generous employer pension contribution of 6%
25 days annual leave, increasing up to 28 days with every year at IXICO
Various discounts in retail, food & drink and entertainment through our benefit portal
Annual salary review and company bonus scheme
Life Assurance scheme
A very sociable, supportive and highly motivated team
A company in an industry where your work has an impact every single day
How to Apply
IXICO is working hard to create a representative, inclusive and super-friendly team, because we believe different experiences, perspectives and backgrounds make a better workplace, and ultimately better services.
IXICO doesn’t discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion or belief, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or any other protected class.
This is a great opportunity to thrive in an engaging and fast-paced environment, to make a difference on an every day basis. You will be given support to enable you to grow with your challenges, and we pride ourselves to be a sociable and diverse bunch of people, who are all working together on one big mission: Improving brain health. Will you join us?
If you think IXICO should meet you, send us your CV and covering letter by email to careers@ixico.com. We are looking forward to your application!
Please note that IXICO will process the data provided by you only in order to perform the outlined recruitment exercise. For more details on what data we process and on what legal basis this happens please view our Recruitment Privacy Policy or contact careers@ixico.com.

Title: Trainee UX Designer
Description:
Responsibilities
Description of the Business Line or Department
SG Markets is Societe Generale’s suite of B2B digital products and applications for start-ups, corporate and financial institutions.
We are the UX Design team of the Corporate & Investment Banking division. So far with our team of ~20 designers we have delivered over 100 services on the SG Markets platform over 4 years and developed one of the most advanced Design Systems in a Bank. Our mission? To lead change and make great products with a seamless user experience.
Our team structure is flat and transversal – this means that we don’t isolate ourselves in a studio, but we’re not completely dispersed either. Our flat team structure means that every single person on the team is heard – we don’t worry about where ideas come from, we only want to find the best solutions.
We have bi-annual team meetups in Paris or in London and there will be other opportunities to travel to Paris as needed (depending on up-to-date travel guidelines of course!). There will also be opportunities to attend the biggest UX events and conferences. One of the biggest perks of working for a large bank is our perks-at-work scheme – you’ll have access to discounts for retail, cinema, hotels, flights, free admission to the V&A and weekly free ticket draws to events around London.
Please check out our design website and our medium blog on the links below:
https://design.sgmarkets.com/

https://medium.com/societe-generale-design

We’re a diverse bunch at Societe Generale and we believe in people as the core to our success. As a result we’re committed to talent and recruit regardless of sex, martial or civil partnership status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origins, pregnancy, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief or gender reassignment.
Summary of the key purposes of the role
We’re looking for a talented UX designer who we can make an impact on us, and on the products that we work on. We love diversity and we’re open to all backgrounds. As long as you can show us your passion for user experience, your skills in strategic thinking and excellent execution, we would love to have you work with us.
As a UX designer, we’d like you to be able to use research to uncover customer issues, and opportunities. You should be able to use efficient problem framing approaches to solve problems and create products with great user experience.

Summary of responsibilities
What will you be doing?
We want to give you the skills to work on a project end to end – you’ll be in constant contact with the Business and Information Technology teams. In the projects, you’ll work on the scoping, research, ideation, prototyping and handoff stages. All with a goal of making the best and most easily usable products.
Projects range across brand new products, redesigns of existing systems, individual feature design and one off UX or UI reviews. You’ll start on smaller projects while you learn to work with our methodology and design system with your buddy, before we unleash you to eventually lead the design of a full project.
Our work is broad – We know that corporate companies and financial products can seem intense, but in reality this only means that we constantly have to adapt our skills to new areas, which ensures that everyone here has the opportunity to work across a huge variety of financial projects, ranging from trading tools to client onboarding services.

Profile Required
Competencies
Communication skills are a must – we have lots of presentations to product owners and users who need to understand the rationale behind your proposals.

Title: Content Designer
Description:
Founded in mid-2015 to make consumer research simple and accessible for anyone, anywhere, Attest is a fast-growing scaleup backed by investors including Silicon Valley leader NEA. Attest is striving toward a world in which anyone can put consumers and data at the heart of every decision, to create and deliver better, more useful services, products and experiences for real people and communities worldwide.

In 2019, our team tripled to nearly 100 people, and together we achieved huge commercial, technical and people success. Our plans for 2020 and beyond are big and exciting, and our team is growing fast.

A robust set of shared values unites our team. We invest in each other to ensure every Attester has the opportunity, support and encouragement to realise their full potential. We strongly believe everyone should have the autonomy to freely explore new ideas and have a voice in shaping the future of Attest, whilst making sure that the work we do genuinely makes a difference.

About the Design team

The Design Team crafts the Attest experience from end-to-end, from front to back, in every channel. From the moment a user encounters a problem to the moment they solve it; from very-user-facing elements like the marketing website to the almost-invisible like how internal services operate; from the magazine delivered through a clients door to the interface that renders survey results. We obsess over what our customers need and doggedly pursue solutions which are useful, usable, and high quality.

About the role

As a Content Designer at Attest, you'll collaborate with cross-functional peers and stakeholders to define problems and speculative opportunities, rapidly prototype and ship solutions, and validate those solutions with data. You'll be a strong advocate for research, information architecture, content, and narrative—working collaboratively to define and socialise the conceptual model of Attest.

Content Designers will spend most of their time embedded in a single product team and will help to solve problems within their product pillar—focused on things like growth, engagement, and audience—to ensure we create connected, coherent experiences for our users. You'll lead projects end-to-end and will champion users and content design throughout the product development process.

You might do things like

> Work collaboratively to define both long-term strategy and short-term tactics to improve Attest, both within your own squad and across the product function.
> Collaborate with designers and other cross-functional peers to map out the conceptual model of Attest, and articulate/socialise the concepts with the broader team.
> Translate the conceptual model of Attest into well-defined and clearly articulated objects to be reflected in the design system and represented in interface and code.
> Audit content and information architecture across the platform and work across product squads to ship both small and large changes to IA and end-to-end flow.
> Collaborate with other teams to map out end-to-end customer journeys, identify strengths and opportunities, and generate potential solutions to improve the journey.
> Create content standards and style guide to be used across the Attest platform, and support others in shipping high-quality content design throughout the product.
> Improve user onboarding and product education through creating a structured narrative and identifying opportunities to engage users in the right place, at the right time.
> Work closely with designers and engineers to ensure the language we use is consistent throughout the stack and document product terms for others in an accessible way.
> Own the end-to-end design process, from problem definition and user research, through to low/high-fidelity prototyping and IA/UX copy that's ready to ship.
> Carry out usability testing and user experience research to falsify assumptions and validate solutions, working closely with our in-house research experts.

You may be a good fit if you

> Can define and articulate business or user problems in straightforward terms, and explore solutions that contain the right balance of simplicity, flexibility and power.
> Think rigorously about the problems you're solving and the solutions you explore, working from first principles and trying to understand real user needs.
> Have strong skills in information architecture and UX writing, but have a broad skillset across product design, including research and prototyping.
> Think in systems and are able to translate your work into reusable patterns that can be used across the product design team to create consistent and coherent work.
> Are skilled in communicating your work, process, and design decisions to cross-functional stakeholders, and regularly seek feedback to improve your work.
> Love working with other designers to help them learn and grow through collaborating, coaching, and mentoring (and to have others help you learn and grow).
> Have a very high bar for design quality, but know when and how to balance priorities and scope to benefit your squad, the design team, and the rest of Attest.
> Are results-driven and know how to use data to both define user problems and to understand if (or to what extent) your solutions address those problems
Is this role not quite the right fit for you? Or, have you not seen a suitable position available on our careers site? We’re always on the look-out for curious, motivated and bright people to join our team. Connect with us, and we’ll let you know if and when we have new opportunities.

Diversity at Attest

Everyone's welcome at Attest, regardless of what you look like, where you come from or what you’re curious about. Our product is for everyone, globally, and so is our work space. The more diverse our range of perspectives in our business, the more we all thrive, together. So tell us about your background, personal experiences and perspective on the world and help us further enrich our offering to enable better made decisions to make the world a better place.

Do let us know if there are any adjustments you’d like us to make to ensure the most inclusive interview process we can - we’re learning too, so we’re more than happy to adapt and accommodate whenever possible.

Attest aims to change the way decisions are made, and to help people understand the data that responds to their curiosity. Our mission is to put data at the heart of decisions. Everything we do at Attest is driven by curiosity, honesty, responsible autonomy and collaboration. Our team is growing - will you be next to join the adventure?

Title: Policy Adviser, Financial Services Trade

The Financial Services Group promotes a stable and efficient financial services sector that supports growth in the UK economy and promotes good outcomes for consumers and businesses, by:

Title: Research Fellow
Description:
Nesta is looking for a Research Fellow, on a one-year maternity cover contract, to deliver between two and three research papers that explore how online job adverts and microdata can be used to improve regional estimates of skill supply, demand and skill mismatches.

About Nesta and the Data Analytics Directorate
Nesta is an innovation foundation. For us, innovation means turning bold ideas into reality. It also means changing lives for the better. We use our expertise, skills and funding in areas where there are big challenges facing society, from the frontiers of personalised healthcare to stretched public services and a fast-changing jobs market. Nesta is based in the UK and supported by a financial endowment. We work with partners around the globe to bring bold ideas to life to change the world for good.
Nesta’s Data Analytics Directorate is at the forefront of using Big Data for social good. We bring together world class capabilities in User Research, Data Engineering, Data Science and Data Visualisation to produce open source code, research and tools that help individuals, charities, businesses and governments to make more informed choices for the benefit of society.

About this exciting opportunity
You will be joining our Data Analytics Directorate which consists of approximately 15 data scientists, developers and visualisation experts. Within the Directorate, this role will sit within the Open Jobs Data team, which aims to use novel data and methods to improve labour market information for others. The research papers you will be working on are part of Nesta’s commitment to the Economic Statistics Centre of Excellence (ESCoE), which is made up of a consortium of leading institutions, and is a collaboration with the Office for National Statistics (ONS). You will work with ONS microdata (after becoming an accredited researcher), as well as a dataset containing millions of job adverts.
Within each research paper there will be plenty of scope for you to bring your own ideas and methods. Each research paper may be submitted to ESCoE’s discussion paper series . This is an example of an ESCoE discussion paper that was written by members of the Open Jobs Data Team.

What we’re looking for:
A masters or PhD in a relevant field (e.g. economics, data science, statistics etc)
A good understanding of economics, with a preference for those with experience in quantitative labour market research
A high level of proficiency in Python, with some knowledge of machine learning methods
A demonstrable ability to lead and deliver research projects to fixed deadlines
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. The successful candidate will need to provide regular updates to ESCoE. The research papers must be clearly written and accessible to a broad audience
A desire to keep advancing their technical skills. We expect the research papers to demonstrate innovative approaches and to deliver new insights
The ability to work well within a team. As a member of the Data Analytics Directorate, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to provide technical advice to others within the team.
How to apply
For further details about this post, and to apply, please complete the application form on our website.
Closing date: 27th July 2020 at 8am.
1st stage interviews will be held 5th August 2020 .
2nd stage interviews will be held 12th August 2020 .

Please note that all interviews will take place remotely. You will be given different interview slots to select from so you can go for the one that suits you the best, given any care giving or any other responsibilities you might have due to the current public health situation.
Nesta is committed to equality, diversity and inclusion - we welcome and encourage applications from everyone.
Please note: After the job advert closes, your answers will go through a sift process: randomising and anonymising answers for taking out individual information that biases hiring decisions and facilitating us to review each answer by more than one person so you can benefit from the wisdom of the crowds. People scoring the applications will not have seen your CV at this stage so please try your best to answer questions without rephrasing your CV, they will see this later! Title: Technology Resilience Assurance Specialist
Description:
Our team:
Role Title: Technology Resilience Assurance Specialist
Reporting to Technology Resilience Assurance Manager
Location: Paddington / Ivrea (Italy)

Our Team: Strategy, R&D and Assurance (SRA)
The Strategy, R&D and Assurance team within Group Technology are responsible for creating and guiding Vodafone’s technology strategy as well as exploring new technologies working closely with partners, vendors, Group functions and Local Markets.
SRA are also responsible for identifying and assuring key technology risks across all local markets and group entities, ensuring policies and controls are being implemented and adhered to. The SRA team produce board level reporting for technology risks.
Role purpose

The 2nd Line Assurance function will be responsible for monitoring and mitigating key technology risks, driving a risk awareness culture and promoting a risk-sensitive approach to processes, architectures, applications and platforms within Technology.
The key technology risks currently in scope are Cyber Security, Technology Resilience, IT Transformation, Shadow IT and Lifecycle Management. We monitor risk by working closely with local markets and Group functions; testing key controls established in our policies. We mitigate risk by identifying corrective actions and reporting to key stakeholders, including the Technology leadership team and various board committees.
The assurance specialist will be required to shape and drive the technology resilience program in all our markets and group functions while supporting financials and related controls. This role requires a high calibre individual with a strong growing strategy mind-set and understanding of technology architectures and its evolutions. The candidate will interact with local markets and Group entities for different domains such as Mobile, fixed, IT, IoT etc.. The role also requires that you asses, evolve and implement continuous improvement to the Vodafone resilience program, process and culture. This is role is expected to have 10% travel time.

With us, you will:

Transform the way that Vodafone manages technology Resilience risk, so that we achieve the risk tolerance targets as set by the Board
Perform risk management/assurance/compliance reviews/controls testing across Vodafone Technology (Network and IT) to determine high areas of risk, working closely with local markets.
Understand and support the resilience KPI’s, capabilities, methodologies and strategy
Identify areas of business pain and risks while providing mitigations and corrective actions where possible
Work with markets and group functions in advising how to introduce best process and methodologies to reduce the loss of technology failures.
Understand the architectures/solutions to lower risks and increase technology resilience including best practises sharing and methodologies
Support the business continuity process and procedures
Execute part of the governance for Vodafone’s key technology risks up to Board level, including reporting to and managing senior stakeholders.
Perform analysis on Vodafone technology to determine high areas of risk
Support the design of the end-to-end assurance strategy.
Investigate and implement automated testing where possible
Apply if you have:
Experience of large IT or Network delivery programmes.
Experience in IT audit including application audits, general control reviews and/or data analytics
Technology assurance, compliance or risk management experience (managing reviews and reporting findings)
Experience with developing, implementing and testing risk, policies and controls.
Strong stakeholder management skills, documentation and presentation skills
The ability to grasp technical concepts rapidly and to articulate these concepts to technical and non-technical audiences
Analytical thinking capabilities and are able to manage complex detail without losing sight of the big picture
At least one risk, audit, or governance certification e.g. CISA, CRISK, CGEIT or equivalent
A fluency of the English language both written and spoken

We are happy if you have:
A technical degree
Knowledge of relevant Frameworks (e.g. SOX, ISO 27001/27002, COBIT, etc)
Technical/Infrastructure knowledge i.e. detailed knowledge of some of the following platforms:
Applications (CRM, HR)
Operating Systems(LINUX, Windows)
IT Networks, Firewalls, VPNs
Databases (SQL, Oracle, MySQL etc)
GSM Network Infrastructure
Telecommunications experience

Title: Sales Development Manager
Description:
Founded in mid-2015 to make consumer research simple and accessible for anyone, anywhere, Attest is a fast-growing scaleup backed by investors including Silicon Valley leader NEA. Attest is striving toward a world in which anyone can put consumers and data at the heart of every decision, to create and deliver better, more useful services, products and experiences for real people and communities worldwide.

In 2019, our team tripled to nearly 100 people, and together we achieved huge commercial, technical and people success. Our plans for 2020 and beyond are big and exciting, and our team is growing fast.

A robust set of shared values unites our team. We invest in each other to ensure every Attester has the opportunity, support and encouragement to realise their full potential. We strongly believe everyone should have the autonomy to freely explore new ideas and have a voice in shaping the future of Attest, whilst making sure that the work we do genuinely makes a difference.

About the role

Reporting to the Head of Business Development, your role will be to manage and coach a team of six exceptional, motivated and successful Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) and execute on commercial initiatives and KPIs in order to build qualified pipeline for the AE team to close.

We are looking for an inspiring, enterprising and committed natural leader to join our team as a Manager for our SDR team and we’re keen to hear from current SDR Managers within the Tech and SaaS space.

What you’ll be doing

> Coaching and SDR Development:
You will champion personal and professional development for each SDR leveraging your experience in the role. You will help the team gain the skills and knowledge to meet and exceed their targets, and have a passion for helping everyone to achieve their full potential.

You will hold regular 1-1s and coaching sessions offering constructive feedback to ensure each SDR is supported and given the best chance to succeed.

> Operational Excellence:
You will play a fundamental role in the day-to-day running and efficacy of our sales team. This includes ensuring processes are followed, upholding data integrity and helping the team use tools and systems to their full extent. You’ll have an eye for detail, and continue to look for ways to optimise performance and output, based on your experience and team feedback. This includes setting SPIFs, competitions and other initiatives you believe will drive behaviours and results.

> On-boarding and Ramping
You will be actively involved with the on-boarding and ramping of new SDR recruits ensuring they hit the ground running as soon as possible. You will work with the Sales Enablement team to feedback and constantly look for ways in which we can improve our on-boarding process.

> Constant Iteration and Innovation
You will have your ear to the ground when it comes to the latest and greatest outreach techniques and will be constantly experimenting while having a keen eye for data points to ascertain what is working well. In practice, you will help the team A/B test their messaging and approach in order to scale success.

You may be a good fit if

> You’re conscientious and take pride in your work, but you’re humble – you win and win well - we call it humble ambition.
> You’re relentlessly positive and you’re passionate about self-development.
> You're self-motivating - you love being part of a team, but know how to keep yourself moving.

Nice to have experience

> Experience with Salesloft/Outreach, Salesforce, Linkedin Sales Navigator, Vidyard/Loom and Jiminny/Gong (or similar)
> Experience as an SDR and SDR Manager in a rapidly growing SaaS scale-up.
> Consistent success in a previous sales role - achieving or even better over-achieving against sales targets.
About the interview process

You can see an overview of the interview process, including who is involved, on this page.

We believe in full transparency. We know that applying for a role and spending time with us in interviews is a significant commitment of your time and energy. We appreciate that there are many companies out there hiring, and there are only so many processes you will be able to commit to participating in fully, so having some visibility of what the process will include may help you plan and choose how to spend your time and energy. We publish our interview process for each role transparently from the start, so you have full visibility of the stages, the things we'll be covering, whether there is a task involved, and who you are likely to meet during the process.

We're always open to and welcoming of candidate feedback on the interview experience with Attest, and in particular, on the process outlined - if there are folks you think are important for you to meet to get to know us better and help strengthen your decision of whether to join us, please let us know as soon as possible, so we can make adjustments to the overall process as necessary; we may not always be able to make it happen, but we'll definitely try!

In return, we’ll give you…

Our benefits and perks are designed with a focus on the wellbeing, engagement, and growth of our Attesters. In addition to the below overview, we publish details on all benefits available, including location-specific benefits, openly and transparently on our Notion pages.

>A competitive salary - that fairly recognises your experience and potential;
>25 days (UK) or 23 days (US) paid holiday (+public holidays) per year - we care about our team’s wellbeing, so we make sure you have time to fully switch off, rest, and recharge;
>Up to 2 additional full company days off annually for Attest's Christmas 'office closure'. These are set by Attest, and are usually the days of Christmas Eve and New Years Eve to the extent they fall on business days. We will let everyone know in advance which days will these will be.
>Flexible working hours and remote working - whether you have parental responsibilities, just need some headspace, or prefer to structure your working balance a bit differently, we value responsible autonomy and default to trust; we’ll support you in making your work and personal life a manageable blend. We're currently working fully remotely due to covid-19; you can read more about how we approach that in our Guide to fully remote working at Attest.
>10% time - to invest in charitable activities, your growth and development, and/or side projects for Attest;
>10 fully-paid sick days per year - mental health and physical health are treated equally at Attest and apply regardless of location. Whether you’ve been knocked out with the flu, are having an operation, or need some time off to manage anxiety, stress or depression, for example, we encourage all our Attesters to rest up and come back when they’re feeling more like themselves;
> £/$500 per person annual Growth & Development fund - we care deeply about your personal and professional growth and development, so in addition to other structured Growth & Development initiatives we offer throughout the year, we also provide every Attester with £/$500 via Sunlight.is annually, to spend on courses, books and further development of your choosing.
>Sanctus - Remote coaching sessions with fully qualified coaches 2 x per month through Sanctus. Sessions are private to you and your coach, and a space for you to use as you see fit. As coaches are usually UK based, we ask all Attesters to be mindful of booking afternoon slots where morning slots are available, to be considerate of our international colleagues who may only be able to make use of slots that fall later in the day.
> 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - all Attesters have access to Employee Assistance Programmes, including accessing confidential telephone counselling 24/7, advice on debt, housing, and beyond.
>High-quality Equipment - we’ll invest to provide you with the right tools and set-up to help you do your best work;
>A values-led working environment - that encourages putting people first, honesty, curiosity and leadership.
> A Dog Friendly work environment - during coronavirus, we've gone fully remote. But in our previous office and in future offices, we're a dog-friendly bunch!

Is this role not quite the right fit for you? Or, have you not seen a suitable position available on our careers site? We’re always on the look-out for curious, motivated and bright people to join our team. Connect with us, and we’ll let you know if and when we have new opportunities.

Diversity at Attest

Everyone's welcome at Attest, regardless of what you look like, where you come from or what you’re curious about. Our product is for everyone, globally, and so is our work space. The more diverse our range of perspectives in our business, the more we all thrive, together. So tell us about your background, personal experiences and perspective on the world and help us further enrich our offering to enable better made decisions to make the world a better place.

Do let us know if there are any adjustments you’d like us to make to ensure the most inclusive interview process we can - we’re learning too, so we’re more than happy to adapt and accommodate whenever possible.

Attest aims to change the way decisions are made, and to help people understand the data that responds to their curiosity. Our mission is to put data at the heart of decisions. Everything we do at Attest is driven by curiosity, honesty, responsible autonomy and collaboration. Our team is growing - will you be next to join the adventure?

Title: Engineering Manager, Front Line Platform
Description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we have our eyes set on an ambitious goal: to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers trillions of requests per month. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare have all web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was recognized by the World Economic Forum as a Technology Pioneer and named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list.
We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us!
About the Department
Cloudflare's Engineering Team builds and runs the software that serves 14 million HTTP requests per second on average. We also build and run the internal tools that builds and runs our software. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base. The operations team handles one of the world's largest networks with data centers in more than 200 cities worldwide.
What you'll do
As Engineering Manager for the Front Line Platform (FLPLAT) you will lead the London-based team of engineers that develops the software platform responsible for routing, validating, and securely processing all 14 million/sec HTTP requests that hit the Cloudflare edge. This platform is a mix of open source systems such as NGINX with Lua, and increasingly our own code written in Rust, C++, Go, and Python. This unique role presents an opportunity to be at the nexus of the Cloudflare edge applications and operations, and to closely collaborate with other product and engineering teams in enabling their delivery.
You will lead a team of passionate, talented engineers who are building innovative products that touch billions of web requests each day. In this role, you will introduce tools and processes to make our engineer's lives better. You will play an active part in shaping product strategy based on what's technically possible. You will make sure our company hits our ambitious goals from an engineering standpoint.
You bring a passion for meeting business needs with building technically innovative solutions, and excel at shifting between the two—understanding how big-picture goals inform technical details, and vice-versa. You thrive in a fast-paced iterative engineering environment and have experience delivering scalable distributed systems. Most importantly, you will have a track record of having past teams respect you as both a technical leader and manager.
Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience
5+ years experience in engineering management
Solid foundation in computer science, with strong competencies in algorithms, data structures, software design, and building large, distributed systems
Proven experience in running enterprise services at pace and at scale whilst maintaining operational stability
Strong experience working with web performance, reverse proxy, caching and load balancing
Experience in representing Engineering teams strategically when cross-team design and planning is required
Experience of working with Product teams to balance priorities across operational requirements and new product development
Excel at planning, creating teams and overseeing execution to meet commitments and deliver with predictability
Demonstrate a track record of managing a team including hiring, on-boarding, and professional development. You inspire your team to reach higher. You're as good at explaining "why" as you are "how"
Experience implementing tools, process, internal instrumentation, methodologies and resolving blockages
A passion for continuous improvement when it comes to both operations and new product development
Comfortable managing teams/projects with tight deadlines and short release cycles
Bonus Points
Familiarity working with Rust and Lua
Familiarity working with NGINX, DNS, database systems, Internet performance, and/or Internet security
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We're not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We're a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo: We equip politically and artistically important organizations and journalists with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare's enterprise customers-at no cost.
Athenian Project: We created Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration.
Path Forward Partnership: Since 2016, we have partnered with Path Forward, a nonprofit organization, to create 16-week positions for mid-career professionals who want to get back to the workplace after taking time off to care for a child, parent, or loved one.
1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here's the deal - we don't store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy policy and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you'd like to be a part of? We'd love to hear from you!
Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.
