Title: Strategy, Implementation and Spending Review Advisers/ Analy...
Company: UK Government - Department of Health and Social Ca...
Description:
Our teams work closely together and report to the same Deputy Director. Our respective focusses are:

The Strategy Unit works on the big strategic questions and challenges facing the health and social care system. The SU works jointly with policy teams on key strategic policy development (e.g. social care, workforce, climate change) and conducts our own 2/3-month projects in ministerial priority areas. It also acts as an “incubator” for new ideas and is externally focused – maintaining close links with wider stakeholder groups (including think-tanks, the health and care sector and academics).

The Implementation Unit supports Ministers in translating their priorities into real world impact for patients/service users, clinicians and the public. This includes tracking the implementation of priority projects, providing independent analysis and challenge of delivery plans, and building delivery capability across the Department and its ALBs. The IU also carries out regular “deep dives” into implementation challenges; combining qualitative and quantitative evidence to identify and unblock barriers to effective implementation, including gathering evidence from frontline providers.

The Spending Review team builds the case for future spending decisions across all aspects of health and care. We support the delivery of Ministerial and Departmental priorities by leading DHSC’s preparations for major fiscal events at which these decisions are taken. This includes Budgets and the forthcoming Spending Review, a critical cross-Government event where departmental budgets are agreed for future years.

We are recruiting for three Higher Executive Officers, one in each team.

Our teams are dynamic, motivated, friendly and supportive. Successful candidates will benefit from a wide overview of the Department’s work, proximity to Ministers and the senior leadership team of the Department, and the top priorities of the day. They will have the opportunity to learn and deploy a range of strategic, analytical and financial tools and techniques.
Responsibilities
The main responsibilities of each of the available posts are:

Strategy Adviser/ Analyst (Strategy Unit)

1. Support Ministers to set the direction and strategy for health and care by:
Bringing together the Department’s leaders in the Strategy Forum, supporting it to shape the strategic direction of the department – working in close partnership with DHSC policy teams and supporting progress against the key priorities agreed with Ministers and with DHSC Executive Committee;
Making links with our key ALBs and other Government Departments, as well as external experts, academics and opinion formers to maintain a cutting edge understanding of health and social care policy

2. Support the Department to respond to the most significant strategic challenges facing health and care by:
Supporting or leading for one or more high priority strategic projects to deliver high quality, evidence-based options and recommendations for Ministers and DHSC policy teams
Supporting or leading rapid responses to commissions where the policy question spans a number of policy areas;
Using qualitative and quantitative strategic tools and techniques to answer key medium and long-term questions, including identification of emerging opportunities and challenges.

3. Support the development and embedding of strategic capability across the department by:
Contributing to the design and delivery of training on strategy tools and techniques, informally or through departmental programmes;
Sharing knowledge on what works and new policy ideas;
Encouraging close working with policy teams on projects, to share tools through on the job learning

Implementation Adviser/ Analyst (Implementation Unit)

1. Work on problem solving “deep dives” to identify and make recommendations to unblock implementation barriers, including:
Quickly grasping the IU’s tools and thinking techniques to break down complex problems;
Working collaboratively with policy teams across the Department, our ALBs, the wider Health and Social Care System and in the Prime Minister’s Implementation Unit to understand policy areas, the reasons for delivery challenges and potential solutions;
Conducting qualitative research with staff of all levels in the NHS and the Department’s ALBs, leading engaging and focused interviews to deliver impactful insights;
Taking a solutions focused approach to delivery challenges to generate workable recommendations; and
Using communication skills to translate complex qualitative and quantitative evidence into clear insights and messages for senior officials, special advisers and Ministers.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with policy teams, specifically a set of allocated ‘portfolio’ teams, keeping abreast of developments in those areas and providing briefing when required, including for the Secretary of State’s meetings with the NHS.
3. Develop the team’s support and challenge function – for specific portfolio teams and through tracking the delivery of the Department’s priority areas.
4. Build implementation capability through sharing IU tools and techniques. This includes taking a lead in delivering and presenting at the DHSC flagship Basecamp.

Financial Strategy Adviser (Spending Review Team)

1. Support development of our financial strategy for Spending Review 2020 (SR20), including:
Leading on cross-cutting financial analysis, working with colleagues to develop a clear and internally consistent overview of the Department’s financial requirements for future years; and
Developing a strong understanding of future public spending scenarios, using this to provide clear and impactful advice on the implications of these scenarios for DHSC budgets and our SR20 negotiating position.

2. Lead for the SR team on several high-profile policy areas. The successful candidate will be assigned a policy ‘portfolio’. They will work in close partnership with policy finance and analytical leads for these policy areas to:
Understand key issues with spending implications in these areas;
Develop strong proposals on future spending and reform; and
Deliver evidence-based and high-quality advice and recommendations for senior officials and Ministers.

3. Support effective programme management in the team, including:
Developing and maintaining core programme management documents; and
Providing a light-touch secretariat function for DHSC SR governance bodies.

Person specification

The ideal candidates will be able to demonstrate:
Excellent analytical skills: an ability to analyse complex issues quickly; see the big picture; take part in data-rich project work and challenge conventional thinking; utilise innovative data sources and provides constructive challenge to develop new approaches;
Strong project management capability to deliver quality work at pace, including responding to changing working circumstances;
The ability to build highly effective working relationships with a wide range of people, including policy teams across the Department and stakeholders across the health and social care system;
The ability to rapidly acquire broad knowledge of, DHSC’s policy agenda;
Excellent communication skills (both oral and written), to be able to present findings with impact;
They prioritise their own personal development, including through a culture of honest and constructive feedback; and
They uphold the values of DHSC and the wider Civil Service

Overall, these posts would be appropriate for either generalists with strong analytical skills, or analysts (e.g. an economist, statistician, operational researcher, social researcher) who are interested in developing their policy experience working on practical projects.
In the case of the Spending Review team post, the role would be well-suited for a candidate with strong finance skills.
Behaviours
We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:
Making Effective Decisions
Delivering at Pace
Seeing the Big Picture
Communicating and Influencing
Working Together
Benefits
Learning and development tailored to your role
An environment with flexible working options
A culture encouraging inclusion and diversity
A Civil Service pension

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Lyst is a search and discovery platform which connects millions of shoppers globally with the world’s leading fashion designers and stores, giving them a simpler, more engaging buying experience. We work in small, self-managing, autonomous teams with end-to-end responsibility for a specific customer-focused project. This structure brings together Lysters from all the disciplines that are needed to deliver the squad’s goals. We reward these squads for the impact they make and value the innovative approaches that autonomy and alignment can bring. We hire great people and get out of their way.
Requirements
We are looking for a Data Engineer on the Bidding & Attribution team who can help build the data pipelines, infrastructure and tooling needed to train and deploy our machine learning models.
Communication: You are able to communicate clearly and be humble when sharing ideas with everyone on the team.
Commitment to quality: You strive to write code that is readable by everyone, well tested and robust in production.
Knowledge of Machine Learning: You are interested in modern machine learning techniques and are keen to work in this area and learn more.
Motivation: You understand and are motivated by the challenge of building scalable, reliable distributed systems.
Experience with data processing in the cloud: You have experience working with large amounts of remotely hosted data and developing tools and infrastructure needed to process this.
You will also be experienced using traditional relational databases (e.g. Postgres) and have good intuition for how to write efficient SQL queries.
You will have excellent Python knowledge and experience and be up to date on best Python practices.
What will you be working on?
Data engineering: Designing the Extract, Transform and Load pipeline to process data from our data warehouse / data lake into a form suitable for training machine learning models.
Backend systems: Working across all backend systems to ensure the data we need is gathered and stored in our data lake, and also writing the backend systems to train and serve models.
Full stack: Some full stack work to enable our main website to be able to query and use the ML model predictions in real time.
Analytics, Reporting and Monitoring: Developing reports and dashboards to monitor both the training and prediction performance of our models.
We work mainly in Python, running on a range of AWS technologies such as S3, ECS, SQS, Glue, Sagemaker and Postgres RDS, along with non-AWS tools such as Snowflake, CircleCI, Docker and Github.
We have high engineering standards and practice comprehensive testing, code reviews, continuous integration and continuous deployment across all engineering teams.
Things that matter to us:
You are pragmatic and you like engaging with hard engineering problems.
You like all things about data, passing it around, parsing it, storing it and reporting on it.
You are curious at heart and like to take ownership of something to make it better.
You are a team player and communicate with your peers and other stakeholders in the company on a day to day basis
Being confronted with a difficult or strange problem makes you feel like a detective that wants to crack the mystery.
You enjoy nurturing your colleagues and empowering the team to the fullest of their ability.
Benefits
You get 29 days’ time off throughout the year to take a well earned rest. There’s also the 8 public bank holidays too
Private Healthcare by Vitality. Your health is important to us which is why we offer all employees a comprehensive healthcare scheme from the day you start
The Lyst Clothing Benefit. We're a fashion company, so we'll give you £250 to spend on the site in Year 1, £500 in Year 2, £750 in Year 3 and £1000 from Year 4 onwards. You're going to look fantastic!
Conferences and events. We’re big on learning and development, so all Lysters get £1500 to spend on courses and training
Discounted eye tests and glasses
Team meet-ups, social events, sports and exercise events
Cycle-to-work scheme
Childcare vouchers
Transport season ticket loans

Title: VP Sales EMEA
Description:
Founded in mid-2015 to make consumer research simple and accessible for anyone, anywhere, Attest is a fast-growing scaleup backed by investors including Silicon Valley leader NEA. Attest is striving toward a world in which anyone can put consumers and data at the heart of every decision, to create and deliver better, more useful services, products and experiences for real people and communities worldwide.

In 2019, our team tripled to nearly 100 people, and together we achieved huge commercial, technical and people success. Our plans for 2020 and beyond are big and exciting, and our team is growing fast.

A robust set of shared values unites our team. We invest in each other to ensure every Attester has the opportunity, support and encouragement to realise their full potential. We strongly believe everyone should have the autonomy to freely explore new ideas and have a voice in shaping the future of Attest, whilst making sure that the work we do genuinely makes a difference.

What you’ll be doing

Collaborative leadership. Collaborating closely with our commercial leadership, commercial teams and the wider Attest team, you will lead us to deliver ambitious growth targets for new client ARR. Using your deep sales acumen and customer-centric approach, you will enjoy mentoring and supporting team leads and individual team members to drive engagement and performance to ever new heights across the commercial team.

Strategic focus and planning. You will have experience of setting directional goals across commercial disciplines at a strategic level, and default to defining clearly and pragmatically at the outset what you will need from the wider team to support the team’s success in delivering against those goals, being proactive, forward looking and collaborative in your approach to execution of plans.

Hiring, coaching and training. Developing, coaching, and continuously learning together is core to our shared values at Attest. You will embody this approach, leading by example. You’ll work closely with the team leads and wider team to help everything fit together seamlessly, and to be greater than the sum of its parts. You will be someone who gains energy from spending your day to day focused on helping your team do their very best through a blend of effective coaching, training, and other team growth and support activities.

Lead by example. Your leadership style will reflect the values and behaviours you wish to see in members of the commercial team. You default to supporting the team through consistent and positive encouragement, taking existing structures and working with the team to instil a learning mindset, and through giving individual team members the specific tools they need to become ever more accomplished sales professionals.

An eye for detail and blend of instinct, data and expertise for improvement. Along with credibility and deep sales acumen, you will have a great eye for detail, capable of applying a suitable blend of domain expertise, data and instinct to experiment, test, adapt and deliver positive movement in our sales metrics. From conversion rates and sales cycle, to deal size and team productivity.

Codify best practices. Continuously improving, to ensure you’re always using and establishing best practices based on what works at Attest and for the team, together with lessons/experiences gained outside Attest, you’ll be well versed in combining these with the data available to you (and which you will seek out) to identify and lean into patterns of success. You will have experience of codifying these best practices in a clear, easy to digest format for the team and wider business to read and revisit on our internal information sharing platform, Notion.

Product-led. You will gain a deep understanding of the Mission and Vision of Attest, and become a true evangelist for our product goals, taking responsibility for guiding us to ensure the overall commercial goals of the business remain aligned with product goals through the fog of the day-to-day commercial operations, including taking a high-level view on customer feature requests that will inevitably surface over time. You will understand the important role you have to play in maintaining cohesion between the often friction-filled product and commercial sides of a business, building strong relationships with the product and engineering teams you work with, to unite, promote and support the wider team to operate in a truly cross-functional environment.

Talent and productivity. You will know the importance of finding and hiring exceptional talent timely and consistently in anticipation of the goals you are seeking to achieve. You’ll manage your talent pipeline in the same way you manage sales pipelines, so that it is predictable, repeatable and sets you and the team up for the best possible outcome. You will understand the role you play in the hiring process, and what needs to happen to help every team member reach productivity and their best possible outcomes, quickly. From successfully and consistently on-boarding each person, with a foundation in Attest’s on-boarding and knowledge-building processes with adaptations to support your team, you will be trusted to develop and evolve your team with Attest’s hiring model and focus on continuous learning and improvement.

Collaborating. As one of the senior revenue leaders, we will trust you from Day 1 to grow this function, make decisions and show true cultural leadership at the same time. We will trust you to do this through finding the right balance of collaboration, co-creation, and education.

Data and data sharing. We are a data driven business, and you will be expected to provide regular, accurate reports and forecasts. Across our wider team, we use data not as blunt tools, but to facilitate better collaboration and decision-making. In commercial, this will include everything from you getting creative with activities, leaderboards and incentives for your team, through to detailed and insightful commentary on various metrics that you will be responsible for to help the wider team gain an ever better understanding and empathy for the commercial operations and how we can optimise for success across all disciplines based on that data.

Who you are

An empathetic and confident leader. You have a passion for people and their progression, whichever form that might take, and whether with Attest or not. You define your success based on their success, take time to truly get to know what success means to them, and flex your coaching style and approach to help elicit the best from all.

Analytical. You’re confident working with dashboards, data and technology. You know how to utilise insights to drive performance across the team. You know what metrics to look for, what good looks like, what exceptional looks like, and the most valuable data to focus on. Experience of Salesforce and other sales tools is essential to hit the ground running.

A builder. You’re happy to establish and embed new processes into a team, while being open to feedback and new ways of doing things. You can find, hire, train and retain talent. You’re always focused on the critical path to success, looking for blockers, finding ways to remove them, and thinking about future scalability while achieving today’s goals.

Team player. You have the wisdom to know that you don’t know everything, and the humility to ask for help from those around you. You want to be part of a wider team of leaders, celebrating shared successes, and collaborating with colleagues from a range of exciting areas/backgrounds.

Ambitious. You’ll be ambitious for your team, the company and our clients. Always pushing for greater achievements and value creation, while providing the necessary support to get there. Attest has a huge, global opportunity to create a new category. You’ll play a pivotal role in helping us achieve great goals.

The Interview Process

You can see an overview of the interview process, including who is involved, on this page.

We believe in full transparency. We know that applying for a role and spending time with us in interviews is a significant commitment of your time and energy. We appreciate that there are many companies out there hiring, and there are only so many processes you will be able to commit to participating in fully, so having some visibility of what the process will include may help you plan and choose how to spend your time and energy. We publish our interview process for each role transparently from the start, so you have full visibility of the stages, the things we'll be covering, whether there is a task involved, and who you are likely to meet during the process.

We're always open to and welcoming of candidate feedback on the interview experience with Attest, and in particular, on the process outlined - if there are folks you think are important for you to meet to get to know us better and help strengthen your decision of whether to join us, please let us know as soon as possible, so we can make adjustments to the overall process as necessary; we may not always be able to make it happen, but we'll definitely try!
In return, we’ll give you…

Our benefits and perks are designed with a focus on the wellbeing, engagement, and growth of our Attesters. In addition to the below overview, we publish details on all benefits available, including location-specific benefits, openly and transparently on our Notion pages.

>A competitive salary - that fairly recognises your experience and potential;
>25 days (UK) or 23 days (US) paid holiday (+public holidays) per year - we care about our team’s wellbeing, so we make sure you have time to fully switch off, rest, and recharge;
>Up to 2 additional full company days off annually for Attest's Christmas 'office closure'. These are set by Attest, and are usually the days of Christmas Eve and New Years Eve to the extent they fall on business days. We will let everyone know in advance which days will these will be.
>Flexible working hours and remote working - whether you have parental responsibilities, just need some headspace, or prefer to structure your working balance a bit differently, we value responsible autonomy and default to trust; we’ll support you in making your work and personal life a manageable blend. We're currently working fully remotely due to covid-19; you can read more about how we approach that in our Guide to fully remote working at Attest.
>10% time - to invest in charitable activities, your growth and development, and/or side projects for Attest;
>10 fully-paid sick days per year - mental health and physical health are treated equally at Attest and apply regardless of location. Whether you’ve been knocked out with the flu, are having an operation, or need some time off to manage anxiety, stress or depression, for example, we encourage all our Attesters to rest up and come back when they’re feeling more like themselves;
> £/$500 per person annual Growth & Development fund - we care deeply about your personal and professional growth and development, so in addition to other structured Growth & Development initiatives we offer throughout the year, we also provide every Attester with £/$500 via Sunlight.is annually, to spend on courses, books and further development of your choosing.
>Sanctus - Remote coaching sessions with fully qualified coaches 2 x per month through Sanctus. Sessions are private to you and your coach, and a space for you to use as you see fit. As coaches are usually UK based, we ask all Attesters to be mindful of booking afternoon slots where morning slots are available, to be considerate of our international colleagues who may only be able to make use of slots that fall later in the day.
> 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - all Attesters have access to Employee Assistance Programmes, including accessing confidential telephone counselling 24/7, advice on debt, housing, and beyond.
>High-quality Equipment - we’ll invest to provide you with the right tools and set-up to help you do your best work;
>A values-led working environment - that encourages putting people first, honesty, curiosity and leadership.
> A Dog Friendly work environment - during coronavirus, we've gone fully remote. But in our previous office and in future offices, we're a dog-friendly bunch!

Is this role not quite the right fit for you? Or, have you not seen a suitable position available on our careers site? We’re always on the look-out for curious, motivated and bright people to join our team. Connect with us, and we’ll let you know if and when we have new opportunities.

Diversity at Attest

Everyone's welcome at Attest, regardless of what you look like, where you come from or what you’re curious about. Our product is for everyone, globally, and so is our work space. The more diverse our range of perspectives in our business, the more we all thrive, together. So tell us about your background, personal experiences and perspective on the world and help us further enrich our offering to enable better made decisions to make the world a better place.

Do let us know if there are any adjustments you’d like us to make to ensure the most inclusive interview process we can - we’re learning too, so we’re more than happy to adapt and accommodate whenever possible.

Attest aims to change the way decisions are made, and to help people understand the data that responds to their curiosity. Our mission is to put data at the heart of decisions. Everything we do at Attest is driven by curiosity, honesty, responsible autonomy and collaboration. Our team is growing - will you be next to join the adventure?

Title: Product Owner
Description:
Product Owner

Please note: the planned start date for this role is September 2020, but subject to change.

Concirrus

Concirrus is on a mission to change the way that insurance works forever.
You might live in a ‘safe’ area with your car parked in a garage overnight, but what if you spend all day driving around on congested motorways at a high risk of a crash? From an insurer’s point of view, shouldn’t your insurance premium reflect your daily behaviour rather than your demographic data i.e. where you live.

The fact is, behaviour is a much better indicator of risk than demographics and, working with some of the leading marine and motor insurers utilising our software Quest, we are proving this to be true.
Quest is a beautifully designed and intuitive web app built upon cutting edge technical architecture. It pulls together multiple sources of industry data, combines that with an insurer’s own data and uses big data analytics, developed by our in-house team, to derive new behavioural insights for our customers.

With backing from insurance and deep tech investors, co-founders with previous start up experience, and a clever and passionate team based in London and Delhi, we’re looking for exceptional people excited by our vision to help us make it happen.
The Role

Developing products that solve real problems for our customers is at the heart of everything we do, and we’re on the hunt for an exceptional Product Owner to work across our Quest platforms that are changing the game in commercial marine insurance.
The challenges facing the marine insurance market are well publicised. There has never been so much pressure to consider alternatives to the status quo. At Concirrus, we’ve developed products that take advantage of the growing availability of data to help the market see risks in a new light: based on the day-to-day behaviour of fleets.

We’re looking for a Product Owner to be a part of the team responsible for our Quest Marine products, and to help us continue to revolutionise marine insurance.
You will be based in our London office, working with a talented, diverse team in both London and Delhi, helping to produce innovative software that is entirely new to the insurance market.

You will be critical in understanding customer requirements and translating these into implementable product specifications, user stories and development tasks.
You will work directly with the product, delivery and data science departments to ensure that our innovative vision is carried right through from idea to technical implementation. You will be responsible for ensuring that the product roadmap is well understood, and the development backlog is well prioritised to ensure we are developing the right things at the right time.
Major Responsibilities
Gathering requirements from the business and working to help define delivery goals.
Writing high quality user stories and tasks ready for development.
Collaborating closely with UI & UX to maintain a high quality user experience throughout our product.
Overseeing features through from specification to production, doing user acceptance testing to ensure quality outputs.
Managing the Jira backlog and coordinating with product management to ensure pragmatic progression towards the product goals.
Collecting feedback and input from users and internal stakeholders (where relevant) to inform improvements to the product.
Giving input to the delivery life cycle and helping the team to achieve the most effective workflow.


Key Attributes

Essential:
Strong commercial experience working as a business analyst, product owner or similar.
Experience taking a product from inception through to production, with the ability to write high and low-level requirements that accurately describe the given business problem.
Experience across the end-to-end requirement engineering process.
A proven track record working within a software team; ability to understand the technical and non-technical challenges faced on a daily basis.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders. You should demonstrate the ability to work proactively whilst remaining true to the overall business objectives.
Astute and professional with the ability to describe the complex in a simple way to all levels of business stakeholders.
Results oriented and able to independently complete tasks to deadline.
Strong analytical skills.
Working experience within an agile environment.


Nice to have:
SQL / Excel skills.
Working familiarity of Confluence and Jira.
Insurance industry domain knowledge.
Relevant professional certifications (e.g. IIBA's CBAP, BCS).


Benefits

As well as the opportunity to work on projects that you enjoy in an environment you’ll love, we like to look after our team members at Concirrus. Here are some of our perks…
Flexible, outcome driven, working environment.
We pay competitively with regular pay reviews.
Share option scheme so you get to own a piece of the pie.
Pension scheme with generously matched contribution.
Private medical insurance (from September).
Learning & Development fund for all employees.
25 days annual leave (plus public holidays).
Spacious, modern offices a stone’s throw from the culinary delights of Borough Market, and with a pub almost on our doorstep. The office is located on St Thomas Street, opposite The Shard.
Coffee and snacks are all on hand in the office to keep you fuelled.
Friday FED talks – like TED talks, but you get fed (on us).
Monthly team drinks, birthday cakes and social events.
Season Ticket Loan and Cycle2Work schemes, plus seasonal flu vaccinations.
Plus, we’re always on the lookout for creative ways to look after our employees and encourage them to come to us when they have an idea or need.

Description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by our job advert. We’re Community Fibre and our mission is to bring better internet to everyone. You won’t find any old and slow copper technology here, our network is full fibre and that’s directly to our customers so whether you’re a gamer, you have lots of data hungry family members or you love to chill out and download a movie we will have a package for you.

The clue is in our name and we love working with local communities in London. We want to bridge the digital divide in society and make internet accessible to all. We also love when we can welcome residents from the local community becoming team members of CFL, over 20% of our talent is from local communities that we serve.

We are not the new kid on the block, we were established in 2013 and some of our key achievements since then include:

Raised £90m investment from large institutions.
Acquired over 360,000 wayleaves across Local Authorities, Housing Associations and Private Landlords.
Deployed our full fibre infrastructure to over 100,000 premises.

So far we’re proud of our achievements and we are doing a great job disrupting the broadband industry but we are definitely not stopping here. To help us we’re looking for forward thinkers, people with big ideas, people passionate about technology and most importantly hard workers to join us and help support our growing business.

Job purpose:
We are continuing to grow rapidly and to support the next stage of our growth we need a Delivery Manager to lead the installations of our fibre optic network. The Delivery Managers duty is to coordinate the successful completion of Distribution installations, ensure that contractor work is following CFL standards, and where required take a more proactive lead in completing installations. To ensure that each project is delivered as planned the Delivery Manager will oversee the civil and cabling installation, splicing and testing elements of our build contractors to ensure that our network is presented on time for any external project stakeholders. What you’ll be doing:
Manage the quality of the installations of distribution project sites whether internally or externally with contractor.
Supervising contractor installation teams, ensuring that any project-specific quality or technical standards are well understood by the CF and Contractor teams.
Assist Project Manager in key tasks associated to client sites including; performance managing contractor resource, reporting and site handover documentation.
Ensuring splicing, testing and reporting on our optical network is carried out to a standard as outlined by the CF standard splicing at testing documentation.
Assess works completed by a 3rd party to allow sign off.
Verifying at relevant project stages (‘sign-off’) that these standards have been achieved (or triggering remedial action required)
Ensure that CF H&S requirements are always being adhered to

The experience we’re looking for you to bring:
Understand of FTTP, Openreach network and Civils delivery
Thorough working knowledge of a fibre network build through significant job experience and training on site
Experience of managing teams and effectively managing performance
Experience and Qualification within street works. Understanding of the New Roads & Streetworks Act
Experience of working on the Openreach Network - desirable
Experience splicing, testing and fault finding on fibre optic networks
Demonstrate the ability to talk the ‘same language’ as civils and cabling contractors
Demonstrable experience of working with/for telecommunications operators or service partners.
Proven Experience completing 1st and 2nd fix customer installations
BT accredited splicing qualification
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Project.

Why join us:
You get to work with some of the best technology in the market
Be part of an exciting scale up business where you can bring your ideas, bring your knowledge, we value your contribution
We all love time off whether that’s going on an exotic holiday or a staycation, you’ll get 25 days holiday to enjoy, increasing by 1 day for each year of service up to 28 days
Birthday leave, our treat to you
Keen cyclist, join our cycle to work scheme
Enjoy the perks of Vitality health
You get to work with an amazing bunch of people

What happens next:
You’ve done your bit so sit back and relax, we will review your application and come back to you.

If we think you’re not quite right for the role you have applied for but may be a better fit for another, we’ll definitely let you know.

Want to know more about a career at CFL, check out our careers page: https://communityfibre.co.uk/jobs

We are an equal opportunities employer that values diversity in our team, we welcome applications from all backgrounds.

Title: Content Manager
Description:
ABOUT DECODED
We are Decoded, the pioneers of transformative technology education. We democratise cutting edge skills. We help transform traditional businesses into tech companies. We give our learners the skills and confidence to embrace the future of work.
Our products and methodologies have been shaped through our collaboration with some of the largest and most technologically progressive organisations in the world. We use the intelligent, ethical and creative application of technology to lay the foundations for a more productive and promising world – one with unlimited possibilities.

OVERVIEW
Decoded is on a mission to democratise the world of digital technology and data science. Through our in-house learning programmes at large companies around the world, we educate 10,000s of professionals every single year. We empower them to enrich their working lives through more positive, productive and ethical uses of digital technologies.
That makes Decoded an exciting place to work. As an organisation we stand at the centre of technology, learning and creativity.
We have incredible talent in London, New York, Hong Kong and Sydney. We have an incredible set of clients. We also have an incredibly ambitious growth trajectory. That means we need to foster relationships with more brilliant people and large organisations around the world.
And while we have an amazing track record when it comes to conceiving, crafting and delivering world-class learning experiences, we’re not amazing at creating and producing world-class content and getting it in front of prospective clients.
We’re therefore looking to hire our first ever specialist Content person. This is a new role, with plenty of opportunities to shape the scope for whoever joins the team.
Broadly, it will be a hugely creative and strategic role, where you’ll be working alongside the Decoded Commercial Team to stimulate demand from new clients and deepen demand from existing clients. You’ll also work with the People team to help surface and celebrate what an amazing place Decoded is to work for prospective new joiners to Decoded.
You’ll manage your own quarterly budget, and while you’ll start with nailing the basics of content – making the quality of our website content, LinkedIn content and case-study content as strong as our learning experiences – you’ll then have the opportunity to take Decoded content to exciting, uncharted territories.

ACCOUNTABILITIES
As Content Manager, you will own content for Decoded. You'll play a key role in the success of our marketing strategies, creating content that engages, delivers value and drives action for both our client and learner audiences.
Sitting within the Commercial Team, you'll report into the Managing Partner, but work cross-functionally with other Commercial Team members as well as colleagues from Product and Operations.
You'll be hands-on – commissioning and creating content across a variety of media, taking projects from brief to completion, as well as managing a network of freelancers and expert contributors.

SPECIFIC ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES
Content will be a key part of our growth strategy, and we've got ambitious goals for where it can take us. We want someone who gets excited by a challenge, has a vision and can execute on it, as well as not being afraid to shake up the status quo.
Own the production of content at Decoded, creating high quality, engaging and shareable content for a range of audiences
Manage and grow our network of contributors, enabling us to source and create amazing content on a regular basis
Work with teams across the business, from Commercial to Product to the Founders, to support and drive their content needs
Amplify and develop the Decoded brand through content
Own and be the driving force behind the growth of our owned media channels, in particular, LinkedIn and the Decoded website
Use your insight and experience to help drive the content, SEO and wider marketing strategy
Own reporting and insight for content, using data to measure the success of campaigns and to help define new ones

SKILLS & BEHAVIOURS
Your performance will be driven by a mindset built on:
Fearlessly leading people and building brilliant and productive relationships with colleagues, clients and partners alike
Solving problems elegantly and creatively: “find a way or make a way”
Taking accountability for your own success, and the success of others
Aside from that, you’ll:
Have a passion for writing and the power of content marketing
Highly organised and resourceful, and have experience of finding and managing freelancers/contributors
Think both big and small – by getting inside of the mind of the end-user, but also able to step back and create content that aligns with, and helps to achieve, big objectives
Be excited about b2b social media marketing and creating engaging content that brings value to people
Have experience with data and reporting, and know how to measure the success of their content – using that insight to influence future work

WHO ARE YOU?
You have experience in managing the development and production of content and campaigns in a fast-paced, commercial environment
You are a good communicator and can lead projects confidently
You have a track record in delivering content on time, and on budget
You are passionate about Decoded’s mission and creating an impact through learning
You thrive working in a cross-functional team environment

TEAM & REPORTING STRUCTURE
In the London office, you’ll sit in the Commercial Team, alongside Account Management and New Business. You will report directly into the Managing Partners who oversee the Commercial Team.

DAY-TO-DAY
The Content Manager’s day will be a mix of internal and external meetings, managing the Decoded team around them and head-down work.
The typical Decoded working week is 09:00 – 18:00, Monday to Friday. When we talk about working late, we mean working until 18:30 – it’s important to us that your evenings and weekends are always yours.

LEARNING & PROGRESSION
The Commercial Team gains full exposure to Decoded learning programmes. So when it comes to future-proofing your CV, you couldn’t be better placed. In just a few months at Decoded you’ll gain cutting-edge data skills and become fluent in digital technologies and innovation, and you’ll continue to refresh and refine this knowledge for the duration of your career here.
Beyond that, we run a dedicated learning calendar to hone craft skills content creation, storytelling, management and other relevant disciplines.
Quarterly reviews embedded within our culture of feedback will ensure you progress swiftly in your role at Decoded. While there’s a relatively flat hierarchy in the business, you should expect to be growing your level of responsibility on an ongoing basis and pushing for promotions in line with improving performance.

APART FROM THE ABOVE WORKING AT DECODED MEANS YOU'LL GET
A competitive salary
28 days’ holiday per year, inclusive of the 8 bank holidays. We also close for two full weeks at Christmas, at Decoded's discretion
Company pension contributions
Private health care including dental, GP, hospital cover and a gym-discount to help you prioritise your wellbeing
Travel insurance
The opportunity to join a high growth company
A work environment that values creativity, personal growth and collaboration
Continuous learning and development: you will be challenged with lots of responsibility and exciting projects in an environment that encourages learning
A huge array of social events including themed Christmas get-togethers and a summer away day as well as monthly drinks and activities
Monthly team breakfast, fresh fruit every day, drinks and snacks
Flexible working and working from home when you need to
Cutting edge software and kit, always

Title: Delivery Manager
Description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by our job advert. We’re Community Fibre and our mission is to bring better internet to everyone. You won’t find any old and slow copper technology here, our network is full fibre and that’s directly to our customers so whether you’re a gamer, you have lots of data hungry family members or you love to chill out and download a movie we will have a package for you.

The clue is in our name and we love working with local communities in London. We want to bridge the digital divide in society and make internet accessible to all. We also love when we can welcome residents from the local community becoming team members of CFL, over 20% of our talent is from local communities that we serve.

We are not the new kid on the block, we were established in 2013 and some of our key achievements since then include:

Raised £90m investment from large institutions.
Acquired over 360,000 wayleaves across Local Authorities, Housing Associations and Private Landlords.
Deployed our full fibre infrastructure to over 100,000 premises.

So far we’re proud of our achievements and we are are doing a great job disrupting the broadband industry but we are definitely not stopping here. To help us we’re looking for forward thinkers, people with big ideas, people passionate about technology and most importantly hard workers to join us and help support our growing business.

Job purpose:
We are continuing to grow rapidly and to support the next stage of our growth we need a Delivery Manager to lead the installations of our fibre optic network.

The Delivery Manager’s duty is to coordinate the successful completion of installations, ensure that contractor work is in compliance with CFL standards, and where required take a more proactive lead in completing installations. To ensure that each project is delivered as planned the Delivery Manager will oversee the civil and cabling installation, splicing and testing elements of our build contractors to ensure that our network is presented on time for any external project stakeholders. The task objectives are to support the project manager in ensuring project milestones are completed on time, within budget and to the standards and quality set by the business or our clients.

What you’ll be doing:
Supervising contractor 1st fix installation teams, ensuring that any project-specific quality or technical standards are well understood by the Community Fibre and Contractor teams.
Assist Project Manager in key tasks associated to client sites including; performance managing contractor resource, reporting and site handover documentation.
Ensuring splicing, testing and reporting on our optical network is carried out to a standard as outlined by the CF standard splicing at testing documentation.
Assess works completed by a 3rd party to allow sign off.
Verifying at relevant project stages (‘sign-off’) that these standards have been achieved (or triggering remedial action required).
Ensure that Community Fibre H&S requirements are being adhered to at all times

The experience we’re looking for you to bring:
Understand of FTTP, Openreach network and Civils delivery.
Thorough working knowledge of a fibre network build through significant job experience and training on site.
Experience of managing teams and effectively managing performance.
Experience and qualification within street works. Understanding of the New Roads & Streetworks Act.
Experience of working on the Openreach Network – desirable.
Experience splicing, testing and fault finding on fibre optic networks.
Demonstrate the ability to talk the ‘same language’ as civils and cabling contractors.
Demonstrable experience of working with/for telecommunications operators or service partners.
Proven Experience completing 1st and 2nd fix customer installations.
BT accredited splicing qualification.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Project.

Why join us:
You get to work with some of the best technology in the market
Be part of an exciting scale up business where you can bring your ideas, bring your knowledge, we value your contribution
We all love time off whether that’s going on an exotic holiday or a staycation, you’ll get 25 days holiday to enjoy, increasing by 1 day for each year of service up to 28 days
Birthday leave, our treat to you
Keen cyclist, join our cycle to work scheme
Enjoy the perks of Vitality health
You get to work with an amazing bunch of people

What happens next:
You’ve done your bit so sit back and relax, we will review your application and come back to you.

If we think you’re not quite right for the role you have applied for but may be a better fit for another, we’ll definitely let you know.

Want to know more about a career at CFL, check out our careers page: https://communityfibre.co.uk/jobs

We are an equal opportunities employer that values diversity in our team, we welcome applications from all backgrounds.

Customer/client facing approach

Title: Data & Analytics Delivery Manager, Energy Trading, London
Description:
The Opportunity
Are you a confident and curious individual, who is passionate about helping clients shape and deliver sustainable data & advanced analytics capabilities? If yes, then read on!
This role will be joining a community of consulting professionals at DMW who are helping clients keep pace with cloud, digital and data modernisation, and in particular will help us resolve some of their biggest challenges faced in transforming energy, and trading analytics. You’ll need to bring with you the technical acumen, principles and knowledge to be credible in this constantly changing landscape, but also the modesty, imagination and logic to help our clients navigate, challenge and reform existing norms.

Requirements:
Here’s what you will do
DMW is different to many other consultancies, in that we expect our consultants to deliver and lead by example to the interests of our clients, as trusted advisors, with a focus on enabling effective use of insight and associated technology by their staff and customers; not doing it for them.
As a managing consultant you’ll work autonomously or leading a team, to engage with our existing clients and prospective leads on establishing progressive technical, people & process change to meet their data & analytics needs. You’ll help us grow our practice and shape offerings in the space of energy & trading, as well as our core data & analytics enablement capabilities; including data strategy, data platforms, service-oriented design for data & analytics, continuous intelligence, and scaled agile (value-stream led delivery). You’ll be expected to lead projects and even programmes with diverse teams and skillsets, and help our clients transform their businesses into organisations that are not just data-led, but appropriately prepared for the changing face of business and digital emphasis post COVID-19.

Location
Based in the vibrant and modern Labs House, we are a stone’s throw away from Holborn station. Boasting coffee lounges, co-working spaces, ping pong/table tennis tables, free on-site gym and weekly yoga classes all the way through to fortnightly free breakfasts.
Hours
This is a permanent full-time office-based role. However, we do consider flexible ways of working that allow the best outcomes for our team.

Responsibilities
Manage data and analytics capability delivery projects using Agile & Waterfall techniques, balancing scope, quality and cost to deliver outcomes agreed with the business within available budget
Management and resolution of issues, mitigation of risks that could impact the project or programme
Lead capability to develop rich data visualisation dashboards for data analysis, reconciliations and reporting
Lead production of design artefacts to describe key components and interactions for development by self and team
Lead transition of implementation for support and maintenance
Lead capability to produce prototypes by quickly translating requirements into demonstrable data pipelines and iterate solution in short cycles
Interrogate platform data sources and produce views of useful information to meet various business requirements
Bring project rigour to delivery innovation; particularly cost and benefit
Support customers with business change and benefits realisation activities
Support customer with data & analytics strategy definition
Stakeholder management (Customer business, IT, external leads & DMW)
Lead sprint planning to decompose stories/PBIs into tasks and provide estimates.
Lead maintenance and enhancement of data engineering SDLCs and frameworks.
Ensure customer delivery is resourced for success (recruitment of key project roles)
Requirements
Experience of delivering business value through data in Energy trading environments, either in a technology or delivery role
Experience in benefits model development, tracking and realisation
Experience of support and diagnosis in a data pipeline environment
Experience in business case development and creation of financial memoranda
Experience of Price and Fundamental data use
Experience of developing dashboards using data visualisation tools such as Power BI & Tableau
Experience of leveraging and combining data from large data warehouses, optimising queries and consuming data from APIs
Experience of leading projects in excess of $3m annual spend
Ideally, experience of big data engineering environments
Experience in toolsets for agile delivery management and DevOps; for example Azure DevOps (ADO) or JIRA.
Cloud certification in Solution Architecture or Data; for AWS, Azure or Google
SQL or Python skills for analysis
PRINCE2 or PMP certification
Data migration delivery experience.
Familiarity with ETL concepts and solutions
Familiarity with streaming data solutions
STEM academic background
Experience of continuous integration/deployment and development techniques
Exposure to Apache Foundation and Modern Data Warehouse Technologies, and associated commercial frameworks. (e.g. Spark, Databricks).

In addition, you will have an:
Analytical mindset – data driven ability to problem solve and refine engineering requirements
Service oriented – understand principles of DevOps & ITIL and maintaining provision of products and services to consumers.
Attention to detail – focus on rigour and completeness of investigation, and consideration for the needs of BP customers
Be a good communicator – able to deliver messages effectively, with good verbal communication skills, and act as an independent voice within a collaborative team.
Be self-motivated and self-starting – able to work with little supervision and unfamiliar concepts quickly. Be confident in their judgement.
Delivery-Oriented Leadership – Able to lead ‘best practice’ over big data, analytics, engineering and platform delivery spaces, draw consumer parallels, and drive out implementation alignment between those capabilities
Desirable skills
Scrum or Agile delivery methodology certification

Benefits:
This is what you get in return
We’ve grown consistently over the years and offer an entrepreneurial environment within which to embark upon an exciting career path, where your contribution really counts, and we will recognise it. With personalised development opportunities, experienced colleagues and exciting client assignments, progression can be extremely rapid for high performers. We are a social bunch of people and go out as a team on a regular basis. You can also expect:
A highly collaborative working environment and great rates of pay (including base salary and bonus potential).
A range of flexible benefits consisting of well-being and lifestyle benefits.
A commitment to your development & continuous growth of skills through one-to-one mentoring and wide-ranging hands-on experience.
25 days’ holiday and the ability to flex this to 30 days if you chose to do so.
2 day’s CSR volunteering days.
Award-winning learning and development opportunities, including dedicated personal training budgets and time and a wide range of choice in training courses.
A dedicated personal budget to choose the IT equipment of your choice.
Here’s a little more about us and what we value
Independent, award-winning and ambitious, DMW are a technology and management consulting firm that places a high value on people, which is why we have been recognised as a Great Place to Work™ consecutively for the last 5 years. We believe we offer a significantly better work-life balance than in other IT consultancies because you are involved every step of the way, making career decisions together.
DMW is widely recognised as the place where smart, technically curious, ambitious people who value their integrity and independence want to work. We offer rewarding careers to people who are driven by the desire to do exciting work for ambitious clients.
We have helped improve some of the biggest organisations in the UK and Europe across three core sectors: Finance and Insurance, Energy and Commercial and the Public Sector. Solving complex technology problems to create competitive advantage through the advanced application of Cloud, Digital and Data technologies; growing revenues, reducing costs, and improving efficiency and effectiveness for our clients.
DMW Group is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society. We believe that diversity makes us a stronger team so seek to employ people with different ideas, styles and skill sets, each able to contribute in unique ways to our organisation’s growth and success.
