We’re LandTech. We’re the award-winning tech startup building platforms to bring much-needed innovation to the property industry. We started with LandInsight, which made it easier to find and assess off-market land. Then we launched LandEnhance, bringing tech to the planning sector. And we’ve got plenty more in the pipeline.

We’re the fastest-growing PropTech company in the UK. And PropTech just happens to be one of the fastest-growing sectors in the UK too.

Imagine what that could do for your career progression.

About You

As our CTO, you will take full ownership of our product architecture, our technical output, our technical strategy and roadmap, our technical teams and our technical culture – everything technical.

With that in mind, and although this is not a hands-on coding position, we of course need someone with a strong technical pedigree and a background in software and data engineering. You’ll therefore be working closely with the Head of Engineering (Interim) and Engineering Leads, bearing in mind that we do have a flat and inclusive engineering culture where everyone’s opinion is valued, so you’ll work closely with everyone!

We’d like a CTO who is still very passionate about technology and wants to create high-quality products with excellent customer experiences. You should be able to challenge and mentor engineers, remove blockers and ultimately be our answer to all things tech.

As the CTO you will also partner with our Product, Customer Success and Sales teams to ensure everyone is aligned and delivering meaningful output with the customer in mind.

Working closely with the two co-founders (and everyone else) you will help drive the business forwards, scale, innovate and internationalise.

Requirements
Recent experience working in a SaaS company
Start Up/Scale Up experience
Experience working within a company that has grown at a rapid scale (We have big plans!)
Has experience working very closely with a Head of/VP of Product
Our company is built on data therefore having someone that can bring a lot of knowledge on the data side is a bonus
Ideally has had experience of aligning multiple products to one technical strategy and roadmap
Has experience of international markets

Responsibilities

Long term technical vision, responsible for the Technical Roadmap Strategy for the next 3+ Years
Aligning this technical strategy with the business requirements
The CTO will have oversight of the whole department. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering and Head of Product

Our Tech and Principles

Linux, Docker, Shell Script, Python, TypeScript, Node.js, Vue.js
Data stores such as Mongo, Postgres (RDS) and ElasticSearch
CI and CI/CD via CircleCI and Kubernetes
AWS (EB, EC2, S3, Lambda) and Kubernetes (Kops, ELK stack, Grafana+Prometheus, Istio, Argo)
A mixture of Lean/DevOps and Agile principles
Collaborative, test-first, automated, fast-feedback, craftsmanship software principles
Our engineering values are Confidence, Creativity, Collaboration and Excellence

Company Culture

Our company was built on three core values: ‘open’, ‘empower’ and ‘home’

We believe that businesses (and people) do their best work when they’re working collaboratively. That means you’ll be working directly with everyone in the business, right up to the co-founders Jonny and Andrew.

It’s this attitude that saw us voted the 3rd best UK SaaS Company to work for, and receive awards for ‘Best at Employee Development’.

And, of course, we offer some great perks...

Benefits
Competitive salary and equity options
Flexible working hours
25 days paid holiday (plus flexi-bank holidays)
Unlimited unpaid holidays
Professional and personal training budget
Gym and wellness contributions, and a cycle to work scheme
Dog-friendly office
Lots of social events, including a quarterly away day, an annual ski trip and monthly socials

Title: STRATEGY MANAGER
Description:
THE GIG
Dr. Martens is looking for an exceptional individual to support the Head of Brand Strategy & Insights in building and protecting Dr. Martens' brand equity. Understanding our consumers and developing strategies to drive cultural relevance is more important than ever as Dr. Martens continues to expand its footprint across the globe. As Strategy Manager, you will help to plan, set up, run and track progress on a number of strategic projects, both ad-hoc and ongoing. Projects will typically involve cross-functional teams with both global and regional input, and as such this role will require a collaborative approach, working closely with the Strategy & Insights Statistician and Value Creation team.
WHAT SETS YOU APART
Brand strategy and Insights
Project manage ongoing research (e.g. brand health quarterly tracker and annual deep-dive survey) as well as new, ad hoc research as necessary, including those insights projects owned by the Head of Value Creation aimed at operational improvements (e.g. pricing, store experience etc.)
Own the relationship with our survey partner, ensuring consistent and robust delivery of data
Act as the ‘go-to’ person for the business for all things survey-related, including working with the DM’s Power BI team to translate raw data into user-friendly dashboards, and delivering training on these to local teams across the globe
Ensure the ongoing delivery of best-in-class consumer research through continuous review of our processes and methodologies, identifying opportunities for improvements in both the medium and long term
Contribute to the identification and development of brand building strategies across marketing, product and distribution channels
Work with external consultants and agencies, where relevant, to deliver project outcomes
Value Creation: identifying and executing operational improvements
Help with the project management, roll-out, tracking and development of new and ongoing value creation and operational improvement initiatives, e.g.:
Retail operations (e.g. staff selling-behaviours, time and attendance systems, store operations, buying & merchandising, product training, etc.)
Store environment (e.g. set up of test & learn stores to trial and track new concepts based on consumer insights)
Ecommerce website improvements (e.g. using consumer behaviours to align our search functionality and website taxonomy to consumer needs and expectations, mapping the consumer journey and improving the user experience against this, etc.)
CRM programme based on a Single Customer View
Act as the strategic lead to partner with IT on the design, set-up, and management of a single customer view database
Help to develop a CRM roadmap, making use of market research and competitor benchmarking to establish the best route forwards for DM’s
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
University degree essential, alongside excellent academic track record
3-5 full performance cycles’ experience in a top tier Strategy Consulting firm
Experience working in an international environment an advantage but not essential
PROFESSIONAL QUALITIES
Passionate about extracting insights from data but led by common sense, pragmatism and commercial acumen
Excellent critical thinking, highly analytical and methodical and a passion for problem-solving
Keen interest in our brand and the apparel and footwear industries as a whole
Excellent presentation skills underpinned by the ability to draw compelling narratives from vast amounts of data
Self-starter who works well independently and as part of a team
Innate 'hands-on' mentality with ability to demonstrate flexibility and adaptability
Highly organised and able to juggle multiple tasks and prioritise effectively
Resilient with strong networking and influencing skills to ensure collaboration across functions and geographies
Strives to do the “right thing”, not the “easy thing”
Energetic, positive, determined and goal focused
Happy to be part of the Dr. Martens growth journey and a growing Strategy & Insights team
COMPETENCIES
Excellent analytical skills using a variety of data types (both quantitative and qualitative)
High levels of numeracy, accuracy and attention to detail, whilst being able to think ‘big picture’
In-depth understanding of consumer survey design and interpretation
Knowledge of, and ability to work with statistical analysis and modelling (e.g. regression, factor analysis, etc.)
Knowledge of project management methods and tools
Excellent Microsoft Office skills including Powerpoint, Excel and Word

Title: Deal Strategy Analyst
Description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly's edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers' applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development.
Fastly's customers' use our edge cloud platform to ensure concertgoers can buy tickets to the live events they love, travellers can book flights seamlessly and embark on their next great adventure, and sports fans can stream events in real-time, across devices. They include many of the world's most prominent companies, including Spotify, Alaska Airlines, Hulu, The New York Times, and Ticketmaster.
We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.
Deal Strategy Analyst
Fastly's Deal Strategy team are located across the globe, and we're looking for our first Deal Strategy Analyst to join the team.
As the sole Deal Desk Analyst supporting the EMEA region, you'll be the go-to person in the region, supporting the teams in Finance, Sales, Account Management & Channel Partners across the UK, Spain, Germany, Nordics and Italy. You'll ensure that the business is executing on deals that make sense for Fastly's customers, sales team and shareholders.
What You'll Do
Act as a trusted advisor to quota bearing sales reps in deal shaping opportunities
Guide sales teams in the deal flow process and ensure smooth handoffs to contracts and billing teams
Analyze deal structure, business terms, and pricing impacts to optimize profitability, meet strategic corporate goals, and accelerate deal closure efficiency
Respond to requests (cases) from sales to adjust CPQ rate cards & product lines
Collaborate with internal stakeholders (sales, finance, product, and legal) to ensure that all deals align with corporate strategies and guidelines
Provide additional ad-hoc deal support to deal desk managers as needed
Provide business analytics and business case presentations to team leaders as needed
Manage deal approvals using project and process management best practices
Utilize and advocate for Fastly's proposal automation and content management platform, Loopio, including project oversight from set-up to completion and content library maintenance
Collaborate with internal teams to curate the proposal content, including the execution of content review cycles within Loopio
Aid sales RFP process for non-standard requirements in structure, business terms, SLA, etc.
Ensure that all deals align with corporate strategies as well as legal, billing, and revenue recognition guidelines
What We're Looking For
Extensive experience working as a Deal Desk Specialist, or Pricing Analyst, ideally with experience working previously in sales or working closely with revenue teams
SAAS or Software Experience
Confident and assertive communication style with executive-level decision-makers and sales leaders
A self-starter, with excellent attention to detail and that, takes initiative to resolve pressing business issues
Able to prioritise work, work autonomously in a region away from the Global Deal Desk Team (All US Based)
Relationship builder, able to build relationships with key stakeholders across Sales, Account Management, Partnerships, Law, Finance and marketing teams
Strong understanding of the importance of deal economics with both short- and long-term perspectives
Ability to manage multiple deals and tasks simultaneously and experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams
Strong analytical skills and experience with profitability analysis and pricing strategy
Experience with Salesforce and financial modeling in Excel
Bonus Points:
Salesforce CPQ/Steelbrick experience a plus
CDN / IT Infrastructure background a plus

Why Fastly?
We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives. Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.
We love distributed teams. Fastly's home-base is in San Francisco, but we have multiple offices and employees sprinkled around the globe. In fact, 50% of our employees work outside of SF! An international remote culture is in our DNA.
We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits like up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave, options for free medical/dental/vision plans, and an open vacation program that enables our folks to take the time they need to recharge (some benefits may vary by location).
We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful - every day.
We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we're not 'one size fits all'. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.
We're always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply!

Fastly is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity and to providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment.
Employment decisions at Fastly are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Fastly encourages applicants from all backgrounds.
Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Fastly. Please inform us if you need assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process.
Fastly collects and processes personal data submitted by job applicants in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Please see our privacy notice for job applicants.

Title: Marketing Partnerships Manager - Home Delivery
Description:
A bit about KFC:
Welcome to Kentucky Fried Chicken, made by hand, served with pride, eaten at the same table. We’re a people business that happens to sell chicken and chips. Starting with our founder Colonel Harland Sanders’ philosophy, when it comes to making our world-famous Original Recipe chicken, we believe there is a right way to do things. It isn’t always easier, but it is always better. There’s no doubt about that and we’re proud of it. We’re spirited and driven. We believe in hard work that makes an impact, a famous recognition culture that celebrates everyone and we try to not to take ourselves too seriously.

The role:
Gone are the days where you have go to the drive thru to get your chicken fix. With the rise of home delivery, you don’t even need to leave your home to get a delicious bucket of chicken. Chicken in the bath anyone?

KFC UKI is looking to bring on board a talented and ambitious Marketing Partnerships Manager. We want someone who not only LOVES chicken but has a real passion for marketing and delivering winning results. As Marketing Partnerships Manager, you will report directly to the Marketing Manager as part of a team that includes brand & category growth, national advertising, new digital channels and customer insights. This is a Mark Ritson meets Steve Jobs type of role, bringing the best of marketing practices to a new dynamic digital channel in home delivery.

Key responsibilities:

Be the strategic and commercial business owner to deliver a marketing strategy that super-charges transactions to our restaurants through home delivery.
Identify the opportunities to increase penetration and grow revenue on Delivery, the fastest growing channel for QSR, through a pipeline of core activations, limited time offers and value plays.
Build strong relationships with our aggregator partners (Just Eat, Deliveroo, Uber Eats) to understand their brand and business objectives and identify how KFC can partner with them to win. Collaborate to build a Joint Business Plan geared to grow both brands and win guests.
Build strong relationships with our Executive Management Team and Franchise owners to drive and implement the channel growth plan.
Lead a cross functional squad across product development, commercial finance and restaurant operations to deliver the brand strategy for the channel.
Build the right menu architecture that is fit for the channel to ensure we deliver hot, fresh fried chicken to our guests every time. Work with the Digital Technology team to build the right e-commerce approach to provide our guests with a seamless order journey.
Champion a test-and-learn mindset in growing the channel, leveraging data to optimise offer and experience
Lead key national campaigns from defining phase all the way to execution – to get the UK to crave KFC whenever, wherever. Have the opportunity to work and manage world-class and award-winning creative agency partners, such as Mother London. From TV to POS, we’re looking for a someone who wants accountability, can manage the full marketing mix and have a lot of fun with this
What we would love from you:
This position requires a real passion for brand strategy, strong commercial acumen, and even stronger partnership skills.
You will need a growth mindset that allows the brand to disrupt category conventions and to be prepared to test and learn, fail and try again until we ultimately succeed in making it a no-brainer to come to KFC. You’ll be connecting the dots in fresh ways to make amazing things happen. This is a new channel for the QSR industry and constantly changing, we need a pioneer to help cement KFC’s leadership in delivery.
This position combines creative thinking, strong commercial acumen, passion for food and focused action driving to set KFC up for further transformational growth over the next 24 months and towards our 2022 vision.
You will have worked on retailing with e-commerce and are well-versed in driving business performance in this channel. You would also have demonstrable experience working with customers and trade partners, and are familiar with building joint business plans.
You have the ability to cut through the jargon and speak fluent “consumer” but with our brand and menu vision at the very heart of your ideas will be a real benefit.
You possess strong collaboration skills are able to work in a dynamic, ever-changing environment.
You’ll have worked your way up the marketing ladder, working on big brand building and commercial initiatives and you will now ideally be looking to take that next step.
An experience working with Delivery aggregators is also a plus.

About you:
You are a leader with stretch to grow in the business and a strong ability to collaborate and take people with you as you lead them towards your vision.
You see yourself as a people grower and team player and love to get stuck in.
You may be the next Marketing Partnerships Manager but you’re a future Chief Marketing Officer, your ambition and hunger for the next move will see you thrive in our culture of building great international careers.
You will bring your own special secret recipe to the KFC Marketing team culture.

What we can offer you:

A career with KFC offers much more than just fantastic earning potential. We reward achievement with amazing incentives and benefits, including;
Company and performance related bonus
Generous pension with up to 11% company contribution
Private healthcare with the option to increase to include family cover and extra dental cover
Annual holiday allowance starts at 25 days with the option to buy or sell up to 5 extra days per year
Study support may be available for job-related qualifications (did we mention the awesome on the job training facilities and career development!)
International career opportunities across Yum!
Pick n Mix Benefits, options include gym membership, health screening and travel insurance
Free breakfast everyday + a seemingly unlimited amount of Free KFC lunches!
KFC is also a very sociable company and we strive to incorporate our company value of fun whenever we can. Our teams regularly enjoy nights out with their colleagues- including pay day drinks, weekly netball and football matches and each year we organise a big Christmas party to celebrate the successes of the year.

This opportunity to join an award winning Marketing team won’t be around for long, if it gets you as excited as we are and you are keen to join a global, dynamic and ambitious company you can thrive in….get in touch!

Role closes on Friday 31st of July 2020

Title: Technology Transfer Manager
Description:
Are you a Technology Transfer professional looking to help transform research in to tangible real world improvements in health care?
LGC is an international life science company working with customers in the government, academic, pharmaceutical, agricultural biotechnology, food, environment, security and sports sectors achieve excellence in investigative, diagnostic and measurement science. LGC’s Grant Management Group are experts at experts in managing research funding to maximise its impact. The Grant Management Group delivers several key parts of the Department of Health and Social Care’s National Institute for Health Research (NIHR), including the Central Commissioning Facility (CCF).

As part of the NIHR, we commission and oversee world-class research that transforms people’s lives, promotes economic growth and advances science. We need a dynamic individual to become a Technology Transfer Manager in our team at the NIHR Central Commissioning Facility.

Job Purpose
The NIHR Intellectual Property Unit provides the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) with expert advice and support on all NIHR related intellectual property, contractual and commercial issues. The Technology Transfer Manager will work across the NIHR portfolio to ensure that NIHR funded intellectual property is identified, managed and translated by researchers to produce impactful outcomes that improve the quality, capacity and capability of health care in the UK and overseas. The Technology Transfer Manager will work on projects that will improve the NIHR’s IP management processes and its integration in to the wider UK health research funding ecosystem. Another aspect of the role will be supporting resolution of due diligence, monitoring and commercialisation issues that require analysis of technical, contractual, stakeholder and commercial factors. The NIHR is a complex system so the successful candidate will need to be comfortable working in a dynamic network of other members of the IP Unit, colleagues throughout the NIHR system, research teams, IP management specialists in research organisations and commercial partners.
We are particularly looking for individuals with experience of IP and commercial issues associated with at least one of:
Technology licensing and commercial negotiation from universities or the NHS
Medical device and diagnostic development
Artificial Intelligence/”big data”
Overseas development funding, including “global health” initiatives

Role Responsibilities
The tasks associated with this role include:
Working with the Assistant Director - IP and Commercial and other members of the IP Unit to plan and deliver the NIHR IP work plan.
Manage the NIHR IP Unit’s routine processes and provide information to an agreed timetable.
Manage the NIHR IP Unit’s training calendar
Supporting NIHR staff members to resolve IP-related queries by running regular IP Open Sessions in Twickenham, Southampton and Leeds where NIHR programme managers can request support and advice.
Manage a portfolio of routine commercialisation cases on behalf of DHSC to maximise return on investment on NIHR-funded IP with a focus on delivering patient benefit and mitigation of state aid. Negotiations of return models (including financial and non-financial return mechanisms) for NIHR and preparation of briefing notes for DHSC.
Providing IP training to NIHR programme managers and staff at NIHR-funded organisations.
Using the IP Unit’s established project management tools for managing allocated activities.
Identifying and implementing improvements to the IP Unit’s processes and systems.
Ensure that a consistent approach to IP management is used across the NIHR for all activities including advising potential applicants, reviewing project proposals, resolving contractual queries, reviewing and short-listing of proposals for funding, advising during project monitoring, closure and follow up activities.
To co-ordinate legal advice for DHSC on all issues relating to research funding on a commercial basis
To represent NIHR on monitoring and audit committees on an ad hoc basis
To provide broader support for CCF and NIHR colleagues in the area of commercial processes, IP management and advice, when required.
Contribute to cross NIHR IP coordination meetings.
Attending and when relevant leading meetings such as IP Management Groups with funding recipients
Developing and updating the NIHR IP Unit website and web materials.
Drafting regular progress reports and ad-hoc papers required by internal and external bodies.
Contributing to the response to Freedom of Information requests, Parliamentary Questions or briefing requests from DHSC.
With all relevant parties, encourage and foster effective communication, consultation and co-ordination
Quality checks of the activities of the Innovations Directorate and other NIHR staff.
Qualifications
Experience and Qualifications
Successful candidates will be expected to demonstrate the following:
A good degree in a relevant subject (a relevant professional qualification would be desirable) or comparable professional experience
Detailed knowledge of life science research gained from working in a university, NHS Trust, company or charity
Knowledge of intellectual property management in the public and private sectors to generate impact from research
Understanding of the different organisational goals of universities, NHS Trusts, charities and companies and how these need to be balanced when negotiating with organisations.
Knowledge of the regulatory framework for intellectual property management
A proven track record in obtaining appropriate legal advice on intellectual property management issues
An ability to analyse situations taking qualitative and quantitative factors in to account, including return on investment models
An ability to draft succinct and informative documents for senior level decision makers providing them with sufficient information for decisions to be made
Experience of project management, including organisational skills and meticulous record keeping
Effective planning, organisational and prioritisation skills with the ability to manage own time to deliver multiple priorities with demanding deadlines
Excellent interpersonal skills and customer focus, including successful senior level external liaison and meeting management to agree mutually acceptable outcomes
An understanding of technology transfer licensing arrangements
Willingness to travel to locations across England (including Southampton and Leeds on a weekly basis) to provide support and advice

Title: Principal Analytics Platform Specialist- EMEA Region
Description:
10+ years of consulting, presales, enterprise selling, and/or program/product management experience specifically supporting analytics initiatives
Experience working with Big Data, Business Intelligence and other analytics technology is required

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the pioneer and recognized leader in Cloud Computing. Our web services provide a platform for IT infrastructure in-the-cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world. These customers range from start-ups to leading web companies to Global 500 companies in financial services, pharmaceuticals, and technology.

As the regional lead for Analytics Platform Technology within Amazon Web Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a technology strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s cloud computing platform for Analytics. Your responsibilities will include helping to define key customers and industries to target, driving the necessary business and technical relationships with customers and partners to establish new business in those accounts and industries, and enabling the sales team drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects in order to build long-term business opportunity. You’ll also work closely with the product/service teams to help them evolve the products/services and address issues, concerns, and requests from the field.

The ideal candidate will have both a business background that enables them to drive an engagement and interact at the CxO/VP level, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact with software developers, architects, and DBAs. She/he should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions, and work cross-organizationally to build consensus. A keen sense of ownership, drive, and scrappiness is a must.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Serve as a key member of the Analytics Platform team focused on helping to drive overall AWS analytics strategy for customer transformations.
Technical expert to help identify the ideal cross-platform solution to support comprehensive use cases.
Build cross-platform demos to show the “art of the possible”.
Help define the AWS market segments, customer base, and industry verticals we target.
Align with regional account teams and professional services to develop large lighthouse customers utilizing broad services of the AWS Database and Analytics platform to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
Lead customer briefings, present at customer events, and further AWS analytics thought leadership
Alignment with service teams to ensure voice-of-customer visibility into user priorities
Engage with C-Level Executives to educate them on how to leverage Data as a competitive advantage
Participate in industry trade shows to distinguish the AWS value proposition from others in the market
Build internal support and excitement with other internal teams to increase analytics revenue throughout the company
Collaborate with other internal stakeholders to ensure cohesive messaging and differentiation of the DBS solutions at AWS

Experience in working in a matrixed organization.
Understanding and experience in business initiatives requiring data driven solutions.
Strong verbal and written communications skills are a must, as well as leadership skills.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively across internal and external organizations is key.
Experience working with Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, Teradata, IBM Netezza, Hadoop, Spark or other data warehouse or data lake technologies is required.
Experience with JavaScript, ASP, JSP, PHP, Perl, and/or Python
Experience with AI/ML technologies a plus
Solution selling experience
Experience with Design Thinking/Working Backwards methodologies a plus

establishment of a learning cell to support active reflection and design changes during the Covid-19 response.

Title: Associate Director, Advisory
Description:
Job: Corporate Secretariat
Primary Location: Europe & Americas-United Kingdom-London
Schedule: Full-time
Employee Status: Permanent
Posting Date: 20/Jul/2020
Unposting Date: 27/Aug/2020
About Standard Chartered
We are a leading international bank focused on helping people and companies prosper across Asia, Africa and the Middle East.


To us, good performance is about much more than turning a profit. It's about showing how you embody our valued behaviours - do the right thing, better together and never settle - as well as our brand promise, Here for good.


We're committed to promoting equality in the workplace and creating an inclusive and flexible culture - one where everyone can realise their full potential and make a positive contribution to our organisation. This in turn helps us to provide better support to our broad client base.


The Role Responsibilities


Strategy
Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.
Processes

Responsible for the delivery of key processes to do with legal entity management and governance, including:
Portfolio management of certain UK and Dutch subsidiary companies, preparation and review of minutes, meeting logistics, statutory filings, and maintenance of company information on Blueprint OneWorld. Where applicable, supporting in the liquidation process of any of the entities in their portfolio (incl. the drafting of GCS section of the corporate action forms).
To work with the Trainee Company Secretary, Subsidiary Governance to in review and collation of information required in connection with the regulatory filings for overseas branches of Standard Chartered Bank (incl. accounts, director changes and quarterly submissions);
To assist with the publishing of stock exchange announcements to the London Stock Exchange
Management of the issuance of Senior Powers of Attorney, and requests for the notarisation and legalisation of Power of Attorneys across the Group.
Assisting with group structure regulatory reporting (close links).
Owning and managing the process for the appointment of enduring corporate representatives as and when they occur.
Executing on requirements and providing general advice around the Group’s Sources of Authority.
To undertake general company secretarial matters
To deal with tasks and general queries from within the Group’s network which come through the secretariat email inbox, including the provision of Group entity information, delegated authorities, document execution and subsidiary governance.
As page owner, maintain the information provided on GCS’ intranet pages.
Risk Management
Support the Director, Risk and Operations Group Corporate Secretariat and Process Owners with the sampling and testing of controls to ensure compliance with agreed ORF controls and standards and GCS policies.
Be familiar with the Group’s Enterprise Risk Management Framework (“ERMF”) and relevant Frameworks (including Compliance and Operational Risk) to provide support and guidance on how these impact the function’s policies and procedures.

Governance
To support the Executive Director, Advisory, Capital and Listing and Group Company Secretary (the latter as Policy Owner) on all aspects of policy ownership in regards to the issuance of Group’s Power of Attorney. Ability to learn quickly

Professional qualification (AMCT, CFA or similar), although this is not essential

Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

As a global front-runner in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. Title: Exchange Decodes C++ Engineer

Designing and implementing enterprise-quality software, primarily in C++ but also in other languages including C#

Contributing to the system architecture and improving performance
There is a wide scope for learning and development in this role, with 10% of your time at work dedicated to allowing you to explore your own ideas, and opportunities to attend training and conferences.
Who are we looking for?
The successful candidate will have:
Experience building high-quality solutions to interesting problems in C++ (in industry or post-graduate academia)
A good understanding of fundamental algorithms & data structures.
A determined and hardworking outlook, with the ability to communicate efficiently with technical and non-technical people
A 2.1 degree or better in computer science, electronics or similar
Financial experience is useful but not required
Why should you apply?
Highly competitive compensation plus annual discretionary bonus
Informal dress code and excellent work/life balance
Comprehensive healthcare and life assurance
25 days holiday

Cycle-to-work scheme
Subsidised gym membership
Monthly company events
Central London office close to 5 stations and 6 tube lines

Title: Analyst – Data & Analytics Platform Strategy & Implementatio...
Description:
Analyst – Data & Analytics Platform Strategy & Implementation Team
- (003810)
Primary Location UK-ENG-London
Job Research
Organisation DATA ANALYTICS TRANSFORMATION DIR
Job Posting 05-Jul-2020, 6:01:00 PM

The Bank of England is the UK's central bank. Our mission is to deliver monetary and financial stability for the British people.

The Bank of England is a diverse organisation. Each of its 4,000 plus people are committed to public service and dedicated to promoting the good of the people of the United Kingdom by maintaining monetary and financial stability.

Directorate Overview
The Bank’s mission depends on data and analytics, through their role in the Bank's decisions, its operations, and the information it provides to the public.

Data and analytics have received a new level of senior attention and backing in the Bank, following Huw van Steenis' Future of Finance review, the Bank's response, and the Governor's Mansion House speech. The Bank is now publicly committed to delivering a "world class regtech and data strategy". A new Directorate, Data Analytics and Transformation (DAT), headed by Gareth Ramsay, has been created to lead on this. DAT is the Bank’s centre of expertise for data strategy implementation and the compilation, dissemination and publication of regulatory and statistical data. We support analysis, policy and decision making by the Bank’s Committees, UK government departments and international organisations. Key stakeholders for our work include MPC, FPC and PRA Boards and our data are used in the Inflation Report, Financial Stability Report, Credit Conditions Review, Stress Test Results, FPC Core Indicators and Quarterly Bulletin. Decisions made in these Boards and from these reports have national economic significance.”

Data Strategy Implementation Division
Within DAT, a new division called Data Strategy Implementation Division (DSID) leads the definition and implementation of the Bank's data and analytics strategy. This strategy touches on practically all functions of the Bank, due to the central importance of data and analysis in our daily work. It also affects the firms from whom we collect data under statutory powers, the domestic and international official sector bodies with whom we share our data and analytics, and the public who receive data and analytics outputs published by the Bank.

Through the 2020s we intend to transform the way the Bank defines and collects data, the way it manages data and its capacity to analyse it, to make our use of data and analytics as insightful, reliable and efficient as possible. In addition, DSID leads the operation of the shared data and analytics services that mean colleagues can harness the power of data and analytics in their ‘business as usual (BAU)’ work today.

The Analytics Enablement Hub (AEH) was established last year to provide a Bank-wide analytics strategy and the support needed to help colleagues realise the potential of our data, and the analytical tools and platforms available to them. The AEH is a virtual team composed of colleagues from different areas across the Bank. They collaborate together to provide a cohesive, easy to access, supported self-service model utilising the skills and expertise we have. The core teams within AEH comprises teams from DSID (Data Analytics and Transformation) and Data and Analytics Modelling (Technology).

The Data and Analytics Platform Strategy and Implementation Team
The Data and Analytics Platform Strategy and Implementation Team is a new team, within DSID, and will augment the current core team, sitting within the Analytics Enablement Hub, that has the remit of implementing the strategy around our Data & Analytics Platform. This D&A Platform, with Bank-wide scope, will be live at the end of the year and will be the reference platform for self-service analytics across the Bank. For this reason we have designed an ambitious, and industry leading, operating model that is a step-change regarding how analytical platforms across the Bank are managed.
The strategy we have designed ensures:

Colleagues across the Bank can quickly add new, and maintain existing, datasets
Colleagues across the Bank can quickly find, trust and use datasets in the platform
Colleagues across the Bank can quickly make use of their datasets by setting-up reproducible, and performant, analytical pipelines
Data Stewards (those accountability for datasets in the Bank) are assured that their data are used in a governed, secured environment
The platform is kept up-to-date and delivering continuous business value
We fully expect this operating model to transform the way a considerable portion of the Bank’s data & analytics landscape will be supported in the future.

Job description
This is a really exciting opportunity to be part of a high-profile transformation, by help developing the team that will be at the heart of shaping one of the most fundamental future capabilities around Data & Analytics in the Bank.
We expect the job holder to help shape the role, but anticipate you will:

Support the team lead with the delivery of the Data & Analytics Platform strategy ensuring the right activities are in place to serve the current and future needs of the Bank
Help with the capture, curation and prioritisation of the business requests into the Data & Analytics Platform activities portfolio
Partner with the virtual teams sitting across Technology, DAT and Business areas, to help ensure the activities are delivered in an agile manner and that processes, policies and standards are defined, agreed, maintained and consistently applied
Be responsible for the design, implementation and ongoing delivery of the MI on the Data & Analytics Platform activities portfolio.
Meet with the business areas to discuss proposals for projects, new data on-boarding and changes, help with scope definition and provide a priority score
Deliver effective and appropriate communications to consumers of services, including promoting the data being made available Bank-wide
Support day-to-day activities and decisions of the governance bodies, ensuring prioritisation of activities are driven by business value and alignment with the Bank’s Data and Analytics Strategy

Role Requirements


Minimum (Essential) Criteria
The most important requirement for the role is that the work excites you and that you believe you can help the Bank substantially improve its data and analytics capabilities and make the most of the large investment it is making in new tools and technologies. In addition, you will have experience of:
managing change and show enthusiasm by embracing new technologies;
Knowledge of typical data and analytical use cases and a desire to develop an deeper understanding of how datasets are collected, managed, accessed and used around the Bank
Strong analytical skills, including experience in collecting, analysing, summarising and presenting information
Stakeholder management skills, both to engage pro-actively with subject matter experts and to ensure positive relationships with the rest of the Bank
working flexibly , autonomously, and co-operatively in a collaborative team environment
Proven experience in working across boundaries and building bridges in multi-disciplinary teams
Proactivity and can-do attitude

While experience in one or two analytics and visualisation tools (e.g. r, python, git, tableau) would be desirable, a strong data & analytics background is not essential. Above all, interest in new advances in technologies, enthusiasm for ways of working in this spectrum and ability to work effectively and flexibly with the other teams.

We anonymise applications so hiring managers will not be able to see your personal information, your original CV or any covering letters when reviewing your submission. Please complete work history and the application form questions as requested because incomplete submissions will not be reviewed.

We continue to build an inclusive culture where everyone can be their whole selves and produce their best work. Our focus on inclusion is intended to build greater diversity in order to reflect the society we serve and be an employer of choice.

This specific role offers a base salary of £35,700.

In addition, the total reward package also includes:
A non-contributory, career average pension giving you a guaranteed retirement benefit of 1/95th of your annual salary for every year worked. There is the option to increase your pension (to 1/50th) or decrease (to 1/120th) in exchange for salary through our flexible benefits programme each year.
A discretionary performance award based on a current award pool.
A 7% benefits allowance with the option to take as salary or purchase a wide range of flexible benefits.
25 days annual leave with option to buy up to 13 additional days through flexible benefits.
Private medical insurance and income protection.

Title: Manager - Workforce Design & Analytics - People Advisory Ser...
Description:
People Advisory Services (PAS) harnesses the collective power of all or our people – related services into a single integrated global sub-service line of over 10,000 people delivering over $1.4bn in revenue. We provide our clients with a set of integrated services and offerings solving their most pertinent people-related business issues.

PAS has been targeted as an area of significant growth as clients increasingly require advice in building their people’s capabilities at a time when global demand for talent and scare skills is at its highest. As well as attracting and retaining talent, clients are also looking at how they raise overall organisational performance through the entire workforce.

This means building their capabilities, processes and systems in workforce optimisation, inclusion, organisational development and culture.

The opportunity

EY is looking someone to undertake data analysis to assist high profile strategy analytics projects.

The person appointed will work closely with the senior project delivery leads both firm and client side to synthesise and analyse both internal and external data to provide strategic insights to clients.

The team is seeking high-caliber professionals with a specific focus on data management, data investigation and insight, predictive modeling and data visualisation. This is an important position requiring both technical knowledge and business awareness, providing opportunities for motivated candidates to contribute to solving complex client problems.

Our projects include a wide variety of areas, including labour market analysis (regulatory, economic, etc.), scenario planning, predictive models, econometric forecasts, and other items of strategic and operational importance to the firm and clients alike.

With the firm’s current focus on meeting Vision 2020+, the Workforce Design & Analytics team is charged to help achieve a ‘step change’ in the development and execution of our strategic agenda through exceptional client service and delivery. By leveraging data, statistics, the appointed candidate will provide within client projects robust, fact-based analyses, models and databases that focuses on delivering business insights and perspectives to facilitate strategic discussions among client teams.

The team’s role includes acting as a trusted advisor to key clients at all levels to enable them to make evidence based decisions on critical strategic, operational and tactical issues.

Your key responsibilities
Investigating and specifying data requirements:
Assessing data coverage and quality
Defining suitable data history requirements
Working with our off shore support teams (GDS) to enhance and maintain data used to support our analytics capabilities
Supporting key projects such as workforce planning, employee engagement or continuous listening data analysis by:
Liaising with internal clients
Developing models
Developing suitable reporting systems
Specifying requirements to our off-shore support teams
Developing data analysis outputs:
Creating visualisations to explain complex concepts
Develop presentation and insight report packs
Provide best practice advice and support
Developing models to support and inform client outcomes:
Enabling greater insights through engaging with other service lines across various geographies within the firm (e.g. Tax, GDS, Markets)
Using the results of the analysis to create persuasive presentations
Developing reporting systems to more widely distribute the results of analysis
Application and adherence to GDPR, people data governance and data privacy polices
Cognisant in the use and application of local data privacy and information security law


To qualify for the role you must have
Ability to quickly grasp complex business problems, develop a rational framework for investigating the problems
Understanding of engagement economics and business finance
First hand knowledge and practical application in designing and implementing complex data structures, including data analysis and problem solving
Application of predictive modeling and statistical methods – such as R, Python, SPSS
Experience with data visualisation and reporting systems such as PowerBI,Tableau or Spotfire
Strong academic record, preferably a degree in a technical domain (e.g., Psychology, Statistics, IT, Math, Engineering, Econometrics, Science)
Experience in the professional services, data supplier or consulting environment
Using relational database, including the development of SQL queries to extract and manage large volumes of data


Ideally, you’ll also have
Strategic, operational and tactical workforce planning experience within a large, complex, multinational organisation is desirable, but not essential
A primary degree and any post graduate degrees and professional qualifications are desirable but not critical e.g. CIPD
Experience of working on projects within a professional services firm, global consultancy firm and/or large private and/or public sector organisations


Skills and attributes for success
Data/ Visualisation skills e.g. Microsoft PowerBI, IBM SPSS, Python, Tableau
Computer Skills: Microsoft 365 Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Teams, Azure DevOps, SharePoint), OrgPublisher
Flexibility and comfort in a rapidly changing environment with shifting priorities
Ability to deal with and manage uncertainty and incomplete information
What we look for

We have many clients from various sectors talking to us about how can they assess, attract and nurture talent engagingly in varying contexts.

We are looking for people who can demonstrate real impact within various areas for our clients. We require people who can build our service offerings, understand client needs, grow our internal capability and connect effectively across our global PAS to maximise our global knowledge and experience in supporting clients to build their talent pool.

What working at EY offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes assistance for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
Coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

About EY

EY is a global professional services organisation providing advisory, assurance, tax and transaction services. We are dedicated to doing our part in building a better working world for our people, our clients and our communities. And we are united by our shared values and a dedication to delivering exceptional client service

We make sure our people succeed. The networks you build and the experiences you have with us will help define and accelerate the rest of your career. Last year in the UK, nearly 2,000 of our people were promoted or progressed within their grade, and we are significantly increasing the number of partners in the UK. So, when you build something better at EY, we make sure you’re rewarded.

Our People Advisory Services practice has over 10,000 practitioners operating within a globally integrated team, bringing their skills, insights and experience to support our clients.

Driven by our focused insight and innovation, PAS is best positioned to advise and influence our client’s activities at senior leadership level to respond to the scale and complexity of how and where our clients work globally, making us the trusted advisor of choice to our clients and creating more opportunities for our people. As a result, we’re continually seeking new markets, new perspectives and better ways to deliver value.

EY is dedicated to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Make your mark.

Apply now.

Title: Customer Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a highly experienced customer-first and data-driven insights leader to join our newly formed Customer team.
As a Customer Data Analyst you will create insights that inform customer acquisition and retention-related strategies across the business, making a substantial contribution to Reach’s ambitious customer growth plans and targets.
Our Customer Data Analyst is an inaugural member of the team, you will be responsible for the data-driven development of Reach’s Customer Relationship Management plans and will be fundamental in setting the future strategic direction of the programme.
As the Customer Data Analyst/Data Strategist, you will identify, design and implement innovative solutions to the challenges of customer management across the business and at such scale.
Initially, you will be required to harness and interrogate all available data sets to establish a customer Insights Roadmap that ultimately informs a CRM and Loyalty programme for Reach.
You will be part of a new CRM team which will initially consist of three people. There is a phased expansion plan in place which will take the department to 11 staff within a year.
So on that note, who are we?
We are the UK's largest news publisher, with influential national newsbrands such as the Daily Mirror, Daily Express, Sunday People, OK! Magazine, Daily Record, and more than 100 distinguished regional titles. Every day our newsbrands - national and regional, in print and online - reach millions of people up and down the country.

Turn insights summaries into actionable recommendations for the CRM team, newsrooms and product owners.
Work with the CRM team to define and disseminate the loyalty and retention strategy
Proactively identify data blockers & concerns, through tracking of metrics on a regular basis.
Work with internal stakeholders to ensure that data insight teams are engaged at the right time - and that they contribute to shaping and scoping of projects as well as delivery.
Create a culture of excellence in terms of the quality of analysis delivered.
Play an important role in delivering customer growth. This may entail supporting new business pitches and continuous development of Reach’s customer commercial proposition.
The Ideal Candidate

You will have an inquisitive mind, be a team player and have a passion for data. You're highly motivated and passionate about developing a deep and actionable understanding of our customer.
We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate:
Detail-oriented with a strong problem-solving mentality.
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
A confident and articulate communicator capable of inspiring strong collaboration within an organisation and between teams.
Good understanding of business KPIs.
An appetite for challenge, innovation and learning new skills.
Ability to work both independently and within a team.
Someone who enjoys a fast-paced environment and is highly organised to manage many tasks and projects at the same time, working across multiple stakeholders to influence action.
Hands-on analysis experience within a marketing environment including customer segmentation, predictive analysis, campaign targeting, and response analysis.
Experience in manipulating and leveraging large scale data with Excel, SQL, Tableau, Python, WPS.
A strong understanding of data structure, visualization and machine learning principles.
Strong capacity to translate data into strategic insights and recommendations whilst also driving a high volume of tactical actions.

Reach plc believe diversity brings benefits for our customers, our business and our people. Pension scheme

This role sits within the Data science team, reporting into the Analytics Manager, who is energetic, super friendly, funny and passionate about data AND working for this organisation; and there is a lot to be passionate about!
This organisation sits within one of the most stable industries economically right now. They have made 0 redundancies during Covid-19 and haven’t had to furlough any staff. It’s a fast paced environment, where a collaborative approach is taken with most projects, plus there is a significant opportunity to take ownership of work, through supporting your manager and pro-actively identifying ways to ease her workload and build your own profile within the business.
ROLE
This role will be owning the analysis of digital product performance, working within a lean team yet on a very large scale, you’ll work alongside experts in advanced machine learning, data engineering, campaign management and delivery, to provide insightful analysis around digital product performance and customer behaviour. You’ll work with behavioural data, and across multiple products (websites and apps), analysing customer journey, experience and CRM, applying structured, critical thinking in order to provide data driven solutions to solve problems, answer business questions and overall optimise and improve product performance.
This is very much a business facing role, so it’s important you feel confident and comfortable talking to various stakeholders about their needs, challenges and requirements, working to build relationships and pushing back when needs be. We’ll be looking for a certain level of maturity and an individual contributor, who is able to self-organise and add value.
Technically, they use both R and SAS (training provided) for more advanced analysis, but SQL is the key skill required for this role (ability to at least use libraries for extracting, organising and structuring the data for analysis, not necessary writing code from scratch). Ideally you will have also worked with Adobe Analytics for web analysis, or something similar such as Google Analytics, but this can be taught – another good reason to consider this role!

You will need to be commercially minded in your approach, working out what any changes in customer behaviour or product performance actually means for the business in terms of cost and revenue, ROI customer experience and customer journey and working on how to measure the performance of the digital products you are working with.
OPPORTUNITIES FOR YOU?
From an analytical perspective, you will gain exposure to huge volumes of digital and customer data, working with a modern tech stack (training in Adobe Analytics available) as well as a friendly and forward thinking team. You’ll be able to develop strong stakeholder management skills – a must for any client or business facing analyst in today’s data industry. Educated to degree level, ideally in a numerate subject; Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Economics, Machine Learning, Computer Science etc.
A background in customer and marketing analysis, and ideally some exposure to digital (whether that be digital marketing or web analytics)

Title: Data Analyst Graduate (Financial Services) - November 2020
Description:
YOUR ROLE
Are you an analytical, data-driven graduate? Are you interested in a role that offers an opportunity to shape the future of audit through data-driven solutions? This unique opportunity offers technical challenge, a creative open problem-solving environment, and quick responsibility and progression.

The purpose of the position is to fundamentally unlock insights contained in data and create solutions to challenges related to the delivery of external audit.

What you’ll do:
Work on Mazars’ most strategic audit clients, including many high profile international listed companies – delivering full cycle external audits as part of the audit team. You will work in many different industry sectors including banking and insurance, retail and the automotive sector to name a few. Exposure to multiple sectors will provide you with a broad view and understanding of the economy.
Innovation ambassador, promoting new ideas to our audit teams and working as part of a network of innovation champions. As part of this community you will be designing, developing and trialling new processes and technology.
Complement your STEM degree with business application and knowledge, discovering how companies work, including processes, controls, accounting and reporting systems.
Experience secondment opportunities to other departments within Mazars, where data science is critical; business areas may include quantitative services, actuarial, consulting and forensics – in the UK and overseas.
Anticipate client needs and formulate solutions to client issues.
Shape the future of audit through data-driven solutions.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED
Role requirements:
STEM degree, 2:1 or above. Your academic background will be in business analytics, data-science, statistics or equivalent programme focused on data and analytics. We will also consider any degree discipline if it involved a data analytics module.
Must have intermediate skills in: Python, Java or SQL with project-based experience
Data analytics skills from a related degree or experience (work experience is not essential)
Keen interest in technology
Strong work ethic; the desire to innovate, get things done, and to learn and progress.
Interpersonal skills; the ability to influence, build client relationships with a foundation of trust and responsibility.
Analytical skills; the ability to accurately and diligently assimilate information, grasp concepts quickly, research and solve problems.
Independent; the ability to think critically, challenge when appropriate, and to apply professional scepticism.
Attention to detail and strong time-management skills.
Credible and effective communication skills (written and verbal)
Affinity with our values; in particular, respect for individuals, diversity and integrity.
Desirable requirements:
Background in any programming language such as Java, Python, R
Linux knowledge
Knowledge of one: MS SQL, MySQL, NoSQL, Postgre SQL
Knowledge of any visualisation technologies such as Power-BI, QlikView, Tableau
YOUR DEVELOPMENT
Your professional development plan focuses using your strengths to do your best work every day. You will be supported by a mentor and a people manager to keep your career and aspirations on track. We offer opportunities to help develop your skills in addition to hands-on experience – development plans are unique to each individual. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development training you will have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout your career.

You will receive technical training within our External Audit and Consulting Data team and on-the-job experience in related teams i.e. quantitative services, actuarial, consulting and forensics.

We will give you the option to study towards the ACA qualification.

You will receive a full study package to ensure that you successfully complete your professional qualification. This includes time off to study, attend college and complete online courses. Your professional qualification is only part of the story at Mazars; we support all our trainees with a blended approach to training and development including classroom study, 1:1 coaching, and soft skills training.

OVERVIEW OF THE SERVICE LINE & TEAM
In Audit, you will join a growing team of over 800 relationship driven, curious, problem solvers who add value to their clients daily. Our Audit Teams provide audit assurance services which are vital to our clients’ business control and credibility. Our expertise ranges from servicing private, entrepreneurial companies through to UK listed companies, financial services and some of the largest FT Global organisations in the world. By joining a unique integrated structure, you will benefit from working in collaborative teams and be given responsibility for delivering robust and independent audit services in a supportive environment.

In a rapidly changing business world, we also care about our industry and have long pressed for a debate on audit competition. We believe that companies and their shareholders alike deserve the benefits that increased competition can bring and are committed to playing an active role in shaping its future.

The financial services audit department works internationally to provide seamless, cross-border support to our clients. As a member of the team you will experience a broad range of clients across various sectors to build your knowledge and understanding of the financial services market.

Teams within Financial Services:

Banking:
The banking group cover clients such as emerging banks and UK operations of large international banks.

Insurance:
The insurance group cover clients from entrepreneurial insurance brokers to Lloyd’s syndicates and large international underwriters.

CULTURE & REWARD
DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION AT MAZARS

Mazars is committed to a 360 degree diversity approach, from building diverse leadership teams which reflect our clients and society, to creating an open, inclusive, culture where individual voices are heard. Our client-facing people can be required to travel regularly or may be based at client sites - our approach to agile working (see benefits) can help achieve a lifestyle balance without compromising on client service. We welcome applications from those returning to employment after a break from their careers. Visit our D&I page to see the ways we are driving diversity https://www.mazarscareers.co.uk/about-mazars/diversity-inclusion .
BESPOKE BENEFITS THAT WORK FOR YOU
We recognise that benefits are important to you and our aim at Mazars is to give you as much choice as possible and to allow you to benefit from our buying power. We offer core benefits to all employees – 25 days holiday, pension, life assurance and income protection insurance. Beyond that we want you to be able to choose benefits that you want, rather than have all benefits chosen for you.

As a Mazars employee you also have access to a range of voluntary benefits including a shopping-discount platform, discounted phone contracts, gym memberships and interest free season ticket loans.

Title: Media Insights & Analytics Manager, Europe

Job Description
We are looking for a passionate media expert to govern & partner on our media effectiveness measurement insights, reporting and analytics with our brand marketing, insights and media teams across Europe. They will act as one team to enrich our media effectiveness program and enable focus on consumer centric media. This is a very exciting and critical role in our Media Insights & Analytics Centre of Excellence (CoE) team and it covers all media touchpoints - AV, Digital, OOH and others.

About Media Insights and the role

Media Insights & Analytics CoE have been established to build our brands, optimize PepsiCo’s media investment and drive Media thought leadership in the company. Media Insights CoE is a part of the bigger Insights CoE group that continuously evolves to drive and map out key Insights focus areas of the future.
This role acts as an internal consultant who governs and coordinates our vast media effectiveness measurement program across Europe, guides the company on coverage of the “white space” markets with no prior measurement. The person will stay hungry for new knowledge and new research techniques and will also play a critical role in ensuring governance principles on the media measurement capabilities in the company.

He or she will become an expert in the current media landscape, available media measurement data and capabilities across key Europe markets (priorities are Russia, Turkey, UK) and fundamental quantitative research methods (e.g. marketing mix modelling). The person will also facilitate implementation of the media effectiveness and ROI insights in the key business processes and influence critical decision making and senior stakeholders .

The role reports into the Head of Media Insights and Analytics and works closely with the colleagues in Insights in the local markets, Marketing teams, Media operations; acts as a key point of contact for research agencies, media agencies, think tanks, media owners and data providers.

The job location is a mix of London and Reading where the Europe headquarters are located. The person would need to be in the Reading office up to 2 days a week.
Qualifications/Requirements
What are we looking for?
This is an ESSA CoE role and CoE roles are very stretching from a leadership and impact perspective, as they have a diverse and very senior set of stakeholders in a complex matrix environment. The “how” of this role is just as important as the “what” and hence we are targeting a demanding leadership profile.
8+ years of relevant client side or the research agency experience combined with in-house exposure
Strong analytical acumen and quantitative skills including basic statistics
Ability to frame problems smartly and define agenda from a relatively loose brief
Focus on the critical issues and actionable growth opportunities with business acumen and commercial savviness
Significant executive maturity to influence multiple stakeholders
Proactivity, drive and ability to inspire others to embrace change on a large scale

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About the Company
MIAC Analytics Ltd is a global organisation providing consultancy and software solutions to the financial services industry from offices in the US, Eurozone and India. The primary Head Office is in New York.
The UK office, based in Twickenham, works across both the U.K. and the Eurozone, covering all asset classes in the financial services industry. Using our proprietary software suite, MIAC Analytics™,and leveraging the firm’s combined international experience, MIAC enhances their clients understanding of the value, risk and performance of key assets or liabilities on their balance sheet. Our goal is to empower our clients to make more informed business decisions through the sophisticated use of data and analytics.
About the Role
There is a current requirement for a Data Analyst/Scientist who can provide data management, visualisation and modelling skills together with a reasonable understanding of the Financial Services market sector. The ideal candidate would have a passion for producing compelling marketing materials and management information through the use and manipulation of large quantities of data.
The role will be reporting to the Head of Modelling in the U.K. in support of MIAC’s data driven products. This requires a person who is fully capable of working in a close and tight team working environment, but is also able to show they can work independently and reliably, showing suitable awareness of when to ask for support, or identify issues that may impact on the work of the business.
There will be a 6 month probationary period upon starting the role with a monthly review before the end of each calendar month in the probationary period to ensure every opportunity is made available for the person to be able to move forward with the business. The role will require 3 months notice of termination by either party post the probationary period.
The Candidate
MIAC is searching for an individual who can use our existing property analytics products to create compelling data visualisations for both internal and external consumption and make them accessible on our website and social media channels. This requires a unique skill set of both data analytics and marketing.
MIAC also have access to other data related to the financial industry and there are plans to develop new analytics which can be used internally and marketed to external clients. The candidate would be able to work on all aspects from development to producing data driven marketing materials to support this effort.
The individual will ideally be educated to degree level within a technical or numerate discipline such as computer science, statistics, or similar. Some relevant work experience is an advantage although this is not essential.
The role requires an individual with some experience of working with statistical models particularly as they relate to unlocking information from large data sets.
The individual will need to have proven knowledge or experience of some of the following:
Managing and manipulating large quantities of data using SQL.
Creating data driven insights and tools through the use of the following:
Data visualisations with Tableau, Power BI, d3 or similar software.
Building data driven models using statistical techniques using in either VBA, R or Python.
Geospatial statistics and working with shape files.
Excellent skills in statistical inference of large data sets, along with the ability to communicate inferences in a compelling manner.
The capability to extend their knowledge base into multiple areas of finance where MIAC have access to data e.g. property data and loan data for different asset classes.
The business is looking for an individual who can show that they are prepared to extend their learning and capabilities using their own initiative as part of a team within agreed remit/mandates. Being an active and interactive team member is a key skill.
Presentation skills are advantageous due to the need to communicate complex ideas and outcomes internally and to external clients.
Proficiency in traditional MS Office suite is required.
Tasks and Responsibilities
Assume responsibility for MIAC’s data driven products and tools. Current products include MIAC’s property Analytics suite encompassing house price and rental indices along with other closely related products.
Responsibility for these products includes the following tasks:
Loading data through MIAC’s proprietary data management software DataRaptor®. This encompasses the following tasks:
Data cleansing
Data normalisation
Data reporting
Output to downstream systems
Running SQL procedures to create the property indices. The indices are built monthly using a considerable amount of SQL procedures that the candidate will need to understand, troubleshoot and enhance.
Validating the indices and populating the management information.
Create new interactive data visualisations that report on the data and the indices. This includes internal and external reports to be accessed through a number of methods including the MIAC website.
Communicate results with clients and answer any queries that they may have with compelling statistics and visuals.
Manage and author documentation around the products.
Investigate additional insights from the existing data that can be developed and used inhouse or licenced to clients.
Providing support to the other areas within the business. This is not an area where the candidate is expected to have any knowledge or experience, but an interest would be beneficial as support may be required on occasion. This includes the following:
Asset valuation: This involves statistical modelling of borrower behaviour in order to calculate future cash flows and provide clients with a portfolio price.
Stress testing: Macroeconomic and loan level modelling in order to gain insight in portfolio behaviour under certain scenarios.
MIAC software: The MIAC Analytics™software suite encompasses tools for cash flow calculation, data management, bond analysis, capital calculation, risk analysis and pricing. Software development is performed in the US, but the UK team contribute towards specifying new functionality within the software, testing, and providing customer support.
Model development and validation: Loan behavioural modelling is often required by clients to satisfy Basel or IFRS9 requirements.
Effective and on-going training will be provided to ensure that the individual is fully versed in the solutions and services to be offered. The individual will also be involved in the on-going development and expansion of these solutions and services as the business continues to expand.
