Title: Catastrophe Research Analyst
Description:
job description:
Catastrophe Research Analyst
12 months Fixed Term Contract
Location: London
Base Salary - upto 41k base salary
Opening Date: 15th July 2020
Closing Date: 12th August 2020

About the team / division
Hiscox underwrites a significant amount of natural catastrophe risk across the globe. Hiscox covers losses arising from perils such as hurricanes, windstorms, floods and earthquakes. Natural catastrophe simulation models are used for pricing and managing risk. The Hiscox View of Risk (HVOR) is derived from a number of adjusted and mathematically blended models. The HVOR underpins our approach to pricing and managing portfolios of risks.
The over-arching goal of the Hiscox catastrophe research team is to improve the HVOR. The catastrophe research team consists of the group head of catastrophe research, several full-time researchers , as well members of the team of catastrophe modelling analysts across the group (10+) who are involved in various research projects throughout the business cycle. The team also has extensive collaborations with analytics teams in re/insurance brokers, catastrophe model vendors, and insurtech companies.
There is a long list of important projects related to improving the HVOR which promises to materially impact the business.
To accelerate progress, one research contract position is now open. The researcher will be supervised by the group head of catastrophe research, alongside other senior members of the team.
On offer is the chance to make a meaningful impact on the business, whilst tackling important and interesting problems. The role will give candidates the opportunity to improve their technical and soft skills while at the same time learning about the business.

The role
The role involves tackling clearly defined research and development projects to improve the HVOR. Projects involving model evaluation, model development, data analysis and machine learning are available. All projects will be related to natural catastrophe risks such as flood, hurricane and/or earthquakes. The candidate will have the opportunity to interact and work with a variety of computing technologies and frameworks. It is expected that this role will involve tackling several projects related to climate change.

What will you be doing in the role?
Day-to-day work is focused on research projects under the guidance of the catastrophe research team. Specific duties include, but are not limited to:
Developing the company’s view of risk on various natural perils (including tropical cyclones, earthquakes, inland floods and wildfires)
Validating existing natural catastrophe models and developing, as required, tailored solutions specific to Hiscox’s needs, leveraging large datasets using advanced data science techniques
Developing new techniques and tools to facilitate the integration and application of the HVOR
Communicating, both internally and externally, various insights about perils and updates on the HVOR
Keeping abreast of new developments in the academic world and translating findings and technical insight into a business context
Those duties require close interaction with the catastrophe model analysts across the group. Working in a collaborative manner, with frequent communication and discussion of results, are thus core parts of the role.

person specification:
Phd in physical sciences (especially Atmospheric and Oceanic sciences and/or Geophysics) from a reputable university
Bachelor’s degree with strong numerate background (Physics, Applied Math etc.)
Postdoctoral research experience related to climate change
Experience with natural catastrophe modelling including Wildfire, Hurricane, European Windstorm, US Flood and Japan typhoon
Demonstrable capabilities in analysing large data sets
Experience in a variety of programming languages including fortran, python and R
Ability to work in a variety of computing environments including Linux systems
Several scientific publications in leading science journals, and specifically addressing climate change
Experience applying machine learning to tackle geophysical problems related to risk quantification
Ability to use google earth engine, mathematical and GIS software
Demonstrable and deep understanding of climate change science
At least 1 year experience working in a reinsurance / insurance context
Good understanding of insurance and re/insurance pricing
Experience developing views of risk in a re/insurance context, in particular to quantify the incremental impact of climate change on portfolio losses
Experience using output from numerical model simulations of the climate system
Experience interacting with clients, investors and stakeholders in the insurance industry about risk modelling concepts
Demonstrable experience developing novel research on the mathematical aspects of catastrophe modelling
Experience in science communication (and climate science, in particular) to a wide range of stakeholders

Title: OMDIA - Market Forecaster
Description:
OMDIA
Market Forecaster
Division Informa Tech
Location London, UK
OMDIA
Omdia's exhaustive intelligence and deep technology expertise allow us to uncover actionable insights that help our customers connect the dots in today's constantly evolving technology environment and empower them to improve their businesses " today and tomorrow.

Market forecasting and quantitative modelling
Delivery of research and consulting projects to time, quality, and cost

Active participation in forecasting related consulting engagements

We're a global business of more than 600 colleagues, operating in 60 markets. Our purpose is to help drive the future by inspiring the Technology community to design, build and run a better digital world. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ongoing development of market forecasting methodologies and processes
Selecting appropriate methodologies for forecasts and quantitative analysis
Balancing data quality with on-time delivery of outputs
Clear justification of assumptions and demonstration of logical thinking to support analysis
Other key responsibilities include:
Successful, on-time delivery of high-quality, highly relevant, and differentiated forecasts that provide quantitative foundations for syndicated research projects across sectors.
Analysis of time series, cross-sectional and panel data. Application of statistical techniques to identify patterns and trends alongside the development of basic techno-economic models and tools to deliver enhanced insight & analysis to clients
Contributing to forecast and quantitative analysis reports, produce clear & consistent methodologies, definitions & assumption documentation; assist in the preparation of client presentations
Successful, on-time execution of forecast products and analysis that are essential components of consulting engagements, delivered to client specifications and quality expectations.
Supporting the Head of Market Forecasting in developing best practices for forecasting, training analysts and other staff on the proper use of forecasting techniques and delivery of associated analysis; focus on continual improvement with the identification, testing and implementation of forecasting methodologies
Secondary research on a service area to develop a broad knowledge on technology, market and macroeconomic trends to support assumptions underlying forecasts and analysis
Focus on continuous improvement through regular solicitation of client and internal feedback.
Partnering with Research Operations for the continuing evolution and refinement of forecasting/data analysis processes and methodologies to optimize quality, timeliness, efficiency, and cost effectiveness of research execution and delivery


Key Internal Relationships:
Data Tools and Analytics to develop, test and implement improved forecasting and data analysis methodologies and products
Research analyst teams for coordination, planning, execution, and support of central forecasting elements for syndicated research deliverables
Sales and Customer Success teams for support for client proposals and interactions
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
Experience in using forecasting techniques to deliver robust strategic insight
Successful track record of building market forecast models using Excel (inc. VBA)
Highly numerate with a strong working knowledge of statistical techniques
Experience of working with statistical software such as Alteryx, Python/R, SPSS, E-views
Comfortable interacting with senior stakeholders across the business and with customers
Strong academic background in a relevant field (e.g. Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering)
KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS
Good knowledge of forecasting techniques and methodologies
Research skills for ongoing analysis and understanding of industry trends and key strategic issues impacting forecasts
Excellent attention to detail and inquisitive mindset to test assumptions
Ability to think logically and organize information, arguments and opinions in a structured way
Good presentation and project management skills

Learning and development plan to assist with your career development
25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, 4 days for volunteering and a day off for your birthday!
Fabulous new office in central London with views of London landmarks, onsite gym and a variety of restaurants and amenities nearby
Work with a high quality of specialist products and service
Bright and friendly staff who are all “expert's experts” and additional training and development for helping you achieve your career aspiration
Life assurance
Other flexible benefits include healthcare, Cycle to Work scheme and season ticket loans
5% Pension match
Share-Match options - become a shareholder
Regular social events and networking opportunities

Title: Operations and Analytics Programme Manager
Description:
The purpose of the BCF is to bring together health and social care budgets to support more person-centred, coordinated care and deliver better outcomes for patients and service users. Each Health and Wellbeing Board (HWB) must agree a BCF plan that sets out how mandatory pooled funding will be used to achieve local priorities for integrated, person centred care.

The Better Care Fund Team (BCFT) is a partnership organisation made up of representatives from the NHS, Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC), the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (MHCLG) and the Local Government Association (LGA).

The purpose of BCFT is to support local systems to successfully deliver their BCF plans and ultimately commission person-centred health and social care services which achieve improved patient and service user experience and outcomes. We also support national partners to develop and implement policy on health and social care integration.

The post holder will be responsible for leading and developing the analytical capability within the Better Care Fund programme which is instrumental in delivering the national policy delivery objectives of the BCF programme; to develop and improve person centred, joined-up, sustainable health and care services and systems which ultimately improve care outcomes for people.

This role will involve a range of responsibilities and activities including:
Developing the architecture of programme related historical and present data and information
Designing the overall approach to data collection, analysis, mechanisms for measurement and frameworks for reporting
Implementing team processes to maintain information and respond to analytical requests
Complying with good data governance practices
Collaborating with policy and delivery leads to draw on the analytical capability to effectively operationalise policy requirements
Design/develop or adopt end-user friendly national data collection mechanisms as needed to support policy delivery
Leading the development of a range of products including national aggregation of locally collected information, summary packs/visualisation dashboards and actionable ad-hoc analysis for insight and decision making
Developing collaborative working relationships with NHSE/I, DHSC, MHCLG and LGA analytical leads and teams
Liaising directly with local system partners including Local Councils, CCGs and Providers as needed
Developing the analytical skill and competency within the team and keeping the team aligned with NHSE/I analytical tools, approaches and datasets

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
WeSwap is the people’s currency exchange! We offer a peer-to-peer travel money platform (iOS, Android and web) enabling travellers to swap currencies directly with each other – avoiding banks and corporates allowing us to offer the best rates on travel money. We want our customers to ‘stress less and travel happy’ hence our mission is to help travellers everywhere swap and manage their currency in the cheapest, fairest, and most transparent way possible. We currently have over 400,000 users and have swapped over £150 million since the start of our journey. If you are looking for the rare opportunity to be part of an exciting fast paced, high growth, tech company then read on!

The Candidate
We are looking for a data analyst to build and scale analytics throughout WeSwap as we rapidly expand in 2020. You will help deliver the second phase of a data pipeline project, trial and implement new business intelligence products, and create incisive, well-designed and accurate analyses. You will be meticulous, embrace TDD and ensure your results are always correct and reproducible.
You will love full stack data pipelines and be enthusiastic about turning your hand to anything: data engineering, visualisation, analysis and, of course, cleansing. We work with an AWS stack (Athena, Glue, Lambda, Quicksight) and Tableau but enthusiasm and potential are more important than technology-specific skills. The ability to create and productionise data pipelines and analyses is more important than formal qualifications.
Most of all, you will love working in a highly innovative, rapid iteration environment, and be able to communicate and diplomatically challenge colleagues at all levels. Data is essential to the ambitious growth of WeSwap in 2020 and this fast-paced role will give the candidate exposure to all areas of the business.

Responsibilities
Design and build data visualisations using business intelligence tools
Ad hoc reporting and analysis using SQL as required by colleagues
Prepare and communicate reports for senior leadership and month-end processes
Gathering requirements for new reports and analyses
Helping to define and report on key metrics
Define data requirements and measures of success for new products and markets
Reconciliations and audit of existing data
Record a backlog of requests and tasks and prioritise with the data lead
Identifying, analysing, and interpreting trends or patterns in complex data sets
Working with our Engineering team to develop and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality
Working across all departments to ensure that requirements are understood, and suitable methodologies are chosen to complete delivery of projects and tasks
Maintaining and developing your own knowledge about technology, systems and approaches to data manipulation

What success will look like…
You will be WeSwap’s go to person for anything relating to data
You will bring transparency to WeSwap’s data therefore creating efficiencies and new opportunities

Qualifications & Skills
Degree, ideally with a mathematical background (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics etc), including experience with descriptive and inferential statistics, but online courses from reputable providers or public analyses and projects on sites like Github or Kaggle are also okay
1-2 years’ experience in an analytical role
SQL, scripting (Python, R, Javascript etc), bash, AWS (Athena, Glue, Lambda) data pipelines or equivalent (Hadoop, Scala, Kafka, Hive etc)
Data visualisation/Business Intelligence tools (Tableau, Sisense, Qlik, Looker, Jupyter, RShiny or similar)
Understanding of key start-up metrics and analysis techniques (cohort retention, churn, DAU/MAU, customer lifetime value etc.)
Some exposure to machine learning and statistical packages in python and/or R (or any other statistical analysis tool)
Good communication skills and understanding of importance of delivering results in a product-focussed company
Ability to manage and prioritise a busy workload

Above all, we want someone who…
Is comfortable communicating with stakeholders at all levels
Is extremely organised and detail oriented
Has a knack for problem solving
Is proactive, not reactive
Is adaptable to fast changing environment, flexibility is key
Can work off their own initiative, and challenge when appropriate
Benefits

Monthly socials
Friday afternoon drinks in the office
Commission free currency exchange

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About the Division

The Business Insight Centre sits within our Finance Division and is responsible for supporting the decision making and progress evaluation processes of UKEF to assist it to achieve its business goals and objectives.

This is achieved through a mixture of regular and ad hoc information, report and dashboard management, the creation of bespoke self-service BI solutions and analytics along with close co-operation with the IT development team to enhance and extend our enterprise data warehouse. The goal of the team is to build a Business Insight centre of excellence and continuously enhance and extend UKEF’s ability to support its customers.

About the Role

The Business Insight Centre (BIC) is team of 7 strong professionals seeking the additional resource of Business Intelligence Analyst to support deliver of the key objectives of the Business Insight Centre.
The BIC is responsible for the definition, creation and delivery of BI/MI solutions, the provision of analysis, insight and information as well as interaction with all areas of the organisation to support the management and improvement of the UKEF loan and insurance business and the achievement of its objectives. One of which is to improve UKEF provides modern and efficient services to our Customers and wide community and able to generate own MI and Analytics using best in class infrastructure and platform. BIC team leads articulated long-term vision, designed roadmap to build modern services to generate data and provide analytics. We need to refine the Roadmap and kick-off work to design business and technical solutions and provide digital capabilities in the BI space.

To facilitate the development of required output, leads an engagement with business and technical stakeholders, we require bright, success driven individual to help Business Insights Centre and UKEF steer Digital agenda and enhance MI Services.

In order to address these challenges, we are looking for someone with a good balance of Business analysis and Business intelligence skills who has the capability to excellent stakeholder management skills and able using various techniques and tools gather requirements for BI/MI solutions, for future demand and catalogue/document them, design TO-BE processes and data need (including data models) and perform a gap analysis where necessary, liaise with technical, development (at all levels) and internal ETL teams to get the data available for MI purposes.

This role would suit to someone who is passionate to improve existing skills and experience in data analysis and business intelligence areas. Who is proactive in acquiring new skills and knowledge to progress in turning data into actionable insights that move the business forward and help us to better understand and be more relevant to our customers; and has a numerate/statistical background, a strong analytical and logical mind-set, and be passionate about the value of data analytics in today's business environment.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you should have a proven track record of delivering business intelligence reports, creating dashboards and analysing existing environment in order to provide effective solutions designs for Capability improvements. We are looking for someone to provide knowledge, expertise and support to depots, departments and customers by way of analysis and reporting, ensuring that information is accessible and available for business consumption.

We are looking for someone with advanced SQL knowledge and Cognos Reporting solutions (and preferably SQL server 2012/2016, primarily SSRS but SSIS and SSAS are also desirable). Job Posting 23-Jun-2020, 3:23:19 PM

The Bank of England is the UK's central bank. Our mission is to deliver monetary and financial stability for the British people.

The Bank of England is a diverse organisation. Each of its 4,000 plus people are committed to public service and dedicated to promoting the good of the people of the United Kingdom by maintaining monetary and financial stability.

Department Overview

The Bank’s mission depends on data and analytics, through their role in the Bank's decisions, its operations, and the information it provides to the public
Data and analytics have received a new level of senior attention and backing in the Bank, following Huw van Steenis' Future of Finance review, the Bank's response, and the Governor's Mansion House speech. The Bank is now publicly committed to delivering a "world class regtech and data strategy". A new Directorate, Data and Analytics Transformation (DAT), has been created to lead on this. DAT is the Bank’s centre of expertise for data strategy implementation and the compilation, dissemination and publication of regulatory and statistical data. We support analysis, policy and decision making by the Bank’s Committees, UK government departments and international organisations. Key stakeholders for our work include MPC, FPC and PRA Boards and our data are used in the Inflation Report, Financial Stability Report, Credit Conditions Review, Stress Test Results, FPC Core Indicators and Quarterly Bulletin. Decisions made in these Boards and from these reports have national economic significance.

Within DAT, a new division called Data Strategy Implementation Division (DSID) leads the definition and implementation of the Bank's data and analytics strategy. This strategy touches on practically all functions of the Bank, due to the central importance of data and analysis in our daily work. It also affects the firms from whom we collect data under statutory powers, the domestic and international official sector bodies with whom we share our data and analytics, and the public who receive data and analytics outputs published by the Bank.

Through the 2020s we intend to transform the way the Bank defines and collects data, the way it manages data and its capacity to analyse data, to make our use of data and analytics as insightful, reliable and efficient as possible. In addition, DSID leads the operation of the shared data and analytics services that mean colleagues can harness the power of data and analytics in their BAU work today.

Role Description

This is an exciting opportunity to join and shape a brand new function providing data related business support to an ecosystem of services based around the Bank’s data lake and other critical tools. The objective is to ensure operational processes run smoothly to fulfil our vision as set out in our target operating model. The role currently has no existing equivalence so there is scope to shape ongoing working processes and take ownership of different elements of the work.

The successful candidate will ideally have knowledge of some data governance and data management concepts such as master data management, reference data, data cataloguing, metadata, data quality and data ownership; though the expectation is that some candidates will have more knowledge in some areas more so than others. Advise on policies and practices related to the data lake
Advise on security and confidentiality considerations for their data
Advise on the environments available in the data lake and make recommendations
Advise, with examples, on the need for data quality

Register datasets, and train others to register datasets, so they appear on the data inventory

Ensure compliance with security policies for the consumable views

Monitor collection and ingestion of reference datasets into the Bank's MDM platform
Training

Become proficient enough in certain tools used for processes to train others
Governance

Create artefacts that support business operations around the data lake ecosystem
Create M.I to showcase operational efficiency

The successful candidate will be proactive and self-sufficient. You will need to develop deep working relationships with key stakeholders such as Technology, Project Managers, various data experts and the wider DAT team. You may also on occasion be asked to step outside of your core role and support high profile endeavours such as the data strategy or emerging project work.

Business analyst skills such as problem solving and critical thinking.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
An opportunity to join our small team in London in its growth phase with venture funding and a global customer base. We are a SaaS start-up engaged in rich video and speech data capture and AI analytics embedded within the workflows for large field forces (field engineers, field services, job auditing, job reporting, health-and-safety, sales and much more).
Education, Skills & Experience
Essential
Bachelors/Masters/PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or equivalent.
Excellent Python and Software Engineering, 4+ years’ experience.
Good knowledge of data structures, data modelling and software architecture.
Good understanding of Linear algebra, Probability and Bayesian statistics.
Have worked with Keras, PyTorch, Tensorflow and Scikit-learn etc. - Ideally production level experience.
Ability to explain and write complex concepts in simple language.
Keen interest in prototyping, experiments and hypothesis-driven thinking.
Good to have:
Some exposure to image and object detection algorithms, OpenCV etc.
Some experience with web API services and standards (REST etc.)
Some exposure with AW, Google or MS Azure ML infrastructure.
Role:
Analyse raw data for assessing quality, cleaning and structuring for downstream processing.
Generate actionable insights for business improvements.
Supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning algorithms for real business problems.
NLU/NLP and computer vision-based predictions and inference for B2B use cases.
Model building, validation, verification.
Hyperparameter tuning and deployment, where necessary.
Collaborate with the engineering team to bring analytical prototypes to production.
Technologies:
Mobile and Web apps are used to capture/manipulate/view structured multimedia data. This data is stored, analysed and labelled on the AWS cloud. Various integrations push the analysis results into other systems such as field service management systems, CRM, etc. We use GitHub, travis-ci, code-pipeline and cloudformation and a devops approach to achieve a high release cadence through our CD pipeline. We use Django rest framework and Postgresql to provide our primary REST API interface. Our web-app is built using react. AWS SQS queues are then used to distribute work to a variety of processing systems / microservices which use a combination of commodity analytics APIs (e.g. aws transcribe, google speech, aws rekognition) and bespoke algorithms and models (e.g. tensorflow) to provide speech, image and video analytics.
As you would expect our system also provides various collaboration, administration, management and security related features around the central video capture and analytics.
We offer both shared and dedicated deployments of the software; by defining all of our infrastructure as code we are able to easily deploy dedicated copies of our entire system into dedicated VPCs for our large customers. Many of our customers have stringent security requirements around their video data.
What is on offer:
Competitive remuneration and benefits
Family-friendly flexible working time, home working and remote working in combination with office working in London (Paddington area)
Working environment:
Our engineering organisation is distributed across multiple locations and time zones, so we use a variety of tools and processes to enable effective distributed working. Our organisation has employees with a wide variety of nationalities, experience levels and backgrounds.
Direct applications only please, and no agency redirects and referrals.

Title: Experimentation Analyst
Description:
We are looking for an Experimentation Analyst specialising in experimentation to join our Product & Engineering team.
You will be leading A/B and multivariate experimentation and analysis for Reach’s network of digital news products, including websites and mobile apps. This role exposes you to various angles of the business, ranging from our commercial teams to the tools our writers use. You will also be working within our growing data team, made up of talented engineers, data scientists and fellow analysts. The insights gathered from experiments will be used to guide business strategy and will allow you to interact with key stakeholders.
We breathe our values of Collaboration, Determination, Imagination and Customer Focus, underpinning the work our talented employees produce every single day, from editorial and HR, to technology and print. We strongly believe in the benefits of flexible working and autonomy in our day to day jobs.
So on that note, who are we?
We are the UK's largest news publisher, with influential national newsbrands such as the Daily Mirror, Daily Express, Sunday People, OK! Magazine, Daily Record, and more than 100 distinguished regional titles. Every day our newsbrands - national and regional, in print and online - reach millions of people up and down the country.
Last year we sold 620 million newspapers, with 5.8 million readers of one of our brands each month. Our network of over 70 websites provide 24/7 coverage of news, sport and showbiz stories, with 8.1 billion page views per year.

Key Responsibilities
What will the role involve?
The successful candidate will be responsible for Reach’s experimentation road map. They will champion experimentation within and without the Product & Engineering team, including:
Helping define experiment objectives and select the best approach
Liaising with the UX Research team to combine qualitative and quantitative research and take ideas from concept to prototype to experiment
Helping development teams build experiments, implement tracking, segment users and capture data, using Google Optimise, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and other relevant tools
Analysis of the results, communication of the outcomes – including through visualisations – and recommending the best course of action
Conducting deep analysis of both experimental and sitewide analytics data to identify trends, explain findings and recommend further investigations
Implement and maintain processes to follow best experimentation practices across product teams, e.g. maintaining a centralised log of experiments to avoid conflicts and capture learnings
The Ideal Candidate
Who are we looking for?
Degree-level education or equivalent experience
Statistical modelling and statistical significance testing used in A/B, MVT, or block design etc. testing
Knowledge of experimentation best practice
Testing tools, especially Google Optimize
Digital analytics tools, especially Google Analytics
A scripting language such as JS, R, Python, SQL
Business acumen and leadership, including ability to weigh multiple qualitative and quantitative factors and make decisions or recommend a course of action to senior managers
Experience with user-centered and hypothesis-driven lean working practices in agile teams
Uses data to inform, explain and justify decisions
Communicates effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders
Collaboration, team working and managing relationships
Results-driven, resilient, flexible and keen to apply learning
Package Description
In addition to competitive salaries, 25 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays) and a contributory pension scheme, Reach plc have a wealth of flexible benefits on offer. These include holiday purchase scheme, cycle scheme, a technology scheme in conjunction with Curry’s PC World, car scheme, health cash plan, employee loans and lots of high street discounts.
Reach plc believes diversity brings benefits for our customers, our business and our people. This is why we are committed to being an inclusive employer and encourage applications from all suitable applicants irrespective of background, circumstances, age, disability, gender identity, ethnicity, religion or belief and sexual orientation.

Title: Finance Assistant Maternity Contract
Description:

Finance Assistant Maternity Cover Contract

We’re hiring!

You will assist the Finance Manager in the day to day running of the Finance Function. You will be covering sales ledger, purchase ledger, month/quarter end reporting, balance Sheet reconciliations, and database management. Aon plc (NYSE:AON) is a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement and health solutions. Aon is an equal opportunities employer. Aon's recruitment and selection policy ensures the best possible skill mix of colleagues and the highest quality candidates are appointed using objective job-related criteria.

Preparing invoices using iControls for multiple companies.

Assisting Finance manager with ‘Month, Quarter & Year End balance sheet reconciliations.

Your skills and qualifications will ideally include:

Ideally you will be AAT part or fully qualified, with a good understanding of month end routines.
Experience of Workday useful but not essential.
Prior experience of managing a database desirable.
Strong communication / interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
Good Excel skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively in a team and individual.
Flexible approach and commitment to meeting ‘month end’ deadlines.
Proactive attitude to chasing colleagues and seeing tasks through to their conclusion.
Ability to work effectively in a team and individual.

Our Colleague Experience

Every day, our colleagues make a difference, work with the best, own their potential, and value one another. Together, we share this one purpose: to empower economic and human possibility around the world. This unifying goal is at the heart of our identity, and it lives in everything we do. We offer you

A competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization. Aon is an equal opportunities employer. Title: Data Analyst - German News Classification
Description:
Deliver the German news that matters most to our clients. You’re the type of person who always knows about the latest news trends and has a real passion for text analysis and technology. Help to build the product which, in an instant, can deliver news to change the direction of our clients’ critically important business decisions.
Do you have the creativity, customer relationship and technical skills to help us further improve our German-language news product. If so, we are looking for you!
What’s the Role?
As a member of our News Indexing team, you will be responsible for automated classification of the world's most important German-language financial and economic news with the aim of further entrenching Bloomberg as the leader in the financial news market. You will use specialized software in order to create hierarchical rules that automatically classify Bloomberg and third-party news, as well as data from social media sites. You need to have a keen interest in news and perform research in order to identify news topics that are relevant to the German market and modify or create news classification rules accordingly. You will also identify opportunities to create efficiency in our processes and execute on your ideas.
In order to build the strongest local-language products, you will closely collaborate with our partners in Product Strategy, Sales, Analytics and Engineering to understand our clients’ needs and build a market-leading German news product. You will also partner with our Sales and Analytics groups to promote our German news product and ensure strong customer uptake.
Finally, you will have the chance to be involved in the fields of statistical classification, natural language processing, data science and text analysis as we build the next-generation of Bloomberg’s proprietary news classification products.
What we do in Content Indexing
We use proprietary and open-source software to automatically retrieve, parse, organize and tag news from social media sites, news feeds, web sites and other sources that run on the Bloomberg Professional Service. We also build and maintain our complex taxonomy of classification tags according to our clients’ needs. Our work is not theoretical or hyper-specific – it is practical and impactful.

Associate Principal, Real - World & Analytics Solutions, Enterprise Solutions
IQVIA™ is The Human Data Science Company™, focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. Formed through the merger of IMS Health and Quintiles, IQVIA offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward.
In our Real - World & Analytics Solutions (RWAS) Enterprise Solutions team, we design and deliver innovative, technology-enabled evidence programs for the pharmaceutical industry. We apply scientific rigor and advanced analytics to real world data in order to help our clients improve population health. This entrepreneurial team works globally, partnering with regional colleagues throughout the enterprise to diagnose critical business issues and deliver evidence-based solutions.
Real - World & Analytics Solutions, Enterprise Solutions Team
We are strategic thinkers, innovative technologists, deep subject matter experts and data evangelists whom are passionate about driving better performance in healthcare. We are collaborative, intellectually curious, entrepreneurial and disruptive. Plus, we have the resource and structure of a large company in an environment where we empower our people to create their own solutions.
Our work can be complex and difficult but that is often the case when you are doing work that no one has done before. We also do not have a templated approach to our work so we require people who can innovate with their practice as well as their solutions. If you have the right levels of intellectual curiosity and a passion to discover the real impact of medicines in the real world, then you’ll fit right in.
Why Join?
Those who join us become part of a recognized global leader still willing to challenge the status quo to improve patient care. At IQVIA, you will have access to the most cutting-edge technology, the largest data sets, the best analytics tools and, in our opinion, some of the finest minds in the Healthcare industry.
You can drive your career at IQVIA and choose the path that best defines your development and success. With exposure across diverse geographies, capabilities, and vast therapeutic and information and technology areas, you can seek opportunities to change and grow without boundaries.
The Role
You will join a high profile, talented and fast paced team where you will manage teams of Associates, Consultants and Managers in the design, development and delivery of large, technical RWAS projects. You’ll gain exposure to client facing projects and innovation initiatives to develop new Real-World & Analytics Solutions product offerings.
The successful candidate will be able to achieve rapid professional development, learning from and being coached by members of the world’s leading and most innovative RWAS team.
As an Associate Principal within Enterprise Solutions team you’ll be responsible for:
Planning, organizing and managing resources to bring about the successful completion of specific project goals and objectives
Leading teams to execute high quality research and analysis
Designing, structuring and delivering client reports and presentations
Developing client relationships through face-to-face discussions, workshops, telephone and email contact
Providing expert guidance on RWAS and the Real-World Data (RWD) landscape to junior colleagues
Leading the development of proposals for new projects / commercial opportunities in partnership with Principals and/or Senior Principals
Taking an active role in business development, building client relationships and identifying new business opportunities with clients
Leading quality assurance efforts for all projects within scope – in particular for client analytical work
Administrating control of the fees and expenses during Projects (travel, meetings, organizing invoicing with finance, etc)
Developing broader and deeper knowledge of consulting methodologies and the pharmaceutical market through on the job exposure and formal training
Building deep knowledge of IQVIA data sources and further developing knowledge of the broader RWD landscape
Supporting on initiatives around IQVIA’s broad RWE strategy (e.g. target assessment / due diligence, etc.)
Coaching project team members and supporting them to fulfil their personal objectives
Acting as a formal coach / mentor for up to 3 junior team members on an ongoing basis (i.e. not just in projects)
An Associate Principal will usually be staffed on 2-3 projects in parallel ensuring a broad exposure to the wide range of activities that Enterprise Solutions undertake in a rapid timeframe, as well as the opportunity to demonstrate a broad skill set.
Desired Skills and Experience
Candidates interested in joining Enterprise Solutions as an Associate Principal will have:
Extensive experience in healthcare / life sciences or the Pharmaceutical industry
Experience in healthcare / life sciences with focus on strategic business cases, product development, technical architecture. Strong capability in managing projects and juggling priorities so that deadlines are met while retaining consistently high- quality outcomes
Experience of working in sizable/multi-disciplined teams and supervising / guiding junior team members
Experience of developing credible relationships with senior level managers and executives in the pharmaceutical/healthcare industry
Knowledge of key issues and current developments in the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries
Demonstrable analytical, interpretative and problem-solving skills
Excellent presentation, communication and client influencing skills
Well-developed written and verbal communication skills including presentations, chairing meetings, workshop facilitation, business and report writing
Knowledge of consulting methodologies, tools and techniques would be desirable
Experience of SAS analytics would be desirable
Qualifications
In addition to the skills and experience above, candidates interested in joining as an Associate Principal will have:
BA/BSc from a top university, preferably in a relevant and / or numerate subject such e.g. economics, life sciences, chemistry, engineering etc
Salary
Competitive Salary + Benefits
Application Closing Date
30th November 2018

Title: Interim Intelligence Officer (Voice Analytics)

Description:
Organisation Details

Cabinet Office supports the Prime Minister and ensures the smooth running of government - from developing policy, to modernising public services. We welcome talented people from all backgrounds with the skills and the commitment to build a career in the Civil Service.
The Cabinet Office Purpose is:

to maintain the integrity of the Union, coordinate the security of the realm and sustain a flourishing democracy;
to support the design and implementation of HM Government’s policies and the Prime Minister’s priorities; and
to ensure the delivery of the finest public services by attracting and developing the best public servants and improving the efficiency of government.

The work Cabinet Office delivers is vast and therefore presents opportunities to develop your skills and experience in a variety of critical government agendas.
An organisation of approximately 7,000 employees, the Cabinet Office is a vibrant, modern and exciting place to work, attracting a diverse workforce which represents the people we serve. Our main offices are in London, but we have staff based around the UK.
At the heart of this are our Cabinet Office values. To deliver our Purpose and help make Cabinet Office a great place to work, we all commit to:-

treating everyone with Respect
actively Collaborate, and
build Trust

We have an aspiration to become the most inclusive employer across the Civil Service. We have a number of staff benefits, including flexible working, and access to a number of staff support networks to ensure we meet this.

Business unit information

The Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants (FEDG) team is a growing, friendly group of experts in counter fraud, debt and grants who coordinate and drive activities across government and the wider public sector, challenging everyone to improve practice and secure better value for money. These three functions provide strategic leadership and set cross-government standards for fraud, error, debt and grant initiatives.

Estimates show government could be losing between £37 and £49 billion per year to fraud and error. Debt owed to government currently stands at £22bn. Grant spending accounts for £115 billion spend each year, which is around 20% of government expenditure.

Job Description

This role sits within the Data Analytics Development Team. You will be working to achieve the successful delivery of a portfolio of data and analytics projects within a specialist team framework. Current projects involve working with new data sharing legislation such as the Digital Economy Act and projects relating to the residual risk identified in the COVID-19 stimulus scheme.

This role will be to provide support across the team, carrying out research and project delivery activities, to ensure we continually increase our understanding of the counter fraud landscape, as well as providing support to the team, including supporting the coordination of work streams across government.

The successful candidate will be expected to produce quality-briefing packs for use internally and externally with stakeholders, to reflect the bigger picture in respect of current counter fraud activity.

Key to this role is the building and managing relationships with stakeholders to understand current counter-fraud activity and inform future policy decisions. It also involves understanding counter fraud activities and tools to assess their effectiveness. The role involves significant collaboration with other government departments, the private sector and internally within the FEDG Team.

We are looking for a well organised professional with excellent communication skills. You will help to design, develop, and deliver ground-breaking counter fraud projects. You will be expected to adopt existing projects and prepare projects for seamless handover to other team members.

You will need to be comfortable engaging with all levels of stakeholders across a wide range of Government departments and private sector organisations.

Essential Criteria:

Comfortable with data and technology and be able to recognise the limitations of both when it comes to fraud problem solving;
Good research skills and experience, ideally in an academic environment;
Strong written and oral communication skills;
Strong time management and organisational skills;
Good prioritisation skills;
Experience of managing meetings and taking comprehensive and accurate minutes;
Experience of pulling together and evaluating information across a broad range of stakeholders.

Desirable Criteria:

Having an understanding of fraud and countering fraud and an experience of working in the area;
Managing information using computer systems and applications;
Creating and maintaining management information.

Note: An employee may be required to carry out other duties within the scope of the grade and within the limits of their skill, competence and training; the post holder may also occasionally be required to carry out responsibilities at a higher level as agreed with their line manager.

Please note that this role requires SC clearance, which would normally require 5 years’ UK residency in the past 5 years. This is not an absolute requirement but supplementary checks may be required where individuals have not lived in the UK for the required period. This may mean that your security clearance (and therefore your appointment) will take longer or, in some cases, not be possible.

Title: Bloomberg Intelligence - Equity Analyst - ESG
Description:
Apply Now
Companies are the backbone of the stock and bond markets. Bloomberg Intelligence ("BI") conducts in-depth research on large and midsize companies to help stock and bond investors effectively evaluate those companies. We analyse the unique attributes of each business, how it competes against other companies in its industry and how the business strategies and successes translate into financial results. Our analysis also focuses on the industry looking at the changing landscape and how it will affect company performance. Our analysts also research the technology, regulation, litigation and economies that will shape the environment for these companies and the related industry impact.
BI research is a combination of written analysis accompanied by interactive charting and analytics created from company reported data as well as industry and government data. Analysts review, check and curate this data into comprehensive and logically arranged dashboards to support their own research and to provide Bloomberg Terminal users a platform to view and analyse the data as well.

As the investment research arm of Bloomberg, Bloomberg Intelligence currently has a global dedicated team of 5 Analysts – and is continuing to grow. The team leverages Bloomberg’s differentiated platform, proprietary technology, data analytics, and culture of innovation – to deliver unique ESG and thematic insight and solutions to our clients.

Through research publication, data management and marketing, the analyst is expected to effectively communicate relevant insights and investment themes, identifying financial impacts of complex issues. In this role, the analyst will also have the opportunity to contribute to broader ESG initiatives within Bloomberg and in the markets.
We’ll trust you to: -

Produce outstanding notes and reports concerning ESG issues, themes, and trends affecting companies, industries and financial markets - including the creation of impactful materials with a keen eye for visual representation of complex and striking data and findings
Translate research and analysis into investment implications in collaboration with market strategists and industry and company analysts
Perform analysis and modelling of ESG data such as emission, proxy voting as well as financial metrics in order to identify meaningful signals
Contribute to the wider ESG product and data development projects within Bloomberg

Foster collaboration between with other research analysts, the BI industry teams

Engage with clients to provide views and perspective in capacity as an ESG specialist

The successful candidate will possess a passion for critical thinking about both ESG and financial markets, as well as a desire build an individual research franchise and be part of a fast-growing team.
Previous experience in an analytical research role either in Asset Management, working with Asset managers or owners, or a closely related business is essential.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills are key. The analyst is expected to individually publish research reports and regularly collaborate to publish research with Bloomberg Intelligence colleagues. The analyst is expected to expertly communicate ESG investment conclusions with Bloomberg terminal clients via phone calls, in-person meetings and online chat, and will likewise articulate research findings with Bloomberg News and Media and at internal and external events.

Solid understanding of financial markets, investment theories and asset valuations
Passion for investing and sustainability
Research and modelling skills:
Track record of leading analysis and authoring thought leadership related to ESG
Excellent written and oral communication skills to articulate methods, insights and recommendations from complex and quantitative analysis in a compelling and influential way, both internally and externally.
Strong analytical and decision-making ability, combined with intellectual curiosity and honesty.
Academic background:
A Degree in Accounting/Finance and experience working with Accounting/Financial Statements preferred or equivalent experience
Working Knowledge of Bloomberg Terminal would be a plus

MBA/CFA would be a plus

Title: Chief Modeller-London/Amsterdam/Munich
Description:
SYSTEMIQ is a different kind of company. Our purpose is to catalyse good disruptions in critical economic systems, with a current focus on land use/forestry, energy, and materials/circular economy. These disruptions are not only vital to the future of humanity and our planet, they also open up immense opportunities for the businesses that drive them. The UN Global Goals and the Paris Agreement have set the targets we must reach to protect the earth and make sure everyone in the growing global population has a chance to prosper. But, so far, most change has been incremental. We need to transform economic systems much faster to hit the targets and stop the degradation of natural resources.
SYSTEMIQ connects the right people, ideas, technologies, and capital to transform economic systems. We do this through four five activities:
Convene and support coalitions of leaders to shape policies and business strategies that will rapidly transform economic activity
Work with companies that want to be pioneers in and drivers of change towards more sustainable systems
Co-create and incubate the market solutions most likely to build regenerative economic systems
Invest our own venture capital and expertise in opportunities with the biggest potential to drive rapid system change
Direct larger pools of capital into regenerative economic systems, so that these scale and multiply.
In order to deliver in these areas, we recruit and develop distinctive and varied individuals who strive to achieve our mission, challenge the status quo and act as change leaders.

Position:


We are looking for an experienced chief modeller to work within teams on exciting opportunities in the UK. This highly strategic work involves some of the most prominent institutions in the field, has a very international character and aims at significant impact over the next 3-5 years. It requires very advanced problem solving, analytical and relationship skills to deliver breakthrough insights, action and results. Our teams are typically small (2-5 people) and you might be involved in more than one project/venture at a time. Occasionally, you may be working with one of our partners in a standalone capacity.

SYSTEMIQ is looking for an individual with a strong record of analytics, achievement and disruptive impact in solving complex problems. You have proven results in different contexts and are keen to work in a young, entrepreneurial company where you can get involved in a variety of work and make maximum impact. You are passionate about SYSTEMIQ's mission and approach to system change.
We are specifically looking for:
Significant prior experience in strategy / analytical projects in consulting or industry that involve large amounts of data and high uncertainty. Prior experience in the Mining, Upstream Oil and Gas sector, or Plastics is also highly desired
Advanced capability and passion for translating complex systems into intuitive and well-structured models
Ability to develop economic models based on stock and flow of material volumes over time
Proven quantitative / analytical skills
Experience developing and/or designing easy-to-use user interface(s) & creating easy-to-use, handover-ready models that can be modified by our project partners at later stages
Experience with Python, R, Matlab, SQL or other commonly user coding languages – big plus
Understanding of financial considerations of business model design (P&L analysis, cash-flow analysis, balance sheet impacts)
Passionate to tackle global environmental challenges at a system level
Natural alignment with SYSTEMIQ values; Creativity, Challenge, Collaborate, Change and Care


Other information:


We are keen to receive applications from all parts of the community.
Please send your application via our website. Any questions on the application process please feel free to email Michael Round at Michael.Round@systemiq.earth.

Title: Director, Global Data & Analytics - Pet Nutrition
Description:
DATA & ANALYTICS AT MARS PETCARE
The Mars Petcare Segment consists of five Divisions: Pet Nutrition, Royal Canin, Mars Veterinary Health N. America, Mars Veterinary Health International & Diagnostics, and Kinship. Under this new organization of Petcare Product and Service brands, we launched our data strategy in 2018 with an objective to "Create a Better World for Pets by extending global leadership in Nutrition, Health and Services powered by data".
With the breadth and scale of our Petcare businesses we have unique and unrivalled data assets. The potential to create benefits for pets and sustainable competitive advantage is huge and we need to seize this opportunity now.
Our data assets consist of a variety of sources: veterinary data including appointment and invoice details as well as the medical histories and diagnostic details this provides, breed and disease marker data from our DNA diagnostics business (Wisdom Health), location and activity tracking data from our Whistle business, and we have sales data, consumer data, and valuable information about retailers, veterinarians, breeders and shelters from our nutrition business. We also have third party data providing us with product purchasing insights and the potential to develop deeper and broader views into Petcare shopping through collaboration and D2C engagement.
PET NUTRITION: POWERED BY DATA
Pet Nutrition supports pet parents around the world with high quality, science-backed nutrition and care products. Pet Nutrition makes A BETTER WORLD FOR PETS by innovating to meet the need of every pet and by making better food accessible to as many pets as possible. Pet Nutrition is working right now to rapidly expand the number of pets we serve. That means at Pet Nutrition we have the opportunity to do and try everything, because we need to reach every pet and every pet parent. Pet parents have needs and preferences that are as diverse as they are. For Pet Nutrition, the real magic lies in unlocking the power of 1:1 relationships with as many pet parents as possible. Data is a key enabler for us as we
WHY JOIN US?
This is a game-changing leadership role in our business, and more broadly in the world of Data & Analytics. It is incredibly exciting for many different ways that the right candidates will truly be energized and passionate about.
Leading a totally new capability within our Division: opportunities with a relatively blank canvass, at a global scale in this space are rare. This is a unique chance to get this journey started, to set the direction, establish the ways of working and grow the talent
It is entrepreneurial, and it has the backing of a scale business with serious strategic ambition and leadership backing
The variety of data and spectrum of possibilities is immense and also unique. Most businesses have relatively narrow sector focus. Petcare is our scope and the data assets we can bring to bear are from genetics, medical records, activity tracking, nutrition consumption, shopping behavior, lifestyle, marketing response, digital behavior … across millions of individuals and many geographic markets. These assets together at scale have perhaps never been available like this anywhere else. This is a treasure-trove of data that will have your imagination racing. There are so many possibilities and having both a keen pioneering instinct as well as a focus on practical outcomes will be key to unlocking tangible benefits and value
We are truly purpose driven and consumer-centric. We are powering our business with data to create a better world for pets. We are aiming for outcomes that improve pets lives and ours as pet parents too. Yes, we are also focused on sustaining and growing our business, as our 5 principles show, we see this mutuality as fundamental to how we operate
HOW YOU'LL CREATE A BETTER WORLD FOR PETS
We are searching for an experienced Data & Analytics leader to drive divisional efforts to be "Powered by Data" in the Pet Nutrition division. This role will articulate the strategic opportunities for data analytics, to develop and deliver the roadmap of use cases from Science to Marketing, to develop the resources and upskill the businesses, and to drive the data strategy all as a connected part of the Petcare ecosystem.
Reporting into our CFO with a dual reporting responsibility to the Global Petcare Data & Analytics leader, this role will engage stakeholders within Pet Nutrition to create and deliver the Data & Analytics strategy, the role will also provide connectivity with other Divisions for broader Ecosystem impact and benefit creation.
Responsibilities include:
Lead the "Powered By Data" Strategy, roadmap and implementation for Pet Nutrition
Engage Pet Nutrition leadership to define the strategic priorities for "Powered By Data" – identifying where our Pet and Pet Owner data and analytics capabilities can drive new levels of pet benefits and/or business performance
Create the roadmap for implementation from analytics to activation in conjunction with the local teams implementing and in alignment with Ecosystem best practices
Ensure resourcing is aligned with the plan in cooperation with the global Petcare Data & Analytics team, and budget plans reconciled as appropriate across the business
Agree and monitor the KPIs and metrics for the Division strategy
Develop the Pet Nutrition Data & Analytic (D&A) resources and drive broader upskilling and change
Lead the design of the Pet Nutrition D&A organization and talent for global, regional and local market needs in partnership with P&O (People and Organization) and global D&A lead'
Oversee the talent acquisition, development, rotation and retention in line with global talent standards and approaches, including hiring and leading the first roles
Align talent needs for ecosystem initiatives with global D&A team, so they are able to support
Partner with P&O and Global D&A to drive Division up-skilling in Data Management and rollout of our Powered by Data plans, and continue to reinforce with relevant communications and appropriate access to data and tools
Lead the development of Division data assets, privacy frameworks and data standards as part of the broader Petcare data strategy
Appoint a Data Director for the Division to lead this area under your guidance
Oversee the Division Data Strategy
Ensure effective data provision to the Ecosystem solution and return flows of ecosystem data to benefit Division systems, applications and users. Ensure changes are managed effectively
Oversee data access rights and rules, and the processes to ensure appropriate access is maintained
Contribute to consumer and pet privacy frameworks, terms, consents and approaches to ensure we position ourselves to empower consumers, to leverage effectively data for their advantage, to abide by all laws and relevant best practices
Drive Master Data Management collaboration and standards, and provide leadership in key areas of consumer- and pet-oriented data
Connect and collaborate effectively across Petcare to ensure our efforts are consistent, complementary and enable ecosystem benefits that are greater than the sum of the parts
Role model the ecosystem approach within the Division
Ensure the Division is contributing to the ecosystem data asset and best practices and supporting the needs other divisions might have to power their businesses
Develop and champion Pet and Pet Parent centric approaches even where consumer choices or pet needs might prioritize a different Division's solution above yours
Lead Division contribution to the broader Petcare strategies and governance of our Powered by Data efforts
WHO WE NEED TO CHART THE FUTURE OF PET CARE
We strive to hire people who are passionate about our mission: creating a better world for pets. For all of our roles, we look for candidates who exemplify our attributes through consistent behaviors. We believe what we do is just as important as how we do it, and we aim to hire people who care deeply about our Purpose and authentically live our Principles:
Quality
Responsibility
Mutuality
Efficiency
Freedom

And for this role, we hope you have the following skills to knock it out of the dog park:
Deep and rich experience in working with data and deliver business-changing analytics, data science and marketing personalization
15 years of experience in this space, with particular focus on working with consumer centric data for consumer-centric outcomes
Proven experience in creating and chairing meetings with senior stakeholders
Strong understanding of Data Protection and Privacy principles and practices including GDPR
Proven ability in working with technical teams on data, data science, advanced analytics, visualization and statistics to guide and lead them to impactful outcomes
Great inter-personal skills and insight story-telling capabilities
Proven ability to guide and partner with senior business leaders including Division and Segment Leadership teams, C-level technology leaders, Chief Privacy Officer
Great at developing new relationships, driving positive change, and highly innovative
Ability to motivate and influence highly skilled professionals across geographies and business units to achieve major organizational goals
Ability to communicate complex subjects in a clear and simple way
Superior time management, planning, project management and organizational skills
Strong written and oral communication skills. Attention to detail is a must
Willingness to travel internationally as needed

Designing strategic business models: helping clients identify the optimum business, organisational, or commercial models to more effectively deliver their objectives;

Strategic cost reduction: helping clients determine where, and how, to cut costs whilst seeking to enhance delivery and achieve policy outcomes;
Harnessing innovation: helping clients to stimulate innovation, adapt to strategic disruptions (e.g. technology – AI / robotics), and enable more effective policy delivery; and
Turning strategy into reality: Supporting clients to understand the required change, the challenges of implementation, and adjusting the strategy in response.
Generating analysis and insight: executing rigorous and insightful analysis to build an evidence base to support strategy development and change;
Tools, skills and frameworks: developing an understanding of effective tools, skills and frameworks that can be brought to bear on new client problems, deploying them appropriately and sharing as best practice within the team;
Team management: managing and supporting junior staff in order to ensure successful project delivery;

Liaising with other internal teams (including our Digital Strategy, Innovation, Cyber Security and Data Analytics teams) to ensure the effective application of the subject matter expertise available, and a seamless client experience;
Continuous Learning: proactively developing your own skills, seeking feedback, building knowledge, and sharing your insight with colleagues; and
Supporting the management of the practice and successful business development.

This is a permanent role with a degree of flexibility. We do encourage careful consideration of agile ways of working, both formal and informal arrangements that allow for the best outcomes for our people and our clients.

Description
About this role
Introduction to Multi-Asset Strategies and Client Portfolio Solutions
BlackRock’s Multi-Asset Strategies (MAS) group includes tactical asset allocation, factor-based strategies, income funds, target date, target risk, and impact investing products. Our team of over 300 multi-asset investment professionals manages a range of pooled vehicles, model portfolios, and customized mandates for a diversified client base.
The Multi-Asset Strategies group sits alongside Client Portfolio Solutions (CPS) which is the investment area focused on delivering custom whole-portfolio asset allocation and portfolio construction services and solutions. These experts are segmented by client channels, including DC and Wealth Management Platforms, Pensions, Insurance, Foundations & Endowments, Family Office, Official Institutions and Multi-nationals.
CPS brings together the best of BlackRock’s real-world investment expertise, premier asset allocation and macro research, and industry-leading risk analysis capabilities to offer our clients a holistic, differentiated portfolio construction experience. Our team is made up of experts in strategic asset allocation design who partner with investment professionals in Fixed Income, Active Equity, ETF, Index, MAS and Alternative asset classes to blend multiple sources of return to maximize long-term performance.
Together, MAS & CPS have $640 billion in assets under management and have teams located in San Francisco, New York, London and throughout Asia Pacific.
Position Overview
The Core PM team is responsible for a wide array of portfolio management responsibilities across MAS and CPS. In London, the primary role of the Core PM team is to partner with the CPS, MPS, Factors and Diversified Strategies teams which manage global, multi-asset portfolios held by institutional and individual retail investors. The Core PM team partners in portfolio construction and new business design with CIOs and researchers, contributes to investment research, handles all aspects of implementation, and drives enhancements across the PM operating platform.
BlackRock is seeking an Associate or Vice-President to join the Core Portfolio Management team, primarily focused on the CPS Client CIO business. The successful candidate will have a portfolio construction focus, driving enhancements to best practice in construction and implementation of market and manager views and supporting the scale of portfolio management best practices across institutional and retail portfolios. The individual is expected to contribute to and influence investment decision making, including asset allocation and market views, the method of implementation and in manager selection. The individual will possess strong analytical and quantitative skills as well as a demonstrated ability to work in a collaboration with a wide range of partner teams and stakeholders.
Given the focus on multi-asset approaches among our clients and within BlackRock, this role has considerable scope for the right individual to have an impact on both the success of the team as well as the broader MAS and MPS businesses. The successful candidate will possess outstanding attention to detail, excellent interpersonal skills, and have a passion for thinking critically about financial markets both across and within asset classes.
Responsibilities:
Manage multi-asset portfolios comprised of physical, synthetic and multi-manager fund assets
Partner with Client CIOs and clients to design, construct and manage portfolios
Perform daily fund management tasks including implementing multiple investment strategies, handling client flows, rebalancing, and monitoring positioning, performance and risk
Ensure all mandates conform to performance expectations, investment guidelines, risk parameters, and regulatory requirements
Utilize technology and analytical tools to enhance processes and create scale
Interface with analytics, risk, data and other platform teams to drive process improvements and contribute to overall systems, investment and trading process enhancements
Participate in research related to multi-asset portfolio construction and other investment topics
Help control and establish best practices in portfolio implementation across multiple investment processes and products throughout Multi-Asset Strategies and Client Portfolio Solutions (transfer coefficient, costs, etc.)
Engage with internal investment teams to leverage product and trading innovations in the investment process
Experience/Qualifications:
Degree in a quantitative field (Physics, Maths, Finance, Economics, Computer Science or similar) or equivalent demonstrated professional experience
Four to seven years of experience in portfolio management or like role desired, with accompanying knowledge of multi-asset portfolio construction, exposure and risk measures, and attribution
Understanding of quantitative investment research and optimization techniques preferred
Experience in a range of multi-asset instruments and markets such as ETFs and other fund vehicles, derivatives, FX, rates, equities and credit markets (options, IRS, CDS, etc. a plus)
Meticulous attention to detail with an ability to remain focused across a wide range of portfolio types and activities.
Flexible, responsive and self-starting personality. Demonstrated experience working both independently and as part of a team in a highly collaborative, global environment
Strong process awareness and sense of accountability and ownership in recognizing and addressing risks in the business
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including ability to deliver presentations internally/externally and coordinate across a variety of functions around the firm
Technical skills such as Python, Matlab, Tableau and SQL desirable
About BlackRock
BlackRock’s purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being. As a fiduciary to investors and a leading provider of financial technology, our clients turn to us for the solutions they need when planning for their most important goals. As of March 31, 2020, the firm managed approximately $6.47 trillion in assets on behalf of investors worldwide.
